Lean your chest forward and sit back until the back knee taps the cushion.
Breathe out and stand up on the front leg, the hand still on the foot, the other arm out.
Each stand is one. One leg, press Switch sides, the other; type the weaker leg's count.
304.name: Shrimp squat, foot held
304.setup: A cushion behind you; one hand holds the back foot behind your seat.
304.stop: Stop when you tip forward or the knee drops fast. Count the weaker side.
tips: Lean your chest well forward and reach the free arm ahead to balance.
Let the front knee move forward over your toes while the heel stays flat.
Pull the held heel towards your seat so the back knee points straight down.

305.cue: Free leg crossed behind the standing leg, sit low, stand. Count out loud, breathe out up.
how: Stand in clear space with the desk just within reach at your side to catch yourself.
Stand on one leg and cross the free leg behind it, its foot reaching out the other side.
Sit all the way down on the standing leg, the free leg straight and up.
Keep the heel flat and your arms forward, then breathe out and stand back up.
Each stand is one. One leg, press Switch sides, the other; type the weaker leg's count.
305.name: Dragon pistol
305.setup: Clear space; the desk within reach to catch yourself.
305.stop: Stop when your knee caves in or your hips twist. Count the weaker side.
tips: Slide the free leg further across as you sink, so it never rests on the floor.
Keep the standing knee over your toes as your hips turn.
Stay tight at the bottom and drive straight up, with no bounce.

306.cue: Lower slowly as one piece, pull back up with no push. Count out loud, breathe steadily.
how: Kneel on a folded towel, heels hooked under a heavy sofa that cannot tip or slide.
Kneel tall in a straight line from knees to head, hands up in front of your chest.
Lower forward for 3 s or more until your chest is just above the floor, body straight.
Pull back up to kneeling tall with the backs of your thighs, hands off the floor.
Breathe steadily. Each trip down and back up counts as one, counted out loud.
306.name: Full Nordic curl
306.setup: Heels under a heavy sofa, never a chair; hands ready to catch.
306.stop: Stop when you drop fast or bend at the hips.
tips: Squeeze your seat and belly so the line from knees to head never folds.
Pull your heels up hard into the sofa to start the way back.
Keep your hands in front with bent elbows, ready to catch you if you drop.

307.cue: Burpee, then jump and pull your knees up high. Breathe out on every jump.
how: Stand at the back of your clear space, feet hip-width apart, with clear space above you.
Squat, put your hands flat on the floor and jump your feet back to a straight line.
Jump your feet back in to your hands and stand up fast.
Jump straight up, pull both knees up towards your chest and land softly.
Breathe hard and freely and keep going, as fast as clean reps allow, until the clock ends.
307.name: Tuck-jump burpees
307.setup: A body length of clear floor behind you, shoes on, a floor that does not slip.
tips: Land on the balls of your feet with soft knees, then let your heels come down.
Brace your belly as your feet go back so your hips stay in line.
Bring your knees up to your chest; do not fold your chest down to them.

308.cue: Legs straight out and level, chin over the bar. Count out loud, breathe out as you pull.
how: Check the bar is fixed firmly and set a stool under it to step down on.
Hang with palms facing away, then lift your straight legs until they are level.
Hold your legs there and pull your chin over the bar, breathing out.
Lower to straight arms with your legs still level.
Each pull with level legs counts as one, counted out loud at the top.
308.name: L-sit pull-up
308.setup: A bar fixed firmly; a stool to step down on.
308.stop: Stop when your legs drop or you swing.
tips: Point your toes and squeeze your thighs so your knees stay straight.
Lean back a little as you pull, so your legs balance in front of the bar.
Start each rep from a still hang with your legs up.

309.cue: Pull until your chest touches the bar, lower fully. Count out loud, breathe out up.
how: Check the bar is fixed firmly and set a stool under it to step down on.
Grip with palms facing away, hands a little wider than your shoulders.
From straight arms, pull until your upper chest touches the bar, breathing out.
Lower all the way to straight arms, breathing in.
Each touch of chest to bar counts as one, counted out loud.
309.name: Chest-to-bar pull-up
309.setup: A bar fixed firmly; a stool to step down on.
309.stop: Stop when your chest no longer reaches the bar.
tips: Lean back a little and lift your chest up to the bar as you pull.
Drive your elbows down and back behind your ribs at the top.
Keep your legs still: a kick or a swing does not count.

31.cue: Hips back, back flat, bow until you feel your hamstrings. Breathe out as you rise.
how: Stand with feet hip-width apart, hands on your hips, knees very slightly bent.
Stand tall with your chest up, shoulders back and your neck long.
Push your hips back and bow, back flat, until you feel the backs of your thighs.
Breathe in as you bow, then breathe out as you drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Keep a slow, even rhythm until the clock ends.
31.name: Good morning
31.setup: Stand tall, hands on your hips.
tips: Imagine your hips reaching back to touch a wall behind you.
Keep your knees still and slightly bent, since the move happens at the hips.
Look at the floor a little ahead so your neck stays in line with your back.

310.cue: Pull to one hand, the other arm straight along the bar. Count out loud, breathe out up.
how: Check the bar is fixed firmly, set a stool under it and grip twice shoulder-width.
From straight arms, pull your chin up towards one hand, breathing out.
Let the other arm go straight along the bar as you rise; it only steadies you.
Lower back to the middle until both arms are straight.
Each pull is one. One side, press Switch sides, the other; type the weaker side's count.
310.name: Archer pull-up
310.setup: A bar fixed firmly, hands wide; a stool to step down on.
310.stop: Stop when the straight arm bends or you twist. Count the weaker side.
tips: Let the straight arm's hand roll over the top of the bar as you go up.
Keep your chest facing the bar; do not turn towards the pulling arm.
Pull with the bent arm; the straight arm presses down only lightly.

311.cue: Pull up on the bar arm; the towel hand only steadies. Count out loud, breathe out up.
how: Check the bar is fixed firmly and hang a bath towel over it a little out from one hand.
Grip the bar with one hand, both towel ends with the other, that fist at chest height.
From a straight arm, pull your chin over the bar, the towel hand only steadying.
Lower slowly all the way to a straight arm, never dropping into the bottom.
Each pull counts as one. Do every rep on one side, then press Switch sides.
311.name: One-arm pull-up, towel at chest height
311.setup: A bar fixed firmly; a bath towel hung over it beside one hand. A stool below.
311.stop: Stop when you cannot lower slowly: step down. Count the weaker side.
tips: Hold the towel at chest height each time so your record stays fair.
Pull your shoulder down first, then bend the elbow.
Step onto the stool the moment the way down speeds up.

312.cue: Chin over the bar on one arm, lower slowly all the way. Count out loud, breathe out up.
how: Check the bar is fixed firmly and set a stool under it to step down on.
Hang from one hand, palm facing you or to the side, the free hand off the bar and arm.
Pull your shoulder down, then pull until your chin is over the bar, breathing out.
Lower slowly to a straight arm, or step onto the stool if you cannot.
Each pull is one. One arm, press Switch sides, the other; type the weaker arm's count.
312.name: One-arm pull-up
312.setup: A bar fixed firmly; one hand on the bar. A stool to step down on.
312.stop: Stop when you cannot lower slowly: step down. Count the weaker side.
tips: Squeeze your legs together and brace your belly so your body does not spin.
Drive the elbow down towards your ribs, close to your side.
Keep the shoulder set at the bottom; never hang loose from one arm.

313.cue: Lean back on one arm, pull to the towel, hold 3 seconds. Count out loud, breathe steadily.
how: Lay the towel over the door's top, its end knot on the far side; shut and lock the door.
Pull the towel hard once: the door must not move.
Hold the towel's free end, toes against the door, and lean back on the straight arm.
Pull your chest up to your hand in 1 s, breathing out, and hold it there for 3 s.
Lower with control, hips square; do every rep on one side, then press Switch sides.
313.name: One-arm towel row with a hold
313.setup: A knotted bath towel over the top of a solid door that you push to open.
313.stop: Stop when your hips twist or the door moves. Count the weaker side.
tips: Say the three beats out loud at the top, which keeps you breathing.
In the hold keep your elbow close to your ribs and your shoulder low.
Keep your toes against the door each time so your record stays fair.

314.cue: Back level, knees tucked, hands to your lower chest. Count out loud, breathe out up.
how: Check the bar or rings are fixed firmly and set a stool below to step down on.
Hang, tuck your knees up and lift your hips until your back is level.
Bend your arms, pulling your hands toward your lower chest, back level, breathing out.
Lower to straight arms and keep your hips as high as your shoulders.
Each pull from straight arms counts as one, counted out loud.
314.name: Tuck front-lever row
314.setup: A fixed bar or rings; a stool to step down on.
314.stop: Stop when your hips drop or you swing.
tips: Keep your knees tucked in tight; a tight tuck is easier to hold level.
Pull your shoulder blades back and down before you bend your arms.
Start each rep from a still, level hang.

315.cue: Pull your chest to one hand, the other arm straight. Count out loud, breathe out up.
how: Lean on the edge, then pull gently: if the table lifts, slides or creaks, stop.
Lie under it and grip the edge with your hands wide, inside the table's legs.
Heels on the floor, lift your hips so your body is straight from heels to head.
Breathe out and pull your chest up to one hand, the other arm long, then lower.
Each pull is one. One side, press Switch sides, the other; type the weaker side's count.
315.name: Archer row under a table
315.setup: A heavy four-legged table, hands wide; never glass, folding, a standing or monitor desk.
315.stop: Stop when your hips sag or the table moves. Count the weaker side.
tips: Slide your chest sideways towards the pulling hand; do not turn your hips.
Let the long arm rest on the edge; it only steadies you.
Squeeze your seat so your hips rise with your chest.

316.cue: Hang, tuck your knees, lift until your back is level. Count out loud, breathe steadily.
how: Check the bar or rings are fixed firmly and set a stool below to step down on.
Hang with straight arms, palms facing away, and pull your shoulders down.
Tuck your knees to your chest and lean back until your back is level with the floor.
Keep your arms locked, press the bar down towards your hips and breathe slowly.
The clock counts up: hold until your back tips out of level, then step down.
316.name: Tuck front lever
316.setup: A fixed bar or rings; a stool to step down on.
316.stop: Stop when your hips drop or your arms bend.
tips: Keep your head in line with your back, not lifted or tucked.
Keep your knees tight to your chest; the hold gets harder as they move away.
Think of pushing the bar down to your hips, not of pulling yourself up.

317.cue: Back flat and level, row the bar to your lower chest. Count out loud, breathe out up.
how: Check the bar or rings are fixed firmly and set a stool below to step down on.
Hang and lean back until your back is flat and level, thighs straight up, knees bent.
Bend your arms and pull your body up to the bar, back still flat, breathing out.
Lower to straight arms with your back still flat and level.
Each pull from straight arms counts as one, counted out loud.
317.name: Flat-back front-lever row
317.setup: A fixed bar or rings; a stool to step down on.
317.stop: Stop when your hips drop or your back rounds.
tips: Keep your hips as high as your shoulders through the whole rep.
Pull your shoulder blades back and down before your arms bend.
Keep your knees over your hips; a tighter tuck is the easier move below this one.

318.cue: Hang, lift your straight body level with the floor. Count out loud, breathe steadily.
how: Check the bar or rings are fixed firmly and set a stool below to step down on.
Hang with straight arms, palms facing away, and pull your shoulders down.
Tuck and lean back to a level back, then push your legs out straight and together.
Hold one line from shoulders to toes, level with the floor, and breathe slowly.
The clock counts up: hold until the line breaks, then tuck and step down.
318.name: Front lever
318.setup: A fixed bar or rings; a stool to step down on.
318.stop: Stop when your hips drop or your arms bend.
tips: Squeeze your seat and point your toes so your hips stay straight.
Press the bar down towards your hips with locked elbows.
Keep your head in line with your body, not tucked to look at your feet.

319.cue: Knees tucked, lift hips and back off the floor, lower slowly. Count out loud, breathe.
how: Lie on your back, head near a heavy sofa or bed, and grip its frame behind your head.
Tuck your knees to your chest and roll up until only your upper back is on the floor.
Lower your back slowly to just above the floor, knees still tucked.
Breathe out, pull on the frame and lift your hips and back up again.
Each lift and slow lowering counts as one, counted out loud.
319.name: Tuck dragon flag
319.setup: Lie by a heavy sofa or bed and grip its frame behind your head. Never a desk or chair.
319.stop: Stop when your lower back arches or your neck takes the weight.
tips: Rest your weight on your upper back and shoulders, never on your head.
Pull your ribs down and tuck your tail so your lower back never arches.
Keep pulling on the frame with bent arms; it holds your shoulders down.

32.cue: Hinge on one leg, the other leg back, hips level. Breathe out as you rise.
how: Stand side-on to the desk and rest the nearer hand lightly on its edge.
Stand on the leg away from the desk, knee soft, the other foot just off the floor.
Tip from the hip as the free leg reaches back, back flat, chest nearly level.
Breathe in as you tip forward and breathe out as you squeeze your seat to stand tall.
Each stand counts one; finish one side, press Switch sides, then turn round for the other.
32.name: Single-leg deadlift at the desk
32.setup: One hand on the desk edge.
32.stop: Stop when your hips twist or your back rounds. Count the weaker side.
tips: Point the toes of the back foot at the floor to keep your hips level.
Keep a straight line from your head to your back heel, like a seesaw.
Use the desk only for light balance and press down through the standing heel.

320.cue: Tuck up, straighten your body, lower it straight for 3 seconds. Count out loud, breathe.
how: Lie on your back, head near a heavy sofa or bed, and grip its frame behind your head.
Tuck your knees and roll up until only your upper back is on the floor.
Push your legs straight up so your body is one line from shoulders to toes.
Breathe out and lower that line for 3 s or more until your heels are near the floor.
Tuck up again for the next one. Each straight lowering counts as one, out loud.
320.name: Dragon flag lowering
320.setup: Lie by a heavy sofa or bed and grip its frame behind your head. Never a desk or chair.
320.stop: Stop when your hips bend or your lower back arches.
tips: Squeeze your seat hard so your body stays in one line all the way down.
Rest your weight on your upper back and shoulders, never on your head.
Keep pulling on the frame; your arms hold your shoulders down as you lower.

321.cue: Body straight from shoulders to toes, lower and raise it. Count out loud, breathe slowly.
how: Lie on your back, head near a heavy sofa or bed, and grip its frame behind your head.
Tuck up onto your upper back, then push your legs straight up into one line.
Lower the line slowly until your heels are just above the floor.
Breathe out and lift it back up, still in one line from shoulders to toes.
Each lowering and lift counts as one, counted out loud.
321.name: Dragon flag
321.setup: Lie by a heavy sofa or bed and grip its frame behind your head. Never a desk or chair.
321.stop: Stop when your hips bend or your lower back arches.
tips: Squeeze your seat and legs so the line stays stiff.
Rest your weight on your upper back and shoulders, never on your head.
Pull hard on the frame to start the lift; do not kick or fold to get up.

322.cue: From standing, roll out to a flat body and roll back. Count out loud, breathe out back.
how: Clear the floor to a wall ahead and stand where it stops the wheel at your full reach.
Feet hip-width apart, bend forward and set the wheel on the floor by your toes.
Roll out slowly until your body is flat just above the floor, arms long.
Breathe out, press the wheel down and pull it back to your feet to stand.
Each roll out and back to your feet counts as one, counted out loud.
322.name: Standing rollout
322.setup: A wheel, a body length of clear floor and a wall ahead as a stop.
322.stop: Stop when your lower back sags.
tips: Tuck your tail under and pull your ribs down before the wheel moves.
Keep your arms straight and your head between them at full reach.
If you cannot pull back, set your knees down and roll in from there.

323.cue: Forearm down, lift your hips, bottom leg hanging free. Count out loud.
how: Lie on your side on the floor beside a bed or sofa that stays put when you push it.
Put your top ankle on its edge, leg straight, elbow right under your shoulder.
Lift your hips into a straight line from ankle to head, bottom leg hanging free.
Put your top hand on your hip and breathe slowly and steadily.
The clock counts up: hold until your hips sink, then press Switch sides for the other.
323.name: Long-lever Copenhagen
323.setup: Top ankle on the edge of a bed or sofa, forearm on the floor.
323.stop: Stop when your hips drop or your inner thigh hurts. Count the weaker side.
tips: Press the top ankle down into the edge, since that is what lifts your hips.
Keep the top knee straight and your hips stacked, not tipping back.
Push the floor away with your forearm so your shoulder stays strong.

324.cue: Side plank, then lift the top leg and the top arm. Count out loud.
how: Lie on your side on the floor, elbow right under your shoulder, feet stacked.
Lift your hips until your body is straight from feet to head.
Lift the top leg a foot's length above the other and reach the top arm straight up.
Hold the star still and breathe slowly and steadily.
The clock counts up: hold until the star sinks, then press Switch sides for the other.
324.name: Star side plank
324.setup: Forearm and feet on the floor.
324.stop: Stop when your hips drop. Count the weaker side.
tips: Lift the top leg straight up, not forward, toes pointing ahead.
Push the floor away with your forearm and the edge of your bottom foot.
Keep your top hip right over the lower one as the leg goes up.

325.cue: Lower your hips to the floor and lift them level again. Count out loud, breathe out up.
how: Lie on your side on the floor beside a bed or sofa that stays put when you push it.
Put your top ankle on its edge, leg straight, elbow right under your shoulder.
Lift your hips into a straight line, then lower them slowly to touch the floor.
Breathe out and lift your hips back into the straight line.
Each lift is one. One side, press Switch sides, the other; type the weaker side's count.
325.name: Copenhagen raises
325.setup: Top ankle on the edge of a bed or sofa, forearm on the floor.
325.stop: Stop when your hips roll back or your inner thigh hurts. Count the weaker side.
tips: Lift by pressing the top leg into the edge, not by pushing off with the bottom foot.
Keep your hips stacked and facing forward on the way down and up.
Move at one even speed, with no drop at the bottom.

326.cue: Low arm straight, high arm pulling, knees tucked, hips up level. Count out loud, breathe.
how: Use only a steel pole fixed in the ground that does not flex or turn, on soft ground.
Stand side-on: far hand above your head, near hand lower, a bit wider than your shoulders.
Lock the low arm and push, pull with the high arm and lift your feet, knees tucked.
Raise your hips until they are level with your shoulders, and keep breathing.
The clock counts up: hold until your hips sink, then press Switch sides and swap hands.
326.name: Tuck flag
326.setup: A steel pole fixed in the ground outdoors that does not turn; soft ground under you.
326.stop: Come down when your low arm bends or your hips drop. Count the weaker side.
tips: Push the low arm long and hard, as if to push the pole away from you.
Keep your chest facing straight ahead; do not let it turn up to the sky.
Come down feet first and with control; never let go at the top.

327.cue: Low arm straight, one leg long, one knee tucked, body level. Count out loud, breathe.
how: Use only a steel pole fixed in the ground that does not flex or turn, on soft ground.
Stand side-on: far hand above your head, near hand lower, a bit wider than your shoulders.
Lock the low arm and push, pull with the high arm and lift into the tuck flag.
Stretch the top leg out in line with your body, the lower knee tucked, and breathe.
The clock counts up: hold until your hips sink, then press Switch sides and swap hands.
327.name: One-leg flag
327.setup: A steel pole fixed in the ground outdoors that does not turn; soft ground under you.
327.stop: Come down when your low arm bends or your hips drop. Count the weaker side.
tips: Squeeze your seat so the long leg stays as high as your hips and shoulders.
Push the low arm long and hard into the pole the whole time.
Come down feet first and with control; never let go at the top.

328.cue: Low arm straight, high arm pulling, whole body level and long. Count out loud, breathe.
how: Use only a steel pole fixed in the ground that does not flex or turn, on soft ground.
Stand side-on: far hand above your head, near hand lower, a bit wider than your shoulders.
Lock the low arm and push, pull with the high arm and lift into the tuck flag.
Open out into one straight line, legs together, level with the ground, and breathe.
The clock counts up: hold until the line sinks, then press Switch sides and swap hands.
328.name: Human flag
328.setup: A steel pole fixed in the ground outdoors that does not turn; soft ground under you.
328.stop: Come down when your low arm bends or your legs drop. Count the weaker side.
tips: Squeeze your legs together and point your toes to keep the line stiff.
Push with the low arm as hard as you pull with the high one.
Come down feet first and with control; never let go at the top.

329.cue: Hips high over your hands, head toward the floor, push up. Count out loud, breathe out up.
how: Kneel on the floor facing away from a bed or a low sofa, hands flat, shoulder-width apart.
Put your toes up on its edge and walk your hands back until your hips are high.
Bend your elbows and lower the top of your head slowly towards the floor.
Breathe out and push back up until your arms are straight, hips staying high.
Each push to straight arms counts as one, counted out loud.
329.name: Feet-up pike push-up
329.setup: Feet on a bed or a low sofa, never on a chair with wheels.
tips: Aim your head a hand's length ahead of your hands, not between them.
Let your elbows point back towards your feet, not out to the sides.
Lower slowly so your head stops just short of the floor, never bumping it.

33.cue: Push through your heels, hips up until knees, hips and shoulders line up. Breathe out up.
how: Lie on your back, feet flat and hip-width apart, heels about 30 cm from your seat.
Rest your arms flat by your sides, palms down, with your head on the floor.
Push through your heels to lift your hips, then squeeze your seat for a moment at the top.
Breathe out as you lift and breathe in as you lower slowly.
Each time your hips touch down counts as one.
33.name: Glute bridge
33.setup: Lie on your back on the floor, knees bent, feet flat.
33.stop: Stop when your back arches or your hamstrings cramp.
tips: Tuck your tailbone a little as you lift, so the lift comes from your seat.
Keep your knees hip-width apart, pointing straight over your feet.
Press your arms into the floor so your shoulders stay down and your hips do the lifting.

330.cue: Walk your feet up the wall, chest to the wall, arms straight. Count out loud, breathe.
how: Clear a 2 by 2 m floor by a bare wall, away from the desk, and warm your wrists.
Start in a push-up with your feet at the wall, hands shoulder-width apart.
Walk your feet up the wall and your hands in until your chest is near the wall.
Push tall through straight arms, toes on the wall, and breathe slowly.
The clock counts up: hold until your arms tire, then walk your hands out and feet down.
330.name: Wall handstand
330.setup: A clear 2 by 2 m floor and a wall, never beside the desk. Warm your wrists first.
330.stop: Come down when your arms shake or your back arches.
tips: Push the floor away so your shoulders rise up towards your ears.
Pull your ribs in and squeeze your seat so your back stays flat.
Spread your fingers wide and press your whole palm into the floor.

331.cue: From the wall handstand, head to the towel, push up. Count out loud, breathe out up.
how: Clear a 2 by 2 m floor by a bare wall, away from the desk, and fold a towel in two.
Lay the towel two hand-lengths out from the wall, then walk up into the wall handstand.
Bend your elbows and lower slowly until your head touches the towel softly.
Breathe out and push the floor away until your arms are straight again.
Each push to straight arms counts as one, counted out loud.
331.name: Wall handstand push-up
331.setup: A clear 2 by 2 m floor, a wall, a folded towel under your head. Never beside the desk.
331.stop: Come down when you cannot lower slowly or your elbows flare.
tips: Keep your elbows in line over your wrists, not flared out to the sides.
Keep your belly tight and your seat squeezed so your back does not arch.
Stuck at the bottom? Walk your feet down the wall; never drop onto your head.

332.cue: Kick up, arms straight, ribs in, balance with your fingers. Count out loud, breathe.
how: Clear a body length of floor on every side, away from the desk, and warm your wrists.
Step one foot forward and put your hands flat on the floor, shoulder-width apart.
Kick the back leg up, push off the front foot and bring your legs together over your hips.
Push tall through straight arms, ribs in, and breathe slowly as you balance.
The clock counts up once both feet are up: hold until you tip, then step one foot down.
332.name: Freestanding handstand
332.setup: A body length of clear floor on every side, never beside the desk. Warm your wrists.
332.stop: Come down when you tip: step one hand forward and turn out.
tips: Press your fingertips into the floor when your legs start to tip over.
Kick up gently, since too hard a kick is what tips you over.
Squeeze your seat and legs together so your body moves as one piece.

333.cue: From a handstand, head to the towel, push up to straight arms. Count out loud, breathe.
how: Clear a body length of floor on every side and lay a folded towel on the floor.
Kick up to a steady handstand with the towel just past your fingers, arms straight.
Bend your elbows and lower slowly until your head touches the towel softly.
Breathe out and push back up to straight arms, legs together over your hips.
Each push to straight arms counts as one, counted out loud.
333.name: Handstand push-up
333.setup: A body length of clear floor on every side and a folded towel under your head.
333.stop: Come down when you cannot lower slowly or you tip.
tips: Lean your shoulders forward as you lower, so your head lands ahead of your hands.
Keep your elbows in line over your wrists, not flared out to the sides.
Squeeze your seat and legs so your feet stay over your hips the whole way.

334.cue: Push down, lift your hips, heels stay down. Count out loud.
how: Set parallettes or two equal stacks of hard books just wider than your hips.
Sit between them, legs straight out, and press on each stack to check it stays put.
Lay a hand flat on each stack, lock your arms and push down until your hips lift.
Keep your heels on the floor, push your shoulders down and breathe slowly.
The clock counts up: hold until your hips sink or your shoulders rise.
334.name: Foot-supported L-sit on books
334.setup: Parallettes or two equal stacks of hard books, never chairs on wheels, on a firm floor.
334.stop: Stop when your shoulders creep up to your ears.
tips: Keep your chest up and look straight ahead, not down at your legs.
Press through the whole hand with your fingers pointing forward.
Think of growing tall: your neck gets long as your shoulders go down.

335.cue: Push down, lift your hips, knees tucked, both feet off the floor. Count out loud.
how: Set parallettes or two equal stacks of hard books just wider than your hips.
Sit between them with your knees bent and lay a hand flat on each stack.
Lock your arms, push down and lift your hips, then pull both knees up toward your chest.
Hold both feet in the air, shoulders pushed down, and breathe slowly.
The clock counts up: hold until a foot lands or your shoulders rise.
335.name: Tuck L-sit on books
335.setup: Parallettes or two equal stacks of hard books, never chairs on wheels, on a firm floor.
335.stop: Stop when your feet touch down or your shoulders creep up.
tips: Push the books down hard; the taller you push, the more room your feet have.
Keep your arms locked and your chest lifted, not caved in.
Pull your knees up with your belly; do not lean back to lift them.

336.cue: Tuck L-sit on books, then stretch one leg straight out in front. Count out loud.
how: Set parallettes or two equal stacks of hard books just wider than your hips.
Sit between them, a hand flat on each stack, push down and lift into the tuck L-sit.
Push one leg out straight in front, level with your hips, the other knee still tucked.
Keep your arms locked and your shoulders down, and breathe slowly.
The clock counts up: hold until the leg sinks, then press Switch sides for the other leg.
336.name: One-leg L-sit on books
336.setup: Parallettes or two equal stacks of hard books, never chairs on wheels, on a firm floor.
336.stop: Stop when the straight leg drops or your shoulders creep up. Count the weaker side.
tips: Lock the knee of the straight leg and point its toes.
Squeeze the thigh of the straight leg hard, since that is what holds it level.
Keep your chest lifted as the leg goes out.

337.cue: Push down, lift your hips, both legs straight out and level. Count out loud.
how: Set parallettes or two equal stacks of hard books just wider than your hips.
Sit between them with your legs straight and together and lay a hand flat on each stack.
Lock your arms, push down and lift your hips and both heels off the floor.
Hold your legs as high as your hips, shoulders pushed down, and breathe slowly.
The clock counts up: hold until your heels sink below your hips.
337.name: L-sit on books
337.setup: Parallettes or two equal stacks of hard books, never chairs on wheels, on a firm floor.
337.stop: Stop when your legs drop or your knees bend.
tips: Squeeze your thighs and point your toes to keep your knees locked.
Push your shoulders down and your chest up, as if growing taller.
Keep your arms locked, since bent elbows let your hips sink.

338.cue: Push the floor away, lift your hips, legs straight and level. Count out loud.
how: Warm your wrists, then sit on the floor with your legs straight and together.
Put your palms flat beside your hips, fingers forward, and lock your arms.
Lean a little forward, push down hard and lift your hips, then your heels.
Hold your legs as high as your hips, shoulders pushed down, and breathe slowly.
The clock counts up: hold until a heel lands or your legs lose their line.
338.name: Floor L-sit
338.setup: A clear floor; palms flat beside your hips. Warm your wrists first.
338.stop: Stop when your heels touch down or your knees bend.
tips: Push your shoulders down as far as they go, since that gives your hips room.
Squeeze your thighs and point your toes so your knees stay locked.
Turn your fingers out to the sides if your wrists feel tight.

339.cue: L-sit, then pull your knees to your chest and lift your hips higher. Count out loud.
how: Warm your wrists, then sit on the floor, palms flat beside your hips, fingers out or back.
Lock your arms, push the floor away and lift into the floor L-sit.
Draw your knees in to your chest and push your hips forward and up, past your hands.
Hold your feet above your hips, arms locked, and breathe slowly.
The clock counts up: hold until your feet sink below your hips.
339.name: Tuck V-sit
339.setup: A clear floor; palms flat beside your hips. Warm your wrists first.
339.stop: Stop when your feet drop or your arms bend.
tips: Lean your shoulders back a little as your hips come forward, to keep the balance.
Push your shoulders down hard the whole time.
Keep your knees tight to your chest; a loose tuck pulls your feet down.

34.cue: Push through one heel, hips level. Count out loud, breathe out as you lift.
how: Lie on your back, one foot flat with the heel about 30 cm from your seat, arms flat.
Straighten the other leg and lift it off the floor, then keep it still.
Push through the flat heel to raise your hips level, pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Breathe out as you lift and breathe in as you lower, counting each rep out loud.
Each time your hips touch down counts one; one side, press Switch sides, then the other.
34.name: Single-leg bridge
34.setup: Lie on your back on the floor, one knee bent, the other leg up.
34.stop: Stop when your hips drop or tilt, or your hamstring cramps. Count the weaker side.
tips: Press your arms into the floor to help keep both hips at the same height.
Keep the raised leg still and let only the flat heel drive the lift.
Keep the working knee in line over its foot, not drifting in or out.

340.cue: From the L-sit, lift your straight legs well above level. Count out loud.
how: Warm your wrists, then sit on the floor, palms flat beside your hips, fingers out or back.
Lock your arms, push the floor away and lift into the floor L-sit.
Push your hips forward past your hands and raise your legs halfway to straight up.
Hold them there with locked arms and breathe slowly.
The clock counts up: hold until your legs sink back towards the L-sit.
340.name: Low V-sit
340.setup: A clear floor; palms flat beside your hips. Warm your wrists first.
340.stop: Stop when your legs drop to level or your arms bend.
tips: Lean your shoulders back as your legs rise, but keep your elbows locked.
Squeeze your thighs and point your toes so your knees stay straight.
Push your shoulders down and keep your hips ahead of your hands.

341.cue: Lift your straight legs up toward your face, hips ahead of your hands. Count out loud.
how: Warm your wrists, then sit on the floor, palms flat beside your hips, fingers out or back.
Lock your arms, push the floor away and lift into the floor L-sit.
Push your hips forward and up, past your hands, and lean your shoulders back.
Raise your legs until they point straight up, knees locked, and keep breathing.
The clock counts up: hold until your legs sink from straight up.
341.name: V-sit
341.setup: A clear floor; palms flat beside your hips. Warm your wrists first.
341.stop: Stop when your legs drop or your arms bend.
tips: Think of lifting your hips, not your feet: the legs follow the hips up.
Squeeze your thighs and point your toes so your knees stay locked.
Keep your shoulders pushed down; do not let them shrug up.

342.cue: From a push-up position, lean your shoulders over your fingertips. Count out loud.
how: Warm your wrists, then start in a push-up on the floor, fingers turned out a little.
Lock your arms and push the floor away until your upper back is a little round.
Roll forward on your toes until your shoulders are right over your fingertips.
Hold a straight line from heels to head, arms locked, and breathe slowly.
The clock counts up: hold until your arms unlock or your shoulders slide back.
342.name: Planche lean
342.setup: On the floor, wrists warm. Lean until your shoulders are over your fingertips.
342.stop: Stop when your elbows bend or your hips sag.
tips: Turn the insides of your elbows to face forward, which locks your arms.
Tuck your tail under and squeeze your seat so your hips stay in line.
Lean to the same mark each time so your record stays fair.

343.cue: Knees on your bent arms, lean forward, lift both feet. Count out loud, breathe slowly.
how: Put the pillow on the floor in front of where your hands will go, then squat on the floor.
Set your palms flat, shoulder-width apart, fingers spread, and bend your elbows a little.
Rest your knees on the backs of your upper arms, just above the elbows.
Lean forward until your toes grow light, then lift both feet and breathe slowly.
The clock counts up once both feet are up: hold until a foot lands.
343.name: Frog stand
343.setup: A pillow on the floor in front of your hands in case you tip forward.
343.stop: Come down at once if a wrist or an elbow hurts.
tips: Look at the floor a little ahead of your hands, not back at your feet.
Press your fingertips down to stop a tip forward.
Squeeze your knees against your arms so they do not slide off.

344.cue: Shoulders ahead of your hands, lower and push up. Count out loud, breathe out as you push.
how: Warm your wrists, then start in a push-up on the floor, fingers turned out to the sides.
Roll forward on your toes until your hands are beside your waist.
Hold that lean and lower your chest to just above the floor.
Breathe out and push up to locked arms, still leaning forward.
Each push to locked arms counts as one, counted out loud.
344.name: Planche-lean push-up
344.setup: On the floor, hands beside your waist, fingers out. Warm your wrists first.
344.stop: Stop when your hips sag or your shoulders drift back.
tips: Keep your elbows close to your ribs, pointing back towards your feet.
Push the floor away at the top so your upper back rounds a little.
Squeeze your seat and belly so your body moves as one straight line.

345.cue: Knees high on straight arms, lean forward, lift both feet. Count out loud, breathe slowly.
how: Put the pillow on the floor in front of where your hands will go, then squat on the floor.
Set your palms flat, shoulder-width apart, fingers spread, and lock your elbows.
Rise onto your toes and set your knees high on the backs of your upper arms.
Lean forward on locked arms until both feet lift, and breathe slowly.
The clock counts up once both feet are up: hold until a foot lands.
345.name: Straight-arm frog stand
345.setup: A pillow on the floor in front of your hands in case you tip forward.
345.stop: Come down at once if a wrist or an elbow hurts.
tips: Keep your elbows locked; a bend turns it back into the frog stand.
Push the floor away and round your upper back to lift your hips.
Let your shoulders move ahead of your hands as your feet come up.

346.cue: Arms straight, lean forward, knees to your chest, feet off the floor. Count out loud.
how: Put the pillow in front of where your hands will go, warm your wrists and squat down.
Set your palms flat, shoulder-width apart, fingers turned out a little, elbows locked.
Lean your shoulders ahead of your hands and draw your knees to your chest, off your arms.
Lift both feet, raise your hips as high as your shoulders and breathe slowly.
The clock counts up once both feet are up: hold until a foot lands.
346.name: Tuck planche
346.setup: A pillow on the floor in front of your hands in case you tip forward.
346.stop: Come down when your elbows bend or your hips drop.
tips: Keep your knees free of your arms: only your hands touch the floor.
Push the floor away so your upper back rounds and your shoulders stay low.
Turn the insides of your elbows forward to keep your arms locked.

347.cue: Tuck planche, then push your hips back until your back is flat. Count out loud.
how: Put the pillow in front of where your hands will go, warm your wrists and squat down.
Palms flat, shoulder-width apart, elbows locked, lean forward into the tuck planche.
Move your knees back from your chest until your back is flat and level.
Lean further forward to balance your longer body, and breathe slowly.
The clock counts up from the flat back: hold until your back rounds or a foot lands.
347.name: Flat-back tuck planche
347.setup: A pillow on the floor in front of your hands in case you tip forward.
347.stop: Come down when your elbows bend or your hips drop.
tips: The further your knees go back, the more your shoulders must lean ahead.
Keep your hips as high as your shoulders, not above them.
Push the floor away and keep the insides of your elbows facing forward.

348.cue: Arms straight, body level, legs straight and wide apart. Count out loud, breathe.
348.hint: Open your legs only as wide as your hips allow; wider comes with time.
how: Put the pillow in front of where your hands will go, warm your wrists and squat down.
Palms flat, shoulder-width apart, elbows locked, lean forward into the tuck planche.
Open your legs wide and push them out straight behind you, as high as your back.
Lean your shoulders far ahead of your hands to hold the balance, and breathe slowly.
The clock counts up once your legs are straight: hold until your feet sink.
348.name: Straddle planche
348.setup: A pillow on the floor in front of your hands in case you tip forward.
348.stop: Come down when your elbows bend or your hips pike up.
tips: Squeeze your seat and point your toes so your legs stay as high as your hips.
The wider your legs, the easier the hold: start wide and bring them in over time.
Push the floor away and keep the insides of your elbows facing forward.

349.cue: Jump back, chest to the floor, push up, jump in, jump. Count out loud, breathe in rhythm.
how: Stand at the back of your clear space, feet hip-width apart, with clear space above you.
Squat, put your hands flat on the floor and jump your feet back to a straight line.
Lower your chest to the floor, then push up with your body in one straight piece.
Jump your feet in to your hands, stand and jump with your arms overhead, breathing out.
Each landing from the jump counts as one, counted out loud.
349.name: Strict burpee
349.setup: A body length of clear floor behind you, shoes on, a floor that does not slip.
tips: Push up as one piece: chest and hips leave the floor together.
Land on the balls of your feet with soft knees to keep it quiet.
Stand up tall before each jump, one clean rep at a time.

35.cue: Walk your heels out and back, hips up. Count out loud, breathe steadily.
how: Lie on your back on the floor, feet flat and hip-width apart, arms flat by your sides.
Lift your hips into a bridge, then rest on your heels with your toes pulled up.
Walk your heels out in small steps, one foot at a time, to nearly straight legs.
Walk them back the same way while your hips stay off the floor, breathing steadily.
Each full trip out and back counts as one, counted out loud.
35.name: Hamstring walkout
35.setup: Lie on your back on the floor, knees bent, hips up in a bridge.
35.stop: Stop when your hips drop or your hamstrings cramp.
tips: Keep the steps small, only a few centimetres, so your hips can stay lifted.
Dig your heels into the floor and pull toward your seat on the way back.
Keep your seat squeezed the whole time so your hips stay high.

350.cue: Jump and pull your knees up to your chest, land softly. Count out loud, breathe out up.
how: Stand with feet hip-width apart and check nothing hangs low above your head.
Dip into a small squat and swing your arms back behind you.
Swing your arms up, jump straight up and pull both knees up towards your chest.
Breathe out as you jump, stretch your legs back down and land softly on bent knees.
Each soft landing counts as one, counted out loud; stand tall before the next jump.
350.name: Tuck jump
350.setup: Clear space, shoes on, a floor that does not slip.
350.stop: Stop when your landings get loud or your knees cave in.
tips: Bring your knees up to your chest; do not fold your chest down to your knees.
Land on the balls of your feet, then let your heels come down.
Keep your knees pointing over your toes on take-off and on landing.

351.cue: Push up fast, hands leave the floor, land on soft elbows. Count out loud, breathe out.
how: Start in a push-up on the floor, hands under your shoulders, body straight.
Lower your chest to about a fist above the floor.
Breathe out and push up as fast as you can, so both hands lift off a little.
Land on both hands at once, elbows bending, and lower into the next rep.
Each push that lifts both hands counts as one, counted out loud.
351.name: Explosive push-up
351.setup: On a floor that does not slip.
351.stop: Stop when your hips sag or you land on straight arms.
tips: Squeeze your seat and belly so your body lifts and lands as one straight piece.
Catch each landing with spread fingers and a bend in your arms.
A small hop of the hands is enough; push for speed, not height.

352.cue: Push up fast, clap once, land on soft elbows. Count out loud, breathe out as you push.
how: Start in a push-up on the floor, hands under your shoulders, body straight.
Lower your chest to about a fist above the floor.
Breathe out and push up as hard and fast as you can, so your hands lift off.
Clap your hands under your chest, then put them back under your shoulders.
Land with bending elbows. Each clap with a clean landing counts as one, out loud.
352.name: Clap push-up
352.setup: On a floor that does not slip.
352.stop: Stop when your hips sag or you land on straight arms.
tips: Clap small and quick, close to the floor, so your hands are back in time.
Keep your hips in line; do not pike them up to buy time for the clap.
Spread your fingers and let your arms bend to take the landing.

353.cue: Pull fast until your chest reaches the bar, lower fully. Count out loud, breathe out up.
how: Use a fixed bar with room above it, never a doorway bar, and set a box to step down on.
Hang with palms facing away, hands a little wider than your shoulders, arms straight.
Breathe out and pull as fast as you can until your chest is at the bar.
Lower with control to straight arms and let your body go still.
Each fast pull to the chest counts as one, counted out loud.
353.name: Explosive pull-up
353.setup: A fixed bar with room above it, never a doorway bar; a box to step down on.
353.stop: Stop when you swing or your chest no longer reaches the bar.
tips: Keep both hands on the bar; the speed is in the pull, not in letting go.
Drive your elbows down and back hard, as if to bring the bar to your chest.
Start each rep from a still hang, with no kick.

354.cue: Pull fast until the bar is at your lower ribs, lower fully. Count out loud, breathe out.
how: Use a fixed bar with room above it, never a doorway bar, and set a box to step down on.
Hang with palms facing away, hands shoulder-width apart, arms straight.
Breathe out and pull as hard and fast as you can, leaning back a little as you rise.
Keep pulling until the bar is at your lower ribs, then lower slowly to straight arms.
Each pull that brings the bar to your ribs counts as one, counted out loud.
354.name: High pull-up
354.setup: A fixed bar with room above it, never a doorway bar; a box to step down on.
354.stop: Stop when you swing or the bar stays at your chin.
tips: Pull the bar down towards your waist; do not just lift your chin to it.
Keep your legs together and a little forward so your body stays still.
Let your body go still at the bottom before the next pull.

355.cue: Jump from the box, pull, turn your elbows over the bar, press up. Count out loud, breathe.
355.hint: Lean your chest over the bar only as far as your shoulders allow.
how: Use a fixed bar with room above it, never a doorway bar, and a sturdy box below it.
Stand on the box, the bar at about chest height, and grip it shoulder-width, palms away.
Jump and pull at once, lean your chest over the bar and turn both elbows up together.
Breathe out and press to straight arms, hips at the bar, then lower slowly to the box.
Each press to straight arms above the bar counts as one, counted out loud.
355.name: Jumping muscle-up
355.setup: A fixed bar with room above it, never a doorway bar; a sturdy box under it.
355.stop: Stop when one elbow comes over first or you cannot lower slowly.
tips: Lean your chest over the bar as your elbows turn, since that gets you on top.
Jump only as hard as you need, so your arms do the work.
Come down the way you went up: bend your arms, then turn your elbows under.

356.cue: Pull high, turn both elbows over the bar, press to straight arms. Count out loud, breathe.
356.hint: Open shoulders make the turn over the bar smoother.
how: Use a fixed bar with room above it, never a doorway bar, and set a box to step down on.
Hang with palms facing away, hands shoulder-width apart, arms straight.
Breathe out and pull hard and fast, leaning back, until the bar is at your lower ribs.
Lean your chest over the bar, turn both elbows up together and press to straight arms.
Lower slowly back to a still hang. Each press above the bar counts as one, out loud.
356.name: Muscle-up
356.setup: A fixed bar with room above it, never a doorway bar; a box to step down on.
356.stop: Stop when one elbow comes over first or you swing.
tips: Keep the bar close to your body all the way up, as if pulling it to your waist.
Roll your wrists over the top as your chest leans forward.
Lower through the turn with control; never drop from the top into the hang.

357.cue: Jump back, chest to the floor, push up, jump in, jump. Breathe in rhythm.
how: Stand with a body length of clear floor behind you, feet hip-width apart.
Squat, put your hands flat on the floor and jump your feet back to a straight line.
Lower your chest to the floor, then push up to the straight line again.
Jump your feet in to your hands, stand and jump with your arms reaching overhead.
Go as fast as clean reps allow, breathing hard and freely all the way through.
357.name: Chest-to-floor burpees
357.setup: A body length of clear floor behind you, shoes on.
tips: Count a rep only when the chest touched the floor and the jump left it.
Land every jump on soft knees and the balls of your feet to keep it quiet.

358.cue: Push the floor away, lift your hips, heels stay down. Count out loud.
how: Warm your wrists, then sit on the floor with your legs straight and together.
Put your palms flat beside your hips, fingers forward or turned out, and lock your arms.
Push the floor away hard until your hips lift off it. Keep your heels on the floor.
Push your shoulders down away from your ears and breathe slowly.
The clock counts up: hold until your hips sink or your shoulders rise.
358.name: Foot-supported L-sit
358.setup: A clear floor; palms flat beside your hips. Warm your wrists first.
358.stop: Stop when your hips sink or your shoulders creep up to your ears.
tips: Lean a little forward so your hands sit just under your shoulders.
Fists on a folded towel rest your wrists and give your hips a little more room.
Think of growing tall: your neck gets long as your shoulders go down.

359.cue: Lift your hips, then one straight leg; the other heel stays down. Count out loud.
how: Warm your wrists, then sit on the floor with your legs straight and together.
Put your palms flat beside your hips, lock your arms and push until your hips lift.
Lift one straight leg off the floor, level with your hips. Keep the other heel down.
Keep your shoulders pushed down and breathe slowly.
The clock counts up: hold until the leg sinks, then press Switch sides for the other leg.
359.name: L-sit, one heel down
359.setup: A clear floor; palms flat beside your hips. Warm your wrists first.
359.stop: Stop when the raised leg drops or your hips sink. Count the weaker side.
tips: Lock the knee of the raised leg and point its toes.
Squeeze the thigh of the raised leg hard, since that is what holds it up.
Lean a little forward so the leg has room to rise.

36.cue: Hips up, slide your heels out and pull them back. Count out loud, breathe out as you pull.
how: Lie on your back with both heels on a towel, on a smooth floor where it can slide.
Pull your toes up and lift your hips until your knees, hips and shoulders line up.
Slide your heels out until your legs are nearly straight, hips still up.
Breathe in as you slide out and breathe out as you pull your heels back under your knees.
Each pull back to the start counts as one, counted out loud.
36.name: Sliding leg curl
36.setup: Lie on your back, heels on a towel on a smooth floor.
36.stop: Stop when your hips drop or your hamstrings cramp.
tips: Press your arms and shoulders into the floor to keep your hips high.
Dig your heels into the towel as you pull, as if dragging the floor toward you.
Pull with both heels at the same speed so the towel slides straight back.

360.cue: Push the floor away, lift your hips, knees tucked, both feet off. Count out loud.
how: Warm your wrists, then sit on the floor with your knees bent and your feet flat.
Put your palms flat beside your hips, a little in front of them, and lock your arms.
Push the floor away hard and lift your hips, then pull both knees up toward your chest.
Hold both feet off the floor, shoulders pushed down, and breathe slowly.
The clock counts up: hold until a foot lands or your shoulders rise.
360.name: Tuck L-sit
360.setup: A clear floor; palms flat beside your hips. Warm your wrists first.
360.stop: Stop when a foot touches down or your shoulders creep up.
tips: Keep your hips between your hands; do not let them swing forward.
Pull your knees up with your belly; do not lean back to lift them.
Fists on a folded towel rest your wrists and give your feet a little more room.

361.cue: Tuck L-sit, then push one leg out straight and level. Count out loud.
how: Warm your wrists, then sit on the floor, palms flat beside your hips, arms locked.
Push the floor away, lift your hips and pull both knees up into the tuck L-sit.
Push one leg out straight in front, level with your hips, the other knee still tucked.
Keep your arms locked and your shoulders down, and breathe slowly.
The clock counts up: hold until the leg sinks, then press Switch sides for the other leg.
361.name: One-leg L-sit
361.setup: A clear floor; palms flat beside your hips. Warm your wrists first.
361.stop: Stop when the straight leg drops or a foot lands. Count the weaker side.
tips: Lock the knee of the straight leg and point its toes.
Squeeze the thigh of the straight leg hard, since that is what holds it level.
Lean your shoulders a little forward to give the leg room.

362.cue: Lift your hips, pull one knee in, the other foot on its toes. Count out loud.
how: Warm your wrists, then sit on the floor with your knees bent and your feet flat.
Put your palms flat beside your hips, a little in front of them, and lock your arms.
Push the floor away hard and lift your hips, your feet coming up onto their toes.
Pull one knee up toward your chest, the other toes still down, shoulders pushed down.
The clock counts up: hold until the lifted foot lands, then press Switch sides.
362.name: Tuck L-sit, one foot down
362.setup: A clear floor; palms flat beside your hips. Warm your wrists first.
362.stop: Stop when the lifted foot lands or your shoulders creep up. Count the weaker side.
tips: Keep your hips between your hands; do not let them swing forward.
Keep your chest up; do not lean forward to meet the lifted knee.
Rest as little weight as you can on the foot that stays down.

363.cue: Push the floor away, lift your hips and your crossed legs off the floor. Count out loud.
how: Warm your wrists, then sit on the floor with your legs crossed at the shins.
Put your palms flat beside your hips, fingers forward, and lock your arms.
Push the floor away hard and lift your hips, then draw your crossed legs up off it.
Hold your seat and both feet in the air, shoulders pushed down, and breathe slowly.
The clock counts up: hold until a foot lands or your shoulders rise.
363.name: Cross-legged lift
363.setup: A clear floor; cross your shins, never a foot on your thigh. Warm your wrists first.
363.stop: Stop when a foot touches down or your shoulders creep up.
tips: Pull your knees up toward your chest with your belly; keep your chest up.
Cross your shins the other way next time, so both hips get the same work.
Fists on a folded towel rest your wrists and give your feet a little more room.

364.cue: Elbows brush your ribs, chest to your hands. Count out loud, breathe out as you push.
how: Place your hands on the floor under your chest, close enough that they touch.
Step back onto your toes, feet hip-width apart, body straight from heels to head.
Lower your chest to your hands, your elbows brushing your ribs.
Breathe out as you push the floor away until your arms are straight.
Count each rep out loud as your arms straighten.
364.name: Close push-up
364.setup: On the floor, hands together under your chest.
364.stop: Stop when your elbows flare or your hips sag.
tips: Keep your elbows pointing back along your sides, never out to the sides.
Turn your fingers a little out if your hands feel cramped this close together.
Squeeze your seat and brace your belly so your hips stay level with your shoulders.

365.cue: Lower and push up on one arm, body straight. Count out loud, breathe out as you push.
how: Push the bed or sofa to check it stays put, then stand facing its long edge.
Place one hand on the edge in line with the middle of your chest, the other on your back.
Walk your feet back and wide until your body is one straight line from heels to head.
Lower your chest toward the edge, then push it away, breathing out.
Each lower and push counts one rep; do one side, press Switch sides, then the other.
365.name: One-arm push-up, hand on the bed
365.setup: One hand on the edge of a bed or sofa under your chest, feet wide behind.
365.stop: Stop when your hips twist or sag. Count the weaker side.
tips: Spread your feet wider than your hips: a wide base stops your body twisting.
Keep the working elbow close to your side, pointing back toward your hip.
Put your hand where the edge is firmest, near the frame, fingers spread.

366.cue: From the wall handstand, lower to the towel in 3 to 5 s. Count out loud, breathe.
how: Clear a 2 by 2 m floor by a bare wall, away from the desk, and fold a towel in two.
Lay the towel two hand-lengths out from the wall, then walk up into the wall handstand.
Bend your elbows and lower for 3 to 5 slow beats until your head touches the towel.
Walk your hands out and your feet down the wall, back to the plank.
Each slow lowering counts as one, counted out loud; walk up again for the next.
366.name: Wall handstand push-up, lowering only
366.setup: A clear 2 by 2 m floor, a wall, a folded towel under your head. Never beside the desk.
366.stop: Come down when you cannot lower slowly or your elbows flare.
tips: Keep your elbows in line over your wrists, not flared out to the sides.
Never push back up from the towel: the slow way down is the whole rep.
Say the beats out loud so the last part of the way down stays as slow as the first.

367.cue: Chest to the wall, drift until your toes leave it, balance. Count out loud, breathe.
how: Clear a 2 by 2 m floor by a bare wall, away from the desk, and warm your wrists.
Walk up into the wall handstand, chest to the wall, arms straight.
Push tall and let your hips drift over your hands until your toes leave the wall.
Balance there with your fingers and palms, ribs in, and breathe slowly.
Type the seconds your toes stayed off, then walk your hands out and your feet down.
367.name: Wall handstand, toes off
367.setup: A clear 2 by 2 m floor and a wall, never beside the desk. Warm your wrists first.
367.stop: Come down when your back arches; if you tip away, step one hand forward and turn out.
tips: Press your fingertips into the floor as your legs drift away from the wall.
Move your hips over your hands rather than pushing off the wall with your toes.
A light tap back on the wall ends the count: start again when your toes leave it.

368.cue: From a handstand, lower to the towel in 3 s, then come down. Count out loud, breathe.
how: Clear the floor by a bare wall, away from the desk, and fold a towel in two.
Face the wall, hands a forearm's length from it, the towel just past your fingers.
Kick up, then lower for three slow beats until your head touches the towel softly.
Step one foot down to the floor, then the other, and stand up.
Each slow lowering counts as one, counted out loud; kick up again for the next.
368.name: Handstand push-up, lowering only
368.setup: A folded towel, your hands a forearm's length from a wall you face. Never by the desk.
368.stop: Come down when you cannot lower slowly or you tip.
tips: Lean your shoulders forward as you lower, so your head lands ahead of your hands.
If you tip toward the wall, let your heels touch it, then step down.
Never push back up from the towel: the slow way down is the whole rep.

369.cue: Knees on your bent arms, lean until your toes grow light, lift one foot. Count out loud.
how: Put the pillow on the floor in front of where your hands will go, then squat on the floor.
Set your palms flat, shoulder-width apart, fingers spread, and bend your elbows a little.
Rest your knees on the backs of your upper arms, just above the elbows.
Lean forward until your toes grow light, then lift one foot and breathe slowly.
The clock counts up: hold until the lifted foot lands, then press Switch sides.
369.name: Frog stand, one foot up
369.setup: A pillow on the floor in front of your hands in case you tip forward.
369.stop: Come down at once if a wrist or an elbow hurts. Count the weaker side.
tips: Keep the other toes on the floor as light as you can; they only steady you.
Look at the floor a little ahead of your hands, not back at your feet.
Press your fingertips down to stop a tip forward.

37.cue: Hips up, slide one heel out and back. Count out loud, breathe out as you pull.
how: Lie on your back with one heel on a towel, on a smooth floor where it can slide.
Hold the other leg straight up at an angle, pull your toes up and raise your hips.
Slide the heel out until the leg is nearly straight, then pull it back.
Breathe in as you slide out and breathe out as you pull, keeping your hips level.
Each pull back counts one, out loud; finish one side, press Switch sides, then the other.
37.name: Single-leg sliding curl
37.setup: Lie on your back, one heel on a towel on a smooth floor.
37.stop: Stop when your hips drop or tilt. Count the weaker side.
tips: Press both arms into the floor to keep your hips level and high.
Keep the raised leg still and pointing up, so it never swings to help.
Pull the heel back slowly, as if dragging something heavy toward you.

370.cue: Arms straight, lean forward, knees to your chest, toes light on the books. Count out loud.
how: Stack books about 15 cm high where your feet will go, a pillow in front of your hands.
Squat, palms flat shoulder-width apart, fingers turned out a little, elbows locked.
Lean your shoulders ahead of your hands and draw your knees to your chest, off your arms.
Rest your toes lightly on the books, raise your hips toward your shoulders and breathe.
The clock counts up: hold until your elbows bend or your toes press into the books.
370.name: Tuck planche, toes on a book
370.setup: A stack of books behind your feet, a pillow in front of your hands. Warm your wrists.
370.stop: Come down when your elbows bend or your toes take your weight.
tips: The books only steady you: press them as little as you can.
Push the floor away so your upper back rounds and your shoulders stay low.
Lift your toes off the books for a moment at a time: that is the tuck planche.

371.cue: Tuck planche, then move your knees halfway back and flatten your back. Count out loud.
how: Put the pillow in front of where your hands will go, warm your wrists and squat down.
Palms flat, shoulder-width apart, elbows locked, lean forward into the tuck planche.
Move your knees halfway back from your chest and let your back go flatter.
Lean a little further forward to balance, hips as high as your shoulders, and breathe.
The clock counts up from the open hips: hold until your hips drop or a foot lands.
371.name: Tuck planche, hips open
371.setup: A pillow on the floor in front of your hands in case you tip forward.
371.stop: Come down when your elbows bend or your hips drop.
tips: Your knees stay under your belly, halfway between your chest and the flat-back tuck.
Push the floor away and keep the insides of your elbows facing forward.
Open your hips a little further each week as the hold gets steady.

372.cue: Flat-back tuck planche, then push one leg straight back, level. Count out loud.
how: Put the pillow in front of where your hands will go, warm your wrists and squat down.
Palms flat, shoulder-width apart, elbows locked, lean into the flat-back tuck planche.
Push one leg straight back, as high as your hips, the other knee still tucked.
Lean your shoulders further ahead of your hands to hold the balance, and breathe.
The clock counts up from the straight leg: hold until it sinks, then press Switch sides.
372.name: Flat-back tuck planche, one leg back
372.setup: A pillow on the floor in front of your hands in case you tip forward.
372.stop: Come down when the straight leg sinks or your elbows bend. Count the weaker side.
tips: Squeeze the seat of the straight leg and point its toes so it stays level.
Keep your back flat; a round back takes the straight leg down.
Push the floor away and keep the insides of your elbows facing forward.

373.cue: On top of the bar, arms locked, lower your chest to the bar and press up. Count out loud.
373.hint: Stop a little higher if the front of your shoulders feels tight.
how: Use a fixed bar at about chest height, never a doorway bar, with a box beside it.
Grip the bar shoulder-width, palms down, step up and press to locked arms on top of it.
Lean your chest a little forward, legs a little ahead, and bend your elbows back.
Lower until your chest nears the bar, then breathe out and press back to locked arms.
Each press back to locked arms counts as one, counted out loud.
373.name: Straight-bar dip
373.setup: A fixed bar at chest height, never a doorway bar; a box to step up on.
373.stop: Stop when you cannot press back to locked arms or the front of a shoulder pinches.
tips: Keep your elbows pointing back, close to your sides, not flaring out.
Keep your shoulders pushed down, away from your ears, all the way up.
Step down to the box when your arms tire; never drop back off the bar.

374.cue: Hands on the edge by your ears, press up, arms straight, hips up. Breathe slowly.
how: Lie on your back, your head at the bed's edge, knees bent and feet flat, hip-width apart.
Reach back and set your hands on the edge beside your ears, fingers pointing to your feet.
Lift your hips and press your arms straight, your head coming up free of the floor.
Push your hips up and your chest toward the bed, and breathe slowly.
Tuck your chin and lower slowly, upper back first, at the end of the hold.
374.name: Wheel, hands on the bed
374.setup: A bed or a sofa that cannot slide, with 2 m of clear floor in front of it.
374.stop: Come down slowly, chin tucked, if your arms shake or your low back pinches.
tips: Keep your knees and feet pointing forward, not turning out.
Press the edge away through your hands to open your shoulders.
Once your arms lock easily, the wheel on the floor is the next step.

375.cue: Other leg forward, sit to the edge, stand on one leg. Count out loud, breathe out up.
how: Stand a small step in front of a bed or sofa, your back to it, the desk within reach.
Stand on one leg, reach both arms forward and lift the other leg straight out in front.
Sit back on the standing leg until your seat just touches the edge.
Breathe out and stand straight back up on that leg, with no hands and no rocking.
Count each rise out loud; finish one leg, press Switch sides, then do the other.
375.name: Pistol to the bed edge
375.setup: Your back to a bed or sofa edge; the desk within reach to catch you.
375.stop: Stop when you drop onto the edge or your knee caves in. Count the weaker side.
tips: Touch the edge as lightly as you can; never sit down on it and rock back up.
Keep the standing heel flat and that knee over your middle toes.
A lower edge is harder, so keep the same bed or sofa until the count comes easily.

376.cue: Lower on one leg for 5 seconds, then stand up on both. Count out loud, breathe steadily.
how: Stand in clear space with the desk just within reach at your side to catch yourself.
Stand on one leg, reach both arms forward and lift the other leg straight out in front.
Lower on the standing leg for a slow count of five, all the way to the bottom, heel flat.
At the bottom set the other foot down and stand up on both legs, breathing out.
Count each lowering out loud; finish one leg, press Switch sides, then do the other.
376.name: One-leg lowering
376.setup: Clear space; the desk within reach to catch yourself.
376.stop: Stop when you drop fast or your heel lifts. Count the weaker side.
tips: Count the five seconds out loud so the last part of the lowering stays slow.
Reach your arms further forward as you sink to keep your weight over the foot.
Count only a lowering that reaches the bottom under control.

377.cue: Free leg crossed behind, a hand on the desk, sit low, stand. Count out loud, breathe out.
how: Face the desk a small step back, the fingertips of one hand resting on its edge.
Stand on the leg on that side and cross the other leg behind it, the other arm forward.
Sit all the way down on the standing leg, the hand only steadying you.
Keep the heel flat, then breathe out and stand back up.
Each stand is one. One leg, press Switch sides, the other; type the weaker leg's count.
377.name: Dragon pistol, hand on the desk
377.setup: Face the desk, one hand on its edge.
377.stop: Stop when your knee caves in or your hips twist. Count the weaker side.
tips: Slide the free leg further across as you sink, so it never rests on the floor.
Keep the standing knee over your toes as your hips turn.
Lean on the desk less each week; the dragon pistol takes it away.

378.cue: Hips up, one heel out in 3 seconds, pull back with both. Count out loud, breathe out.
how: Lie on your back with both heels on a towel, on a smooth floor where it can slide.
Pull your toes up and lift your hips until your knees, hips and shoulders line up.
Lift one foot and slide the other heel out for a slow count of three, hips still up.
Set the lifted heel down by it and pull both heels back under your knees, breathing out.
Each pull back counts one, out loud; finish one side, press Switch sides, then the other.
378.name: Single-leg slide out, both back
378.setup: Lie on your back, both heels on a towel on a smooth floor.
378.stop: Stop when your hips drop or tilt. Count the weaker side.
tips: Press both arms into the floor to keep your hips level and high.
Count the three seconds out loud so the slide stays slow to the end.
Keep the lifted leg still, so it never swings to help.

379.cue: Lower only as far as you can come back from, pull back up with no hands. Count out loud.
how: Kneel on a folded towel, heels hooked under a heavy sofa that cannot tip or slide.
Kneel tall in a straight line from knees to head, hands up in front of your chest.
Lean forward slowly as one straight piece, only as far as you can still come back from.
Pull your heels into the sofa and pull back up to kneeling tall, hands off the floor.
Breathe steadily. Each return to kneeling tall counts as one, counted out loud.
379.name: Nordic pull-back
379.setup: Heels under a heavy sofa, never a chair; hands ready to catch.
379.stop: Stop when you cannot pull back up or you bend at the hips.
tips: Go a little further as you get stronger, always stopping short of where you would drop.
Squeeze your seat so your hips stay straight on the way down and back.
Keep your hands ready in front; if you drop, catch yourself and end the set.

38.cue: Kneel tall, lean as far as you control, catch, push back up. Count out loud.
how: Kneel on a folded towel, heels hooked under a heavy sofa that cannot tip or slide.
Kneel tall in a straight line from knees to head, hands up in front of your chest.
Lean forward as slowly as you can as one straight piece, as far as you still control.
When you cannot slow it any more, let your hands catch you softly, then push back up.
Each return to kneeling tall counts as one, counted out loud.
38.name: Assisted Nordic
38.setup: Heels under a heavy sofa, never a chair; hands ready to catch.
38.stop: Stop when you fall sooner than on your first rep or bend at the hips.
tips: Squeeze your seat so your hips stay straight as you lean.
Pull your heels up hard into the sofa to feel the backs of your thighs working.
Go a little further each week before your hands catch you.

380.cue: Knees tucked, press the floor, hips up, lower in 3 seconds. Count out loud, breathe.
how: Lie on your back with your arms by your sides, palms flat on the floor.
Pull your knees up to your chest and keep them tucked tight the whole time.
Press your palms down and lift your hips until only your upper back rests on the floor.
Lower your hips for a slow count of three until they touch down, breathing steadily.
Each lift and lowering counts as one, counted out loud.
380.name: Tuck plow raise
380.setup: Lie on your back on a clear floor, arms by your sides, palms down.
380.stop: Stop when you swing up or your neck takes the weight.
tips: Lift with your belly and the press of your hands, never a swing of the legs.
Rest your weight on your upper back and shoulders, never on your neck or head.
Roll down slowly so the lowering takes the full three seconds.

381.cue: Hips open, knees bent, lift onto your shoulders, lower slowly. Count out loud, breathe.
how: Lie on your back, head near a heavy sofa or bed, and grip its frame behind your head.
Tuck your knees and roll up until only your upper back is on the floor.
Open your hips into one line from shoulders to knees, the knees still bent at 90 degrees.
Lower that line slowly, then breathe out and lift it back up.
Each lowering and lift counts as one, counted out loud.
381.name: Dragon flag, hips open
381.setup: Lie by a heavy sofa or bed and grip its frame behind your head. Never a desk or chair.
381.stop: Stop when your hips fold or your lower back arches.
tips: Squeeze your seat so your hips stay open all the way down.
Rest your weight on your upper back and shoulders, never on your head.
Keep pulling on the frame; your arms hold your shoulders down as you lower.

382.cue: Roll out from standing to flat in 3 seconds, knees down, roll back. Count out loud.
how: Clear the floor to a wall ahead and stand where it stops the wheel at your full reach.
Feet hip-width apart, bend forward and set the wheel on the floor by your toes.
Roll out over 3 s until your body is flat just above the floor, arms long.
Set your knees down, breathe out and roll the wheel back in from your knees.
Stand back up with the wheel. Each slow roll out counts as one, counted out loud.
382.name: Standing rollout, lowering
382.setup: A wheel, a body length of clear floor and a wall ahead as a stop.
382.stop: Stop when your lower back sags.
tips: Tuck your tail under and pull your ribs down before the wheel moves.
Keep your arms straight and your head between them at full reach.
Set your knees down softly; the work is the slow roll out before they touch.

383.cue: Low elbow wedged at your hip, top arm hugging the pole, body level. Count out loud.
how: Use only a steel pole fixed in the ground that does not flex or turn, on soft ground.
Stand with the back of one armpit against the pole and grip it at chest height.
Wedge the other elbow into your belly by the hip and grip the pole low with that hand.
Lean onto that elbow, lift your feet and stretch your body out level, and breathe.
The clock counts up: hold until your hips sink, then press Switch sides and swap arms.
383.name: Clutch flag
383.setup: A steel pole fixed in the ground outdoors that does not turn; soft ground under you.
383.stop: Come down when your hips drop or your elbow slips off your hip. Count the weaker side.
tips: Pull with the hugging arm as hard as the low elbow pushes, so your body stays level.
Tuck your knees first and straighten your legs once your hips are level.
Long sleeves spare the skin of your inner arm, where the pole presses.

384.cue: Low arm straight, high arm pulling, legs wide, body level. Count out loud, breathe.
384.hint: Open your legs only as wide as your hips allow, both legs straight.
how: Use only a steel pole fixed in the ground that does not flex or turn, on soft ground.
Stand side-on: far hand above your head, near hand lower, a bit wider than your shoulders.
Lock the low arm and push, pull with the high arm and lift into the tuck flag.
Open your legs straight and wide apart, body level with the ground, and breathe.
The clock counts up: hold until the line sinks, then press Switch sides and swap hands.
384.name: Straddle flag
384.setup: A steel pole fixed in the ground outdoors that does not turn; soft ground under you.
384.stop: Come down when your low arm bends or your legs drop. Count the weaker side.
tips: Open your legs to the same width each set so your record stays fair.
Push with the low arm as hard as you pull with the high one.
Come down feet first and with control; never let go at the top.

385.cue: Hands by your knees, lift both heels, hold one slow breath, lower. Count out loud.
how: Sit on the floor, back tall, legs straight and together, toes pointed.
Put your palms flat on the floor beside your knees, arms straight.
Keep your knees locked and lift both heels off the floor with your thighs alone.
Hold them up for one slow breath, then lower them gently and go again.
Each lift counts as one rep, counted out loud.
385.name: Seated leg lifts
385.setup: A clear floor; sit tall with your legs straight and together.
385.stop: Stop when your knees bend or you lean back to lift.
tips: Lean your chest a little over your legs; leaning back makes the lift easier, not better.
A lift of a few centimetres is plenty at first; the height comes with time.
Squeeze your thighs and point your toes so your knees stay straight.

386.cue: Step up, chin over the bar, elbows tight to your sides, hold. Count out loud, breathe.
how: Check the bar is fixed firmly and set a stool under it, high enough to get your chin over.
Grip with palms facing away, step up and bring your chin over the bar, elbows tight.
Lift your feet and hold there, chest close to the bar, shoulders pulled down.
Keep breathing slowly; step back onto the stool when your chin sinks below the bar.
The clock counts up from the moment your feet leave the stool.
386.name: Flexed-arm hang
386.setup: A bar fixed firmly; a stool to step up on.
386.stop: Stop when your chin sinks below the bar.
tips: Squeeze the bar hard and keep your elbows pressed to your ribs.
Cross your ankles and brace your belly so your body hangs still.
