Keep your neck long; do not crane your chin up to stay over the bar.

387.cue: Start at the top, lower over five slow beats to straight arms. Count out loud.
how: Check the bar is fixed firmly and set a stool under it, high enough to get your chin over.
Grip with palms facing away, step up and bring your chin over the bar, elbows tight.
Lift your feet and lower over five slow beats all the way to straight arms.
Step back onto the stool to reset at the top, breathing out slowly as you lower.
Count only the lowerings that took 5 s or more, each one out loud as one rep.
387.name: Pull-up lowering, 5 seconds
387.setup: A bar fixed firmly; a stool to step up on.
387.stop: Stop when a lowering takes less than 5 seconds.
tips: Count the five beats out loud on the way down; it keeps you breathing.
Fight hardest in the bottom half, where the lowering wants to speed up.
Keep your shoulders down and your legs still, with no swinging.

388.cue: Chin over the bar on one arm, lower in 5 s or more. Count out loud, breathe out down.
how: Check the bar is fixed firmly and set a stool under it, high enough to get your chin over.
Step up, grip with one hand, palm toward you, and bring your chin over the bar.
Take the free hand away, lift your feet and lower for 5 s or more to a straight arm.
Step back onto the stool to reset at the top, breathing out as you lower.
Each lowering is one. One arm, press Switch sides, the other; type the weaker arm's count.
388.name: One-arm lowering
388.setup: A bar fixed firmly; one hand on the bar. A stool to step up on.
388.stop: Stop when you cannot lower for 5 seconds: step down. Count the weaker side.
tips: Squeeze your legs together and brace your belly so your body does not spin.
Keep the elbow close to your side and the shoulder pulled down.
Step onto the stool the moment the way down speeds up; never drop into the bottom.

389.cue: Hang, back flat and level, knees bent over your hips. Count out loud, breathe steadily.
how: Check the bar or rings are fixed firmly and set a stool below to step down on.
Hang with straight arms, palms facing away, and pull your shoulders down.
Tuck and lean back to a level back, then open your hips until your knees are over them.
Keep your back flat and your arms locked, and breathe slowly.
The clock counts up: hold until your back rounds or tips out of level, then step down.
389.name: Front lever, back flat
389.setup: A fixed bar or rings; a stool to step down on.
389.stop: Stop when your hips drop or your back rounds.
tips: Keep your thighs pointing straight up; knees toward your chest is the easier tuck.
Press the bar down towards your hips with locked elbows.
Keep your head in line with your back, not lifted or tucked.

39.cue: Lower for 4 to 5 seconds all the way to the floor, hands only at the end. Count out loud.
how: Kneel on a folded towel, heels hooked under a heavy sofa that cannot tip or slide.
Kneel tall in a straight line from knees to head, hands up in front of your chest.
Lower forward for 4 to 5 s all the way to the floor, body straight as a board.
Catch yourself on your hands only at the very bottom, push back to kneeling and breathe.
Count only a lowering that reaches the floor under control, counted out loud.
39.name: Nordic lowering
39.setup: Heels under a heavy sofa, never a chair; hands ready to catch.
39.stop: Stop when you drop fast or bend at the hips.
tips: Squeeze your seat and belly so the line from knees to head never folds.
Pull your heels up into the sofa to slow the lowering with the backs of your thighs.
Keep your hands ready in front with bent elbows so the catch at the bottom is soft.

390.cue: Back level, one leg long, the other knee tucked. Count out loud, breathe steadily.
how: Check the bar or rings are fixed firmly and set a stool below to step down on.
Hang with straight arms, palms facing away, and pull your shoulders down.
Tuck and lean back to a level back, then push one leg out straight and level.
Keep the other knee tucked to your chest, arms locked, and breathe slowly.
The clock counts up: hold until your hips sink, then press Switch sides for the other leg.
390.name: Front lever, one leg out
390.setup: A fixed bar or rings; a stool to step down on.
390.stop: Stop when your hips drop or your arms bend. Count the weaker side.
tips: Squeeze the seat and point the toes of the long leg so it stays in line.
Press the bar down towards your hips with locked elbows.
Keep your head in line with your body, not tucked to look at your feet.

391.cue: Sit all the way down on one leg, hands on the desk. Count out loud, breathe out up.
how: Face the desk a small step back and hold its edge with both hands, arms reaching forward.
Stand on one leg and hold the other leg straight out in front, heel off the floor.
Sit down on the standing leg until your thigh rests on your calf, heel flat.
Breathe out and stand back up, pulling on the desk only as much as you need.
Count each rise out loud; finish one leg, press Switch sides, then do the other.
391.name: Pistol, hands on the desk
391.setup: Both hands on the desk edge; the desk must not move.
391.stop: Stop when your heel lifts or you must pull hard. Count the weaker side.
tips: Keep the standing heel flat and that knee over your middle toes.
Go all the way down every time; a rise from halfway does not count.
Pull on the desk a little less each week, until your fingertips are enough.

392.cue: At the bottom, hands up for 2 seconds, body straight. Count out loud, breathe steadily.
how: Kneel on a folded towel, heels hooked under a heavy sofa that cannot tip or slide.
Lower forward as one straight piece and catch yourself on your hands, arms straight.
Keep your body straight and lift both hands a few centimetres off the floor for 2 s.
Set your hands down softly, breathe, and lift again; each lift counts as one.
After the last lift, push off your hands back to kneeling tall.
392.name: Nordic hover at the bottom
392.setup: Heels under a heavy sofa, never a chair; a towel under your knees.
392.stop: Stop when you cannot hold 2 seconds or your hips bend.
tips: Squeeze your seat and belly so the line from knees to head never folds.
Pull your heels up into the sofa as your hands lift, so the backs of your thighs hold you.
Lift your hands only a few centimetres, so each set-down stays soft.

393.cue: Lower to your fingertips, one small push, pull back up. Count out loud, breathe steadily.
how: Kneel on a folded towel, heels hooked under a heavy sofa that cannot tip or slide.
Kneel tall in a straight line from knees to head, hands up in front of your chest.
Lower forward for 3 s or more as one straight piece until your fingertips touch the floor.
Give one small push with your fingertips, then pull up with the backs of your thighs.
Breathe steadily. Each trip down and back up counts as one, counted out loud.
393.name: Nordic curl, fingertip push
393.setup: Heels under a heavy sofa, never a chair; hands ready to catch.
393.stop: Stop when you need your whole hands to come up or you bend at the hips.
tips: Push with your fingertips only, never your whole hands.
Pull your heels up hard into the sofa to start the way back.
Push a little less each week; the full Nordic needs no push at all.

394.cue: Straight down toward the inner hand, which does the work. Count out loud, breathe out up.
how: Place one hand flat under the middle of your chest, fingers pointing forward.
Set the other hand two hand-lengths out from your side, fingers turned out a little.
Step back onto your toes, feet hip-width apart, body straight from heels to head.
Lower your chest straight down toward the inner hand, then push back up.
Count each rep out loud; every rep on one side, then press Switch sides and swap hands.
394.name: Staggered push-up
394.setup: On the floor; one hand under your chest, the other two hand-lengths out from your side.
394.stop: Stop when your hips twist or you drift to the outer hand. Count the weaker side.
tips: The inner hand does most of the push; the outer hand only steadies you.
Go straight down, never sideways toward the outer hand.
Too hard? Move the outer hand a little closer to your side.

395.cue: Down over the working hand, towel hand sliding out. Count out loud, breathe out up.
how: Fold a small towel under one hand; on carpet, put that hand on a hardcover book.
Set the other hand under your chest and walk your feet back and wide, body straight.
Lower your chest slowly toward the working hand as the towel hand slides out.
Breathe out and push straight up with the working arm, the towel hand sliding back in.
Count each rep out loud; every rep on one arm, then press Switch sides and swap arms.
395.name: Sliding one-arm push-up
395.setup: A hard floor, a small towel under the helping hand (on carpet, a hardcover book).
395.stop: Stop when your hips twist or the towel hand starts to push. Count the weaker side.
tips: The towel hand only steadies you: the less it presses, the harder the rep.
Spread your feet wider than your hips so your body does not twist.
Keep the working elbow close to your side, pointing back toward your hip.

396.cue: Feet on the wall at hip height, hips over your hands, arms by your ears. Count out loud.
how: Sit with your back against the wall, legs straight, and note where your heels are.
Kneel facing away from the wall, set your hands flat on that spot and lift your hips.
Walk one foot up the wall to the height of your hips, then the other.
Push the floor away, hips over your hands, arms straight by your ears, and breathe.
The clock counts up: hold until your arms tire, then walk your feet down one at a time.
396.name: L-hold at the wall
396.setup: A clear 2 by 2 m floor and a bare wall, never beside the desk. Warm your wrists first.
396.stop: Come down when your arms bend or your shoulders sink.
tips: Hips behind your hands? Walk your hands a little closer to the wall.
Push your shoulders up toward your ears so your chest does not sink.
Keep your legs straight and level, the soles of your feet flat on the wall.

397.cue: Kick up softly, both heels to the wall, hold for three, turn out. Count out loud.
how: Face the wall and set your hands flat a forearm's length from it, shoulder-width apart.
Kick one leg up and push off the other, so both heels reach the wall softly.
Push tall through straight arms and hold for a slow count of three.
Shift onto one hand, step the other hand round and turn sideways, feet down one by one.
Each soft kick-up that ends in a turn-out counts as one, counted out loud.
397.name: Kick-up to the wall, turn out
397.setup: A clear 2 by 2 m floor by a bare wall, never beside the desk. Warm your wrists first.
397.stop: Stop when your heels bang the wall or your arms bend.
tips: Kick softly: your heels should touch the wall, never bang it.
Keep your arms locked straight the whole time, also while you turn.
Turn out to a different side each time, so both ways feel easy.

398.cue: From bent arms, chin over the bar, back to a right angle. Count out loud, breathe out up.
how: Set a stool under a firmly fixed bar so you grip it with your elbows at a right angle.
Grip with palms facing away, hands a little wider than your shoulders, and lift your feet.
Pull your chin over the bar, breathing out.
Lower until your elbows are at a right angle, upper arms level, then pull again.
Each chin over the bar counts as one; step back onto the stool when you are done.
398.name: Half pull-up
398.setup: A bar fixed firmly; a stool so you start with your elbows at a right angle.
398.stop: Stop when your chin no longer clears the bar or you kick.
tips: Stop each lowering at the right angle: going lower makes it a full pull-up.
Keep your legs still and together: a kick or a swing does not count.
Pull your shoulders down before each pull, away from your ears.

399.cue: Pull with the bar hand; the towel hand only helps. Count out loud, breathe out up.
how: Check the bar is fixed firmly and hang a towel over it a little out from one hand.
Grip the bar with one hand, both towel ends with the other, that fist at forehead height.
From straight arms, pull your chin over the bar, the bar hand doing most of the work.
Lower to straight arms, breathing in.
Each pull counts as one. Do every rep on one side, then press Switch sides.
399.name: Uneven towel pull-up
399.setup: A bar fixed firmly; a hand towel hung over it beside one hand. A stool to step down on.
399.stop: Stop when the towel hand does most of the pull or you twist. Count the weaker side.
tips: Hold the towel at the same place each time so your record stays fair.
Keep your chest facing the bar; do not turn toward the bar hand.
Squeeze your legs together and brace your belly so you do not swing.

40.cue: Lower halfway, hold 2 seconds, then lower slowly. Count out loud.
how: Kneel on a folded towel, heels hooked under a heavy sofa that cannot tip or slide.
Kneel tall in a straight line from knees to head, hands up in front of your chest.
Lower slowly to halfway, hold still for 2 s, then keep lowering as slowly as you can.
Breathe steadily through the hold, then catch on your hands and push back to kneeling.
Each lowering with its hold counts as one, counted out loud.
40.name: Nordic with a hold
40.setup: Heels under a heavy sofa, never a chair; hands ready to catch.
40.stop: Stop when you cannot hold or you bend at the hips.
tips: Squeeze your seat and belly so your hips stay straight through the hold.
Pull your heels up into the sofa to feel the backs of your thighs hold you.
Count the 2 s out loud, which keeps you breathing through the hold.

400.cue: Chin over the bar on one arm, elbow tight, legs still. Count out loud, breathe.
how: Check the bar is fixed firmly and set a stool high enough to get your chin over the bar.
Step up, grip with both hands, palms toward you, and bring your chin over the bar.
Pull your shoulders down, then let go with one hand and lift your feet.
Hold your chin over the bar, elbow tight to your ribs, breathing slowly.
The clock counts up: step down when your chin sinks, then press Switch sides.
400.name: One-arm lock-off
400.setup: A bar fixed firmly; a stool high enough to get your chin over the bar.
400.stop: Stop when your chin sinks below the bar or you start to spin. Count the weaker side.
tips: Squeeze your legs together and brace your belly so your body does not spin.
Keep the free hand near the bar, ready to grab it.
Step down before your elbow opens; never drop into a hang on one arm.

401.cue: Feet a foot back, pull your chest to the towel on one arm. Count out loud, breathe out up.
how: Lay the towel over the door's top, its end knot on the far side; shut and lock the door.
Pull the towel hard once: the door must not move.
Toes one foot's length from the door, hold the free end, and lean back on a straight arm.
Pull your chest up to your hand, breathing out, then lower with control.
Keep your hips square; do every rep on one side, then press Switch sides.
401.name: One-arm towel row, feet back
401.setup: A knotted towel over the top of a solid door you push to open; toes a foot's length back.
401.stop: Stop when your hips twist or the door moves. Count the weaker side.
tips: Measure the gap once with your own foot and stand there every time.
Spread your feet a little wider than your hips to stop the twist.
Start each pull with the shoulder blade, then bend the elbow.

402.cue: Arms straight, knees to chest, back halfway to level. Count out loud, breathe.
how: Check the bar or rings are fixed firmly and set a stool below to step down on.
Hang with straight arms, palms facing away, and pull your shoulders down.
Tuck your knees up to your chest.
Press the bar toward your hips with straight arms until your back is halfway to level.
Hold there and breathe slowly; the clock counts until your arms bend or you sink back.
402.name: Tuck lean-back hang
402.setup: A fixed bar or rings; a stool to step down on.
402.stop: Stop when your arms bend or your shoulders shrug.
tips: Halfway: your back slants between hanging straight down and flat, not yet level.
Keep your knees tight to your chest; a tight tuck is easier to hold.
Think of pushing the bar down to your hips, not of pulling yourself up.

403.cue: Push up fast from the knees, clap once, land on soft elbows. Count out loud, breathe out.
how: Kneel on the towel, hands under your shoulders, body straight from knees to head.
Lower your chest to about a fist above the floor.
Breathe out and push up as hard and fast as you can, so your hands lift off.
Clap your hands under your chest, then put them back under your shoulders.
Land with bending elbows. Each clap with a clean landing counts as one, out loud.
403.name: Clap push-up on the knees
403.setup: On a floor that does not slip, a folded towel under your knees.
403.stop: Stop when your hips sag or you land on straight arms.
tips: Keep your hips in line with your knees and shoulders; do not bend at the hips.
Clap small and quick, close to the floor, so your hands are back in time.
Spread your fingers and let your arms bend to take the landing.

404.cue: Jump to the top, then lower through the turn slowly, elbows together. Count out loud.
404.hint: Slow down through the turn if the front of your shoulders feels tight.
how: Use a fixed bar with room above it, never a doorway bar, and a sturdy box below it.
Stand on the box, the bar at about chest height, and grip it shoulder-width, palms away.
Jump and press to straight arms on top of the bar, hips at the bar.
Lower your chest to the bar, lean back and turn both elbows under it together.
Take 5 s or more until your feet are on the box. Each slow lowering counts one, out loud.
404.name: Muscle-up lowering
404.setup: A fixed bar with room above it, never a doorway bar; a sturdy box under it.
404.stop: Stop when you drop through the turn or one elbow turns under first.
tips: Go slowest through the turn: that is the part the muscle-up needs.
Keep the bar close to your body all the way down, as if pulling it to your waist.
Breathe out as you lower; jump only as high as you need to reach the top.

405.cue: On top of the bar, lower to the bar in about 5 seconds, then step down. Count out loud.
405.hint: Lower only as far as your shoulders feel comfortable.
how: Use a fixed bar at about chest height, never a doorway bar, with a box beside it.
Grip the bar shoulder-width, palms down, step up and press to locked arms on top of it.
Lean your chest a little forward, legs a little ahead, and bend your elbows back.
Lower over five slow beats, about 5 s, until your chest nears the bar, breathing out.
Step down to the box and step up again. Each slow lowering counts one, out loud.
405.name: Straight-bar dip, lowering only
405.setup: A fixed bar at chest height, never a doorway bar; a box to step up on.
405.stop: Stop when you drop instead of lowering or the front of a shoulder pinches.
tips: Keep your elbows pointing back, close to your sides, not flaring out.
Keep your shoulders pushed down, away from your ears, all the way down.
Get back to the top with your feet on the box, never with a jump.

406.cue: Legs wide and straight, lower in 3 seconds, lift back up. Count out loud, breathe.
406.hint: Open your legs only as wide as your hips allow, both legs straight.
how: Lie on your back, head near a heavy sofa or bed, and grip its frame behind your head.
Tuck up onto your upper back, push your legs straight up and open them wide.
Lower that wide, straight body slowly until your heels are just above the floor.
Breathe out, pull on the frame and lift it back up, legs still wide and straight.
Each lowering and lift counts as one, counted out loud.
406.name: Straddle dragon flag
406.setup: Lie by a heavy sofa or bed and grip its frame behind your head. Never a desk or chair.
406.stop: Stop when your hips bend, your lower back arches or your neck takes the weight.
tips: Squeeze your seat so your hips stay open, and keep your legs as wide on every rep.
Rest your weight on your upper back and shoulders, never on your head.
Pull hard on the frame to start the lift; do not kick or fold to get up.

407.cue: Tail tucked, roll to the wall, pull back to standing, knees straight. Count out loud.
how: Lie once with your heels at the wall, arms past your head, and mark at your fingertips.
Stand with your toes on that mark, face the wall and set the wheel down by your toes.
Roll out slowly until the wheel touches the wall, arms straight, body in line.
Breathe out, press the wheel down and pull it back to your feet, knees straight.
Each roll to the wall and back to your feet counts as one, counted out loud.
407.name: Standing rollout to the wall
407.setup: A wheel and a wall, your toes a full stretch from it, clear floor between.
407.stop: Stop when your lower back sags or you cannot pull back; set your knees down.
tips: Tuck your tail under and pull your ribs down before the wheel moves.
Keep your toes on the mark every time, so each roll is the same move.
If you cannot pull back, set your knees down and roll in from there.

408.cue: Press the thigh down, lift your hips, bottom leg hanging free. Count out loud.
how: Lie on your side on the floor beside a bed or sofa that stays put when you push it.
Lay your top leg across it so the edge sits under the middle of your thigh.
Put your elbow on the floor right under your shoulder, bottom leg along the floor.
Press the thigh down into the edge and lift your hips into a straight line.
Count out loud; when this side ends, press Switch sides, then turn round.
408.name: Copenhagen, thigh on the bed
408.setup: Top thigh over the edge of a bed or sofa, forearm on the floor.
408.stop: Stop when your hips drop or your inner thigh hurts. Count the weaker side.
tips: Press your top thigh down into the edge, since that is what lifts your hips.
Let the bottom leg hang free; a foot on the floor takes the work away.
Keep the edge at the middle of your thigh every time, so each hold is the same move.

409.cue: Low arm locked and pushing, high arm pulling, legs to the sky. Count out loud, breathe.
how: Use only a steel pole fixed in the ground that does not flex or turn, on soft ground.
Stand side-on: far hand above your head, near hand lower, a bit wider than your shoulders.
Lock the low arm and push, pull with the high arm and kick your legs up beside the pole.
Hold your body straight up beside the pole, legs together to the sky, low arm locked.
The clock counts up: come down feet first when an arm bends, then press Switch sides.
409.name: Vertical flag
409.setup: A steel pole fixed in the ground outdoors that does not turn; soft ground under you.
409.stop: Come down feet first when an arm bends or your legs tip over. Count the weaker side.
tips: Push the low hand into the pole as hard as the high hand pulls.
Squeeze your legs together and point your toes at the sky.
Come down one foot at a time, never by letting go at the top.

41.cue: Push through one heel, hips up level. Count out loud, breathe out as you lift.
how: Sit on the floor with your upper back on the sofa edge or a chair pushed back to a wall.
Plant one foot flat, the other leg out straight, any backpack resting on your hips.
Push through the flat heel until your knee, hips and shoulders form one level line.
Breathe out as you lift, pause at the top, then breathe in as you lower slowly.
Each lift to the level line counts one; one side, press Switch sides, then the other.

dumbbells: Sit on the floor with your upper back on the sofa edge or a chair pushed back to a wall.
Plant one foot flat, the other leg out straight, the dumbbell across your hips.
Push through the flat heel until your knee, hips and shoulders form one level line.
Breathe out as you lift, pause at the top, then breathe in as you lower slowly.
Each lift to the level line counts one; one side, press Switch sides, then the other.
kettlebell: Sit on the floor with your upper back on the sofa edge or a chair pushed back to a wall.
Plant one foot flat, the other leg out straight, the bell held on your hips by its horns.
Push through the flat heel until your knee, hips and shoulders form one level line.
Breathe out as you lift, pause at the top, then breathe in as you lower slowly.
Each lift to the level line counts one; one side, press Switch sides, then the other.

41.name: Single-leg hip thrust
41.setup: Shoulders on a sofa or a chair without wheels; a 5-10 kg pack on hips if you have one.

setups.dumbbells: Shoulders on a sofa or a chair without wheels; a 5-10 kg dumbbell on your hips.
setups.kettlebell: Shoulders on a sofa or a chair without wheels; a 5-10 kg kettlebell on your hips.

41.stop: Stop when your hips tilt or your back arches. Count the weaker side.
tips: Keep your chin tucked and your eyes on your knee so your ribs stay down.
Place the foot so your shin is upright at the top of the lift.
Have a backpack? Load it to 5-10 kg: a 1-L water bottle or a hardback is about 1 kg.

410.cue: Tuck V-sit, then one leg straight up to the ceiling, arms locked. Count out loud.
how: Warm your wrists, then sit on the floor, palms flat beside your hips, fingers out or back.
Lock your arms, push the floor away and lift into the tuck V-sit, hips past your hands.
Push one leg straight up toward the ceiling, the other knee still tucked to your chest.
Lean your shoulders back, keep both arms locked and breathe slowly.
The clock counts up: hold until the leg drops, then press Switch sides for the other leg.
410.name: One-leg V-sit
410.setup: A clear floor; palms flat beside your hips. Warm your wrists first.
410.stop: Stop when the straight leg drops or your arms bend. Count the weaker side.
tips: Think of lifting your hips, not your foot: the leg follows the hips up.
Squeeze the straight thigh and point your toes so the knee stays locked.
Keep your shoulders pushed down; do not let them shrug up.

411.cue: Step wide, land on one foot and hold. Each landing counts one. Breathe in rhythm.
how: Clear about a metre to each side and stand on one foot, knee bent, chest forward.
Step wide to the side and land on the other foot, sinking into that knee.
Sweep the free foot behind the landing ankle and touch its toes down lightly.
Hold the landing for a moment, then step straight back the other way.
Each landing counts one: go as fast as steady landings allow, too fast to talk.
411.name: Skater steps
411.setup: A clear step to each side, a floor that does not slip.
411.stop: Stop if a knee caves in or your landings wobble.
tips: Keep the landing knee over your toes, never caving in.
Never hop: one foot stays on the floor until the other lands.
Keep your chest over the landing knee rather than letting it tip to the outside.

412.cue: Back shin up the sofa, chest tall, squeeze your seat. Breathe slowly.
how: Kneel with your back to the bed or sofa, one knee on the towel close to its base.
Slide that shin up the front of the bed or sofa, the top of the foot resting on it.
Step the other foot forward into a lunge, knee over the ankle, hands on that knee.
Lift your chest until your body is upright, hands on your hips, and squeeze your seat.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
412.name: Couch stretch
412.setup: A bed or sofa behind you, a folded towel at its base for your knee.
412.stop: Ease off if your knee hurts or the front of your thigh cramps; never bounce.
tips: Stay leaning forward, hands on the front knee, until upright feels easy.
Move the knee a little away from the bed or sofa if the stretch is too strong.
Tuck your tailbone and keep your ribs down so your low back does not arch.

413.cue: Kneecaps forward, slide out slowly, hands take your weight. Breathe slowly.
how: Stand with your feet wide and your hands on the books in front of you.
Slide your feet out to the sides, knees straight, kneecaps facing forward.
Lower your hips slowly, your hands taking your weight.
Stop with your hips about a hand from the floor and breathe slowly.
To come out, lean on your hands, bend your knees and walk your feet in.
413.name: Middle split prep
413.setup: 2 m of clear floor to the sides, two books for your hands.
413.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or if the inside of a knee hurts; never bounce.
tips: A hand is about the short side of a sheet of printer paper.
Keep your weight in your hands so you can rise at any moment.
Slide down slowly and never drop or bounce into the split.

414.cue: Hands on the books by your ears, press up, arms straight, hips up. Breathe slowly.
how: Set two stacks of books, about 15 cm high, flat against the wall, shoulder-width apart.
Lie on your back, head toward the wall, knees bent and feet flat, hip-width apart.
Reach back and set your hands on the books by your ears, fingers pointing to your feet.
Lift your hips and press your arms straight, head free of the floor, and breathe slowly.
Tuck your chin and lower slowly, upper back first, at the end of the hold.
414.name: Wheel, hands on books
414.setup: A clear 2 x 2 m floor and two stacks of books, 15 cm high, flat against a wall.
414.stop: Come down slowly, chin tucked, if your arms shake or your low back pinches.
tips: Keep the books pressed against the wall so they cannot slide.
Press the books away through your hands to open your shoulders.
Once your arms lock easily here, the wheel on the floor is the next step.

415.cue: Lean back, walk your hands down the wall to hip height and up. Breathe slowly.
how: Stand with your back to the wall, a long step away, feet hip-width apart.
Raise your arms, lean back and put your palms on the wall, fingers pointing down.
Walk your hands down the wall to the height of your hips, chest lifting, hips forward.
Walk your hands back up the wall the same way until you stand tall.
Go down and up five times at an easy pace, breathing slowly.
415.name: Wall walk to hip height
415.setup: A clear 2 x 2 m floor and a wall behind you, a long step away.
415.stop: Stop and walk back up if your arms shake or your low back pinches.
tips: Walk your hands in small steps and keep your hips pressing forward.
Stop higher on the wall at first and go a little lower each day.
Walk back up as soon as your arms start to tire.

416.cue: Hips forward, arch back to the edge, rise chest first. Breathe slowly.
how: Stand with your back to the bed or sofa, heels a forearm's length from its edge.
Lift your chest, press your hips forward and raise your arms over your head.
Arch back slowly, eyes on the bed, and set both hands on its edge.
Press your hips forward, lift your chest and rise to standing without a hard push.
Go down and up five times, breathing slowly.
416.name: Drop back to the bed
416.setup: A bed or sofa that cannot slide behind you, heels a forearm's length from its edge.
416.stop: Stop and sit on the bed if your low back pinches.
tips: Keep your hips pressing forward on the way down so your hands land, not your seat.
Stand a little closer to the edge at first, then step away as it gets easy.
Push through your legs to rise, chest leading, never with a jerk of the head.

417.cue: Hips square, knees straight, palm on the books, turn. Breathe out to turn.
how: Step one foot back a leg-length, back toes turned out a little, hips facing forward.
Reach the arm on the back-leg side forward and hinge over the front leg, back flat.
Put that palm flat on the books just outside the front foot.
Breathe out and turn your chest open, top arm reaching straight up.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
417.name: Twisted triangle on books
417.setup: Clear floor, feet a leg-length apart, books 15 cm high by your front foot.
417.stop: Ease off if your back pinches; never pull to turn further.
tips: Draw the front hip back so your hips stay level as you turn.
Step the back foot in a little if you wobble, hips still facing forward.
Look down at the books if looking up bothers your neck.

418.cue: Long lunge, palms together, elbow outside the front knee. Breathe out to turn.
how: Step into a long lunge, front knee over the ankle, back heel up and back knee straight.
Press your palms together at your chest.
Breathe out and turn, hooking the far elbow outside the front knee.
Press your palms together to turn your chest up, and breathe slowly.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
418.name: Lunge prayer twist
418.setup: A long stride of clear floor.
418.stop: Ease off if your back pinches or your front knee hurts; never pull to turn further.
tips: Drop the back knee to the floor while you find the hook, then lift it again.
Keep the front knee over the ankle, not drifting in toward the elbow.
Grow tall on each breath in and turn a little on each breath out.

419.cue: Feet close, heels down, knees over the toes, arms forward. Breathe slowly.
how: Stand with your feet a fist apart and your toes pointing straight ahead.
Sit your hips down until your thighs are below level, heels flat on the floor.
Let your knees travel forward over your toes and reach your arms forward.
Keep your chest up and your heels down, and breathe slowly.
Put your hands on the floor and stand up slowly at the end of the hold.
419.name: Narrow deep squat
419.setup: Clear floor, feet a fist apart, toes pointing straight ahead.
419.stop: Ease off at a pinch at the front of the ankle or if a knee hurts; never bounce.
tips: Start with your feet a little wider and bring them closer over the days.
Put a rolled towel under your heels if they lift; the goal pose needs them on the floor.
Keep your knees pointing the same way as your toes.

42.cue: Arms straight, let your chest sink, then push the desk away. Breathe out as you push.
how: Check the desk cannot slide, then grip its edge with your hands shoulder-width apart.
Walk your feet back and lean in, straight from heels to head, arms fully straight.
With straight elbows, let your chest sink so your shoulder blades squeeze together.
Breathe out and push the desk away so your upper back rounds and the blades spread.
Count one rep each time you reach the top of the push.
42.name: Scapular push-up plus
42.setup: Hands on the desk edge; the desk must not move.
tips: The move is only a few centimetres, so go slowly and feel both end points.
Keep your hips and belly still so the movement comes only from your shoulder blades.
Keep your neck long and your eyes on the desk, with no dropping of the head.

420.cue: Heels down, turn to the wall, armpit outside the knees, hands on the wall. Breathe out.
how: Stand side-on to a wall, feet together, a forearm's length from it.
Squat with your feet and knees together and your heels flat.
Breathe out, turn to the wall and bring the arm away from it outside both knees.
Put both hands flat on the wall, that hand low and the other high, and breathe slowly.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
420.name: Squat twist at the wall
420.setup: Clear floor, side-on to a wall, feet together a forearm's length from it.
420.stop: Ease off at a pinch at the front of the ankle, in a knee or in your back.
tips: Put a rolled towel under your heels if they lift; the goal pose needs them on the floor.
Turn a little more on each breath out, never by pushing hard on the wall.
To switch sides, turn round so the wall is on your other side.

421.cue: Hands on the wall, back leg up, one level line. Breathe slowly.
how: Stand facing the wall, a little more than an arm's length from it.
Hinge forward from the hips and put your palms on the wall at hip height.
Shift onto one foot and lift the other leg behind you until body and leg are level.
Keep the standing leg straight and the hips level, and breathe slowly.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
421.name: Warrior III at the wall
421.setup: Face a wall, a little more than an arm's length from it.
421.stop: Put the foot down when you sway or your back pinches.
tips: Step a little closer or further until your arms, body and back leg make one line.
Point the back toes at the floor so your hips stay level.
Press the wall lightly so your legs and your back do the holding.

422.cue: Heel on the desk, both legs straight, stand tall. Breathe slowly.
how: Stand facing the desk, about a leg's length away, hands on your hips.
Lift one leg and rest its heel on the desk, the leg straight and the toes up.
Stand tall on a straight standing leg, both hips level and facing the desk.
Breathe slowly and let the back of the raised leg lengthen.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
422.name: Heel on the desk
422.setup: Face the desk, about a leg's length from it.
422.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or any tingling down the leg; put the foot down if you sway.
tips: Put the heel on a bed's edge or a stair until the leg will straighten on the desk.
Keep your chest lifted, not folded over the leg.
Fix your eyes on one still spot ahead to steady your balance.

423.cue: Knees on upper arms, lean forward, lift one foot. Breathe slowly.
how: Start in crow prep: hands flat, shins high on your upper arms, heels up.
Lean forward until your toes grow light.
Lift one foot and draw its heel toward your seat, the other toes resting lightly.
Hold with your eyes ahead of your hands and breathe slowly.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
423.name: Crow, one foot up
423.setup: A pillow on the floor in front of your hands in case you tip forward.
423.stop: Come down at once if a wrist or an elbow hurts.
tips: Lean only as far as you can press back with the foot still down.
Squeeze your knees into your arms so they stay put.
Look forward at the floor, not down at your hands.

424.cue: Front leg over the arm, lean, lift the front foot, back toes down. Breathe slowly.
how: Start in a lunge with your hands flat on the floor inside the front foot.
Slide the front shoulder under the front thigh, close to the knee.
Bend your elbows, lean forward and walk the front foot out until it lifts, leg straight.
Keep the back toes on the floor and the back leg straight, and breathe slowly.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
424.name: Flying splits, back toes down
424.setup: A pillow on the floor in front of your hands in case you tip forward.
424.stop: Come down at once if a wrist, an elbow or a hip hurts.
tips: Lean forward only as far as you can press back up.
Reach out through the front heel so the front knee stays straight.
Keep the back knee off the floor and the back toes light.

425.cue: Knees on your bent arms, lean until both feet float off the books. Count out loud.
how: Stack books about 12 cm high where your feet will go, the pillow in front of your hands.
Set your palms flat, shoulder-width apart, fingers spread, and bend your elbows a little.
Toes on the books, rest your knees on the backs of your upper arms, just above the elbows.
Lean forward until both feet float off the books, then breathe slowly.
The clock counts up once both feet are up; when the balance goes, feet back on the books.
425.name: Frog stand from books
425.setup: Toes on a stack of books 12 cm high, a pillow in front of your hands.
425.stop: Come down to the books at once if a wrist or an elbow hurts.
tips: Lift off the books, never push off them: they only start you higher.
Look at the floor a little ahead of your hands, not back at your feet.
Press your fingertips down to stop a tip forward.

426.cue: Knees on upper arms, lean forward, lift both feet off the books. Breathe slowly.
how: Stack books about 12 cm high where your feet will go, the pillow in front of your hands.
Start in crow prep with your toes on the books: hands flat, shins high on your upper arms.
Lean forward until your toes grow light on the books.
Lift one foot, then the other, and hold with your eyes ahead of your hands.
Breathe slowly, then set your feet back on the books at the end of the hold.
426.name: Crow from books
426.setup: Toes on a stack of books 12 cm high, a pillow in front of your hands.
426.stop: Come down to the books at once if a wrist or an elbow hurts.
tips: Lift off the books, never push off them: they only start you higher.
Squeeze your knees into your arms so they stay put.
Look forward at the floor, not down at your hands.

427.cue: On the books, hands up for 2 seconds, body straight. Count out loud, breathe steadily.
how: Kneel on a folded towel, heels hooked under a heavy sofa that cannot tip or slide.
Stack flat books 15-20 cm high where your hands will land; press on them so they stay put.
Lower forward as one straight piece and catch yourself on the books, arms straight.
Lift both hands a few centimetres off the books for 2 s, keeping your body straight.
Set them down softly; each lift counts one. After the last, push back to kneeling tall.
427.name: Nordic hover, hands on books
427.setup: Heels under a heavy sofa, never a chair; a towel under your knees; books 15-20 cm high.
427.stop: Stop when you cannot hold 2 seconds or your hips bend.
tips: Squeeze your seat and belly so the line from knees to head never folds.
Pull your heels up into the sofa as your hands lift, so the backs of your thighs hold you.
Lift your hands only a few centimetres, so each set-down stays soft.

428.cue: Lower and push up on one arm, hips level. Count out loud, breathe out as you push.
how: Start in a push-up on the floor, feet hip-width apart, body straight from heels to head.
Put one hand under the middle of your chest and rest the other on your lower back.
Lower your chest towards the floor, hips and shoulders level.
Breathe out and push the floor away until your arm is straight.
Each push-up is one. One arm, press Switch sides, the other; type the weaker arm's count.
428.name: One-arm push-up, feet hip-width
428.setup: On the floor, feet hip-width; one hand under your chest, the other behind your back.
428.stop: Stop when your hips twist or sag. Count the weaker side.
tips: Lean your weight a little over the working hand before you bend the elbow.
Brace your belly and seat hard before each rep so your hips cannot turn open.
Keep the elbow close to your ribs and grip the floor with spread fingers.

429.cue: On top of the bar, arms locked, shoulders down. Count out loud, breathe slowly.
429.hint: Press your shoulders down, away from your ears, and keep your chest open.
how: Use a fixed bar at about chest height, never a doorway bar, with a box beside it.
Grip the bar shoulder-width, palms down, step up and press to locked arms on top of it.
Push the bar down so your shoulders stay low, away from your ears, hips against the bar.
Hold still with your legs a little ahead and breathe slowly.
The clock counts up: hold until your arms bend or your shoulders creep up, then step down.
429.name: Straight-bar support hold
429.setup: A fixed bar at chest height, never a doorway bar; a box to step up on.
429.stop: Stop when your elbows bend, your shoulders shrug or the front of a shoulder pinches.
tips: Keep your elbows locked and pointing back, close to your sides.
Lean your chest a little forward so your weight stays over your hands.
Step down to the box at the end; never drop back off the bar.

43.cue: Body straight, chest to the edge. Breathe out as you push.
how: Check the desk cannot slide, then grip its edge with your hands shoulder-width apart.
Walk your feet back until your body forms a straight line from heels to head.
Bend your elbows and lower your chest to the desk edge.
Breathe out as you push the desk away until your arms are straight.
Count one rep each time your arms are straight again.
43.name: Desk push-up
43.setup: Hands on the desk edge; the desk must not move.
43.stop: Stop when your hips sag or your elbows flare.
tips: Aim your chest at the edge, not your chin or belly, so your body stays in one line.
Tuck your elbows so they point back towards your hips, not out to the sides.
Brace your belly and squeeze your seat before each rep so your hips stay in line.

430.cue: Knees bent, feet flat, pull your chest to the edge. Count out loud, breathe out up.
how: Lean on the edge, then pull gently: if the table lifts, slides or creaks, stop.
Lie under it, chest below the edge, and grip it a little wider than your shoulders.
Bend your knees, feet flat, and lift your hips so knees, hips and head make one line.
Pull your chest to the edge, then lower until your arms are fully straight.
Your upper back nears the floor; keep your hips up and pull again. Count out loud.
430.name: Table row, knees bent
430.setup: A heavy table on four legs; never glass, folding, a standing desk or one with monitors.
430.stop: Stop when your hips sag or the table moves.
tips: Squeeze your bottom and belly so your hips rise with your chest, not after it.
Drive your elbows down towards the floor and squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
Keep your neck long, chin slightly tucked, eyes on the underside of the table.

431.cue: Back level, hips open, both knees bent to a right angle. Count out loud, breathe steadily.
how: Check the bar or rings are fixed firmly and set a stool below to step down on.
Hang with straight arms, palms facing away, and pull your shoulders down.
Tuck and lean back to a level back, then open your hips until your thighs line up with it.
Keep both knees bent to a right angle, arms locked, and breathe slowly.
The clock counts up: hold until your hips sink, then tuck and step down.
431.name: Front lever, half lay
431.setup: A fixed bar or rings; a stool to step down on.
431.stop: Stop when your hips drop or your arms bend.
tips: Squeeze your seat so your hips stay open, in line with your back.
Press the bar down towards your hips with locked elbows.
Keep your head in line with your body, not tucked to look at your feet.

432.cue: Push with your feet to the edge, lower in 3 seconds. Count out loud, breathe out down.
how: Lean on the edge, then pull gently: if the table lifts, slides or creaks, stop.
Lie under it, grip the edge a little wider than your shoulders, knees bent, feet flat.
Push through your feet and pull until your chest reaches the edge.
Lower on your arms over three slow beats, hips up, until your arms are straight.
Rest your hips on the floor, then go again. Count each slow lowering out loud.
432.name: Table row lowering, knees bent
432.setup: A heavy table on four legs; never glass, folding, a standing desk or one with monitors.
432.stop: Stop when you drop fast or the table moves.
tips: Make the last part of the lowering as slow as the first, since it is the hardest part.
Keep your knees, hips and head in one line all the way down.
Keep your neck long, chin slightly tucked, eyes on the underside of the table.

433.cue: Heel down, toes up, hinge forward and reach for your toes. Breathe slowly.
how: Sit near the front edge of your chair with both feet flat.
Slide one foot forward until that leg is straight, heel down and toes up.
Hinge from your hips, then let your back round as your hands slide down the leg.
Reach past the ankle for your toes with the knee straight, then breathe slowly.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
433.name: Chair toe reach
433.setup: Sit near the front edge of your chair, feet flat.
433.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or any tingling down the leg; never bounce.
tips: Lead with your chest, not your head, so the stretch stays behind the thigh.
Keep both sit bones on the chair and the other foot flat.
Stop at the ankle on a tight day; the toes come with time.

434.cue: Legs straight and together, sit tall, hands off the bed. Breathe slowly.
how: Sit on your bed with your seat and back against the wall or the headboard.
Stretch both legs out straight in front of you, feet together, toes up.
Press the backs of your knees down and sit tall, head against the wall.
Lift your hands off the bed and reach them along your legs, breathing slowly.
Stay for the time shown, then bend your knees and relax.
434.name: Staff pose on the bed
434.setup: Sit on your bed with your back against the wall or the headboard.
434.stop: Ease off at a strong pull behind the knees or any tingling down the legs.
tips: Rest your hands beside your hips until sitting tall gets easy.
Keep your low back against the wall instead of rounding it.
Bend your knees a little at first, then straighten them a bit more each day.

435.cue: Legs straight, fold from the hips, hold your soles. Breathe slowly.
how: Sit on your bed with both legs straight out in front of you, feet together.
Sit tall, then fold forward from your hips with a long back.
Slide your hands down your legs towards your feet.
Hold your soles with your knees straight, then breathe slowly.
Stay for the time shown, then walk your hands back and sit up slowly.
435.name: Seated fold on the bed
435.setup: Sit on your bed with your legs out straight in front of you.
435.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or any tingling down the legs; never bounce.
tips: Sit on a folded towel if your back rounds before you can lean forward.
Lead with your chest, not your head, so the fold comes from the hips.
Hold your ankles or shins until your hands reach the soles.

436.cue: Legs straight, fold until your forehead meets your knees. Breathe slowly.
how: Sit on your bed with both legs straight out in front of you, feet together.
Hold your soles and lengthen your back as you breathe in.
As you breathe out, fold from the hips and lower your chest towards your thighs.
Bring your forehead to your knees with your knees straight, breathing slowly.
Stay for the time shown, then sit up slowly.
436.name: Chest to knees on the bed
436.setup: Sit on your bed with your legs out straight in front of you.
436.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or any tingling down the legs; never bounce.
tips: Fold from the hips first, then let your back round.
Bend your knees a little first, bring your forehead down, then straighten them.
Relax your shoulders and neck in the fold.

437.cue: Legs straight, fold flat, face down to your shins. Breathe slowly.
how: Sit on your bed with both legs straight out in front of you, feet together.
Hold your soles or wrap your hands around your feet.
Fold from the hips, chest along your thighs, back long.
Let your face come down to your shins, knees straight, and breathe slowly.
Stay for the time shown, then sit up slowly.
437.name: Pike fold on the bed
437.setup: Sit on your bed with your legs out straight in front of you.
437.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or any tingling down the legs; never bounce.
tips: Pull gently with your arms only to help, never to force the fold.
Keep your feet flexed, toes pointing up.
Stay with chest to knees until the deeper fold comes easily.

438.cue: Front leg straight, hips square, chest forward over the front thigh. Breathe slowly.
how: Stand facing your desk, about a long step away, hands on its edge.
Step one foot back, both feet flat, the back toes turned out a little.
Square your hips to the desk and straighten your front leg.
Lean your chest forward over the front thigh with a long back, breathing slowly.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
438.name: Pyramid at the desk
438.setup: Stand facing your desk, about a long step away.
438.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or any tingling down the leg; never bounce.
tips: Shorten your stance if your back heel lifts.
Keep your head up and your back long; the fold comes from the hips.
Slide your hands closer to the desk's edge as the fold gets deeper.

439.cue: Feet wide, knees straight, back long, chest towards the desk. Breathe slowly.
how: Stand facing your desk with your hands on its edge.
Step your feet wide apart, toes pointing forward.
Straighten your knees and walk your feet back until your back is level.
Lower your chest towards the desk with a long back, breathing slowly.
Stay for the time shown, then walk your feet in and stand up slowly.
439.name: Wide-leg stretch at the desk
439.setup: Stand facing your desk, hands on its edge.
439.stop: Ease off at a strong pull inside the thighs or behind the knees.
tips: Widen your stance a little more each week.
Keep your head up so your back stays long.
Press your heels down and lift your kneecaps to keep the knees straight.

44.cue: Knees to head in one line, chest to the floor. Count out loud, breathe out as you push.
how: Kneel on the floor and place your hands flat under your shoulders, fingers forward.
Walk your knees back until your body forms a straight line from knees to head.
Bend your elbows and lower your chest until it is just above the floor.
Breathe out as you push the floor away until your arms are straight.
Count each rep out loud as your arms straighten.
44.name: Knee push-up
44.setup: Knees on a folded towel if the floor is hard, hands under your shoulders.
44.stop: Stop when your hips sag or your elbows flare.
tips: Keep your hips in the line, so they neither sag down nor stick up.
Tuck your elbows so they point back towards your hips, not out to the sides.
Spread your fingers wide and press through the whole hand, not just the heel of it.

440.cue: Front and back shin at right angles, sit tall, hands off. Breathe slowly.
how: Sit on your bed with one shin in front of you, the knee bent to a right angle.
Swing the other leg out to the side and back, that knee also at a right angle.
Both shins rest flat, the front shin across, the back shin pointing back.
Sit tall over your hips, lift your hands off and breathe slowly.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
440.name: 90-90 sit
440.setup: Sit on your bed or the floor.
440.stop: Ease off if a knee or hip hurts.
tips: Lean on your hands behind you until sitting tall gets easy.
Turn your chest towards the front shin to keep your back long.
A cushion under the front hip helps if it lifts.

441.cue: Reach up and back, walk your hands down the wall, hips forward. Breathe slowly.
how: Stand with your back to a wall, heels two foot-lengths away, feet hip-width apart.
Squeeze your seat and push your hips forward a little.
Reach your arms up and back until your hands touch the wall.
Walk your hands a little way down the wall to head height, breathing slowly.
Walk your hands back up and stand tall at the end of the hold.
441.name: Wall lean-back
441.setup: Stand with your back to a wall, two foot-lengths away from it.
441.stop: Stop and stand tall if your low back pinches.
tips: Keep your hips forward so your upper back bends, not only your low back.
Look up at your hands; never let your head drop back hard.
Stand a little closer to the wall if you cannot reach it.

442.cue: Clasp your hands, straighten your arms, lift them away from your back. Breathe slowly.
how: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Reach your hands behind you and clasp your fingers.
Straighten your arms and draw your shoulders back and down.
Lift your hands away from your back, chest open, breathing slowly.
Stay for the time shown, then let your arms down slowly.
442.name: Clasped-hands chest opener
442.setup: Stand tall, hands behind your back.
442.stop: Ease off if the front of a shoulder pinches.
tips: Hold a towel between your hands if they do not meet.
Keep your ribs down so your low back does not arch.
Lift only as high as your shoulders stay down.

443.cue: Curl your shoulders up, ribs towards hips, lower slowly. Breathe out as you curl.
how: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat and hip-width apart.
Cross your arms on your chest, or rest your fingertips at your temples.
Breathe out and curl your head and shoulders up until your shoulder blades lift.
Lower slowly, then breathe in at the bottom.
Each curl up and back down counts as one rep.
443.name: Crunch
443.setup: Lie on the floor, knees bent; fingertips lightly at your temples, never pulling your head.
443.stop: Stop when your neck strains or your lower back hurts.
tips: Never pull on your head; keep a fist of space between your chin and chest.
Think of your ribs sliding down towards your hips, not your chin to your knees.
Not in your first hour out of bed; after a long sit, walk around a few minutes first.

444.cue: Feet off the floor, draw your knees to your chest, lower slowly. Breathe out as you lift.
how: Lie on your back, arms by your sides, palms flat on the floor.
Bend your knees and lift your feet a little off the floor; keep your lower back down.
Breathe out and draw your knees in until they are over your hips.
Lower your feet slowly until they almost touch the floor.
Each lift and lowering counts as one rep.
444.name: Lying knee raise
444.setup: Lie on your back on the floor, palms down by your hips.
444.stop: Stop when your lower back arches off the floor or your legs swing.
tips: Press your lower back into the floor the whole time; that is the work.
Tap your feet down between reps if your back starts to lift.
Move slowly both ways, never a swing.

445.cue: Knees bent, curl your hips up off the floor, lower slowly. Breathe out as you curl.
how: Lie on your back, arms by your sides, palms flat on the floor.
Lift your feet and bend your knees to a right angle, knees over your hips.
Breathe out and curl your hips a little off the floor, knees towards your chest.
Lower your hips slowly until your lower back rests flat again.
Each curl up and back down counts as one rep.
445.name: Reverse crunch
445.setup: Lie on your back on the floor, arms by your sides, palms down.
445.stop: Stop when your legs swing or your lower back arches as you lower.
tips: Lift with your belly, not a kick of the legs; the lift is only a few centimetres.
Keep your knees bent the same amount the whole time.
Press your lower back flat on the floor before each new curl.

446.cue: Roll down slowly, about 3 s, then sit back up any way. Count out loud.
how: Sit on the floor, knees bent, feet flat, arms crossed on your chest.
Tuck your chin a little and round your back as if curling over a ball.
Roll down slowly for a count of three until your shoulders touch the floor.
Sit back up any way: roll to one side and push up if you need to.
Each slow roll down counts as one, counted out loud.
446.name: Sit-up, slow lowering
446.setup: Sit on a clear floor, knees bent, feet flat, arms across your chest.
446.stop: Stop when you drop the last part of the way or your lower back hurts.
tips: Go as slowly as you can the whole way, most of all near the floor.
Feet lifting? Reach your arms forward past your knees.
Breathe out slowly all the way down.

447.cue: Feet hooked, curl up, roll down slowly. Count out loud, breathe out as you rise.
how: Lie on your back, knees bent, toes hooked under the edge of a heavy sofa or bed.
Cross your arms on your chest, or rest your fingertips at your temples.
Breathe out and curl up one part at a time: head, shoulders, then your back.
Sit up tall, then roll down slowly, lower back first.
Each sit-up and roll back down counts as one, counted out loud.
447.name: Sit-up, feet under the sofa
447.setup: Toes under a heavy sofa or bed; hands on your chest, never behind your head.
447.stop: Stop when you yank up with your legs, or your lower back or neck hurts.
tips: Curl up with your belly; never yank yourself up with your feet.
Keep your knees bent, so your belly does the work, not your hips.
Never pull on your head or neck; your hands only rest there.

448.cue: Curl up to sitting, then roll down slowly. Count out loud, breathe out as you rise.
how: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat on the floor and hip-width apart.
Cross your arms on your chest, or rest your fingertips at your temples.
Breathe out and curl up one part at a time: head, shoulders, then your back.
Sit up tall, then roll down slowly, lower back first.
Each sit-up and roll back down counts as one, counted out loud.
448.name: Sit-up
448.setup: A clear floor; feet flat and free, hands on your chest or at your temples.
448.stop: Stop when your feet lift, you jerk up, or your lower back or neck hurts.
tips: Never pull on your head or neck; your hands only rest there.
Feet lifting? Reach your arms forward past your knees until you get stronger.
After a long sit at the desk, walk around for a few minutes first.

449.cue: Knees in, legs up straight, lower them straight and slowly. Count out loud.
how: Lie on your back, legs long and together, palms flat on the floor by your hips.
Breathe out and pull your knees in towards your chest.
Straighten your legs up until they point at the ceiling.
Lower your straight legs slowly, lower back pressed down.
Each lift and lowering counts as one, counted out loud.
449.name: Leg raise, bent up
449.setup: Lie on your back on the floor, legs long, palms down by your hips.
449.stop: Stop when your lower back arches off the floor or your legs drop.
tips: Lower only as far as your lower back stays flat; stop higher if it lifts.
The slow, straight lowering is the work; bending in is the easy part.

45.cue: Body straight, chest to the seat edge. Breathe out as you push.
how: Check the chair sits firm against the wall, then grip the front edge of the seat.
Walk your feet back until your body forms a straight line from heels to head.
Bend your elbows and lower your chest to the seat edge.
Breathe out as you push the seat away until your arms are straight.
Count one rep each time your arms are straight again.
45.name: Low incline push-up
45.setup: Hands on a chair without wheels, its back against the wall.
45.stop: Stop when your hips sag or your elbows flare.
tips: Place your hands near the front corners of the seat, about shoulder-width apart.
Look at the floor just past the seat so your head stays in line with your body.
Tuck your elbows back towards your hips and squeeze your seat on every rep.

450.cue: Sit up as your knees pull in, then lower slowly. Count out loud, breathe out as you tuck.
how: Lie on your back, legs long and together, arms reaching past your head.
Breathe out, sit up and pull your knees to your chest at the same time.
Bring your arms forward to hug your shins, balanced on your seat.
Lower your back and legs together slowly until your heels touch down lightly.
Each tuck in and back out counts as one, counted out loud.
450.name: Tuck-up
450.setup: Lie on your back on a clear floor, legs long, arms past your head.
450.stop: Stop when you jerk up, your legs drop hard, or your lower back hurts.
tips: Press your lower back into the floor before each tuck.
Lead with your chest, not your chin, so your neck stays long.
Move at an even pace, never a swing or a bounce.

451.cue: Legs straight, lift them up, lower slowly. Count out loud, breathe out as you lift.
how: Lie on your back, legs straight and together, hands flat under your seat.
Press your lower back into the floor and lift your heels a little off it.
Breathe out and raise both straight legs until they point at the ceiling.
Lower them slowly, stopping just before your heels touch.
Each lift and lowering counts as one, counted out loud.
451.name: Leg raise
451.setup: Lie on your back on the floor, hands flat under your seat.
451.stop: Stop when your lower back arches off the floor or your legs drop.
tips: Lower only as far as your lower back stays flat; stop higher if it lifts.
Squeeze your legs together and point your toes so your knees stay straight.

452.cue: Lift your chest and one straight leg, reach for that shin, lower. Count out loud, breathe.
how: Lie on your back, legs straight, arms reaching past your head.
Breathe out and lift your chest and one straight leg at the same time.
Reach both hands towards the raised shin, the other leg long on the floor.
Lower slowly, then do the same with the other leg.
A V-up with each leg counts as one, counted out loud.
452.name: One-leg V-up
452.setup: Lie on your back on a clear floor, legs straight, arms past your head.
452.stop: Stop when you jerk up or your lower back hurts. A V-up to each side counts one.
tips: Press the leg on the floor down to keep you steady.
Lead with your chest, not your chin, so your neck stays long.
Lift the leg only as high as it stays straight.

453.cue: Lift legs and chest together, hands to your shins, lower slowly. Count out loud, breathe.
how: Lie on your back, legs straight and together, arms reaching past your head.
Breathe out and lift your legs and chest at the same time, both straight.
Reach your hands towards your shins or toes at the top, balanced on your seat.
Lower your back and legs together slowly until they touch down lightly.
Each fold up and back down counts as one, counted out loud.
453.name: V-up
453.setup: Lie on your back on a clear floor, legs straight, arms past your head.
453.stop: Stop when your knees bend, you jerk up, or your lower back hurts.
tips: Press your lower back into the floor before each lift.
Tight legs? Lift a little lower with your legs straight, or do the one-leg V-up.
Fold up smoothly at an even pace, never a swing or a jerk.

454.cue: Hold the hollow shape, rock from shoulders to seat and back. Count out loud, breathe.
how: Lie on your back on a rug, legs together, arms reaching past your head.
Press your lower back down, then lift your arms, shoulders and legs off the floor.
Hold that curved shape and rock up towards your seat, then back to your shoulders.
Rock at an easy pace, breathing steadily.
Each rock forward and back counts as one, counted out loud.
454.name: Hollow rock
454.setup: Lie on your back on a rug or folded blanket, never on a hard bare floor.
454.stop: Stop when your lower back arches or your arms or legs touch down.
tips: Keep the shape stiff, so your body rocks like a chair and never folds.
Bend your knees or bring your arms to your sides to make the shape easier.
Keep your chin a little tucked so your neck stays long.

455.cue: Hug the weight, curl up, roll down slowly. Count out loud, breathe out as you rise.
how: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat on the floor and free.
Hug the weight to your chest with both arms crossed over it.
Breathe out and curl up one part at a time: head, shoulders, then your back.
Sit up as far as the weight lets you, then roll down slowly, back first.
Each sit-up and roll back down counts as one, counted out loud.

dumbbells: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat on the floor and free.
Hold the dumbbell on end against your chest, both hands cupping its top.
Breathe out and curl up one part at a time: head, shoulders, then your back.
Sit up as far as the weight lets you, then roll down slowly, back first.
Each sit-up and roll back down counts as one, counted out loud.
kettlebell: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat on the floor and free.
Hold the kettlebell to your chest by its horns, the bell down, elbows in.
Breathe out and curl up one part at a time: head, shoulders, then your back.
Sit up as far as the weight lets you, then roll down slowly, back first.
Each sit-up and roll back down counts as one, counted out loud.

455.name: Sit-up with a weight
455.setup: A weight of 5-10 kg hugged to your chest: a bag of books, a jug.

setups.dumbbells: A dumbbell of 5-10 kg held on end against your chest.
setups.kettlebell: A kettlebell of 5-10 kg held on your chest by its horns.

455.stop: Stop when your feet lift, you jerk up, or your lower back or neck hurts.
tips: Pick a weight you can sit up with 6 to 10 times; the game says when to go heavier.
Keep the weight on your chest, never behind your head.
Feet lifting? Hold the weight lower, nearer your belly.

456.cue: Back knee straight, tuck your tailbone, squeeze your seat. Breathe slowly.
how: Stand side-on to the desk, the near hand on it.
Step the outside foot back a long step onto its toes and straighten that knee.
Bend the front knee a little, hands on your hips, body upright.
Tuck your tailbone under and squeeze your seat, then breathe slowly.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
456.name: Standing hip stretch
456.setup: Stand side-on to the desk, a long step of clear floor behind you.
456.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or if your hip or low back hurts; never bounce.
tips: Feel the stretch at the front of the back hip, never in your low back.
Keep your ribs down so your low back does not arch.
Rest a hand on the desk again if you wobble.

457.cue: Hug one knee in, let the other leg hang off the end. Breathe slowly.
how: Sit on the very end of your bed, then lie back along it.
Hug both knees to your chest so your low back rests flat.
Keep one knee hugged and lower the other leg off the end of the bed.
Let that thigh hang, its knee bent, and breathe slowly.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
457.name: Lying hip stretch on the bed
457.setup: Sit on the very end of your bed.
457.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or if your hip or knee hurts; never bounce.
tips: Keep the hugged knee close so your low back stays flat on the bed.
Let the leg's weight do the work; never push it down.
Shuffle up the bed a little if your foot touches the floor.

458.cue: Press your foot gently into your hand for 5, then breathe out and ease in.
how: Stand side-on to the desk, the near hand on it.
Hold the outside foot behind you, heel near your buttock, knees side by side.
Press the foot gently back into your hand at half effort for 5 counts.
Relax, breathe out and ease the heel a little closer. Do three rounds.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
458.name: Quad stretch, press and sink
458.setup: Stand side-on to the desk, a hand on it.
458.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or if your knee hurts; never bounce.
tips: Half effort is gentle: the leg hardly moves while you press.
Keep breathing as you press; never hold your breath.
Loop a towel round the ankle if your hand cannot reach it.

459.cue: Back foot on the bed, sink straight down, body tall. Breathe slowly.
how: Stand facing away from your bed, a long step in front of it.
Rest the top of one foot on the edge of the bed behind you.
Bend the front knee and sink straight down, the front shin upright.
Stay tall, hands on your hips, until the front thigh is level. Breathe slowly.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
459.name: Back foot on the bed lunge
459.setup: Stand a long step in front of your bed, facing away from it.
459.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or if a knee hurts; never bounce.
tips: Move the front foot further out if its knee goes past your toes.
Squeeze the back leg's seat to feel more stretch at the front of the hip.
Rest a hand on a wall if you wobble.

46.cue: Lower for 3 seconds, push up in 1. Count out loud, breathe out as you push.
how: Check the desk cannot slide, then grip its edge with your hands shoulder-width apart.
Walk your feet back until your body forms a straight line from heels to head.
Lower your chest to the desk edge for a slow count of three.
Breathe out and push back up to straight arms in one count.
Count each rep out loud as your arms straighten, then start the next slow lowering.
46.name: Desk push-up, 3-s lowering
46.setup: Hands on the desk edge; the desk must not move.
46.stop: Stop when you lose the 3-s lowering or your hips sag.
tips: Count the three out loud so the last part of the lowering does not rush.
Breathe in slowly on the way down, never hold your breath to stay tight.
Squeeze your seat and belly so your body lowers as one straight piece.

460.cue: Front leg straight, toes up, back long, hands on the books. Breathe slowly.
how: Kneel on the towel with one foot forward, a pile of books either side of your hips.
Move your hips back until they sit over the back knee.
Straighten the front leg, heel down and toes up.
Lean forward with a long back, hands on the books, and breathe slowly.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
460.name: Half split on books
460.setup: Kneel on a folded towel, a pile of books by each hip.
460.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or a tug high under the buttock; never bounce.
tips: Stack the books higher if your back rounds.
Lead with your chest so the fold comes from the hips.
Keep the back hip right above the back knee.

461.cue: Reach back, draw the back heel in, body upright. Breathe slowly.
how: Kneel in a low lunge, the back knee on the towel, the front foot a long step ahead.
Bend the back knee and reach back for that foot with the hand on the same side.
Draw the heel toward your seat, the other hand on the front thigh.
Keep your body upright, hips forward, and breathe slowly.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
461.name: Low lunge, foot hold
461.setup: Kneel on a folded towel in a long low lunge.
461.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or if your knee hurts; never bounce.
tips: Loop a towel round the foot if you cannot reach it.
Move the back knee further back if the kneecap presses hard.
Squeeze your seat so the stretch stays at the front of the hip.

462.cue: Press the front heel gently down for 5, then breathe out and fold a little deeper.
how: Stand in the pyramid at the desk, hands on its edge, front leg straight.
Press the front heel gently into the floor at half effort for 5 counts.
Relax, breathe out and lean your chest a little further over the front thigh.
Do three rounds, the hips square and the back long.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
462.name: Pyramid at the desk, press and sink
462.setup: Stand facing your desk, about a long step away.
462.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or any tingling down the leg; never bounce.
tips: Half effort is gentle: the heel presses, the leg does not move.
Keep breathing as you press; never hold your breath.
Shorten your stance if your back heel lifts.

463.cue: Back knee straight, hips low, forearms on the books. Breathe slowly.
how: Start in a lunge, the front foot a long step ahead and turned out a little.
Put the books inside the front foot and lower your forearms onto them.
Let the front knee open out beside your shoulder.
Straighten the back knee, toes tucked, hips low, and breathe slowly.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
463.name: Lizard on books
463.setup: Clear floor, a pile of books inside your front foot.
463.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or if your hip or knee hurts; never bounce.
tips: Use your hands on the books, arms straight, if your forearms do not reach.
Keep the front heel flat on the floor.
Rest the back knee down to come out.

464.cue: Squeeze the front thigh, lift the heel a little, hold. Breathe slowly.
how: Set up the half split on books, front leg straight, toes up.
Squeeze the front thigh hard so the knee stays straight.
Lift the front heel a finger off the floor and hold for a few counts.
Lower it slowly, then lift again, breathing all the time.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
464.name: Half split, heel lift
464.setup: Kneel on a folded towel, two piles of books in front of you.
464.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or if the front thigh cramps; never bounce.
tips: A tiny lift is plenty; keep the knee straight and the hips still.
Keep breathing as you lift; never hold your breath.
Stack the books higher if your back rounds.

465.cue: Back knee straight, hips low, forearms on the floor. Breathe slowly.
how: Start in the lizard on books, the front foot turned out a little.
Take the books away and lower your forearms to the floor inside the front foot.
Keep the back knee straight and off the floor, toes tucked.
Let your hips sink low and breathe slowly.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
465.name: Lizard on the forearms
465.setup: Clear floor and a mat or towel for your forearms.
465.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or if your hip or knee hurts; never bounce.
tips: Go back to the books if your back knee bends to reach the floor.
Keep the front heel flat on the floor.
Rest the back knee down to come out.

466.cue: Back shin up the sofa, body upright, arms up, ribs down. Breathe slowly.
how: Set up the couch stretch, back shin up the bed or sofa, front foot forward.
Lift your chest until your body is upright and squeeze your seat.
Reach both arms straight up beside your ears.
Keep your ribs down so your low back stays long, and breathe slowly.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
466.name: Couch stretch, arms up
466.setup: A bed or sofa behind you, a folded towel at its base for your knee.
466.stop: Ease off if your knee hurts or the front of your thigh cramps; never bounce.
tips: Lower your hands to your hips if your low back arches.
Move the knee a little away from the bed or sofa if the stretch is too strong.
Tuck your tailbone to feel more stretch without leaning back.

467.cue: Press both legs gently down for 5, then breathe out and slide a little lower.
how: Slide into the front split prep, both knees straight, hands on the floor or books.
Press the front heel and back knee gently down at half effort for 5 counts.
Relax, breathe out and let your hips slide a little lower.
Do three rounds, your hands taking your weight.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
467.name: Front split prep, press and sink
467.setup: 2 m of clear floor, two books for your hands.
467.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or a tug high under the buttock; never bounce.
tips: Half effort is gentle: your legs press, they do not move.
Keep breathing as you press; never hold your breath.
Keep your hips square: back toes on the floor, front toes pointing up.

468.cue: Lift the straight leg forward to desk height and hold. Breathe slowly.
how: Stand tall side-on to the desk, the near hand on it, the other on your hip.
Lift the outside leg straight forward, knee straight and toes up.
Raise your toes to the height of the desk and hold them there for a few counts.
Lower it slowly, then lift again, breathing all the time.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
468.name: Standing leg lift at the desk
468.setup: Stand side-on to the desk, a hand on it.
468.stop: Ease off if the front of your hip cramps or pinches; never swing the leg.
tips: Lift with the front of the thigh; never swing the leg up.
Keep the standing knee straight and your body tall.
A lower lift with a straight knee beats a high one with a bent knee.

469.cue: Hips low, knees straight, body upright, hands on the books. Breathe slowly.
how: Slide into the low front split, hands on the floor ahead of the front foot.
Walk your hands back onto the books beside your hips.
Lift your body upright, hips square, both knees straight.
Keep your hips about 15 cm from the floor and breathe slowly.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
469.name: Low front split, upright
469.setup: 2 m of clear floor, two piles of books by your hips.
469.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or a tug high under the buttock; never bounce.
tips: Stack the books higher if you cannot sit upright.
Squeeze the back leg's seat to feel the front of that hip.
Slide down slowly and never drop or bounce into the split.

47.cue: Lower for 3 seconds from your toes, knees down, push up. Count out loud, breathe out up.
how: Place your hands flat on the floor under your shoulders and step back onto your toes.
Hold a straight line from heels to head with your belly and seat tight.
Lower your chest towards the floor for a slow count of three, staying straight.
Set your knees down, then breathe out and push up to straight arms from your knees.
Lift your knees to come back onto your toes, and count each slow lowering as one rep.
47.name: Slow push-up, knees down
47.setup: On the floor, hands under your shoulders.
47.stop: Stop when you lose the 3-s lowering or your hips sag.
tips: Make the last part of the lowering as slow as the first, since it is the hardest part.
Tuck your elbows back towards your hips as you lower.
Breathe in slowly as you lower and out as you push, never holding your breath.

470.cue: Press both legs gently down for 5, then breathe out and slide a little lower.
how: Slide into the low front split, both knees straight, hands on the floor or books.
Press the front heel and back knee gently down at half effort for 5 counts.
Relax, breathe out and let your hips slide a little lower.
Do three rounds, your hands taking your weight.
