The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
470.name: Low front split, press and sink
470.setup: 2 m of clear floor, two books for your hands.
470.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or a tug high under the buttock; never bounce.
tips: Half effort is gentle: your legs press, they do not move.
Keep breathing as you press; never hold your breath.
15 cm is about the width of one and a half fists.

471.cue: Hold behind the raised leg, knee straight, other leg flat. Breathe slowly.
how: Lie on your back along your bed, both legs straight.
Bend one knee to your chest and hold behind the thigh with both hands.
Straighten that leg up toward the ceiling.
Draw it gently past straight up, the other leg flat, and breathe slowly.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
471.name: Lying leg pull on the bed
471.setup: Lie on your back along your bed.
471.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or any tingling down the leg; never bounce.
tips: Loop a towel round the foot if you cannot keep the knee straight.
Keep your head and both hips resting on the bed.
Press the back of the other knee into the bed.

472.cue: Both thighs down, hips square, body upright, arms up. Breathe slowly.
how: Slide into the front split, hands on the floor beside your hips.
Sit tall with your hips square and both knees straight.
Lift your hands off the floor and reach both arms straight up.
Keep your ribs down and breathe slowly, then put your hands down to come out.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
472.name: Front split, arms up
472.setup: 2 m of clear floor, a mat or towel.
472.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or a tug high under the buttock; never bounce.
tips: Keep your hands down until sitting tall in the split feels easy.
Put a hand down at once if you tip to one side.
Keep the back kneecap facing the floor and the front toes pointing up.

473.cue: Both thighs down, hips square, fold forward with a long back. Breathe slowly.
how: Slide into the front split and sit tall, hips square, knees straight.
Lean forward from the hips with a long back over the front leg.
Rest your hands on the floor either side of the front leg.
Let your chest sink low over the front thigh and breathe slowly.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
473.name: Front split fold
473.setup: 2 m of clear floor, a mat or towel.
473.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or a tug high under the buttock; never bounce.
tips: Lead with your chest, not your head, so your back stays long.
Keep both hips down on the floor as you fold.
Sit up slowly with a long back to come out.

474.cue: Lift the straight leg forward to hip height and hold. Breathe slowly.
how: Stand tall side-on to the desk, the near hand on it, the other on your hip.
Lift the outside leg straight forward, knee straight and toes up.
Raise the heel to the height of your hip and hold it there for a few counts.
Lower it slowly, then lift again, breathing all the time.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
474.name: Standing leg lift to hip height
474.setup: Stand side-on to the desk, a hand on it.
474.stop: Ease off if the front of your hip cramps or pinches; never swing the leg.
tips: Lift with the front of the thigh; never swing the leg up.
Keep the standing knee straight and your body tall, not leaning back.
Go back to desk height if the knee bends to get higher.

476.cue: Soles together, heels in, let your knees fall open; never push them. Breathe slowly.
how: Sit tall on your bed with your knees bent and the soles of your feet together.
Draw your heels in, about a forearm from your body, fingertips on the bed behind you.
Let both knees fall open towards the bed; never press them down.
Sit tall over your sit bones and breathe slowly for the time shown.
476.name: Butterfly on the bed
476.setup: Sit on your bed or the floor, your back on the wall if it helps.
476.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or if the inside of a knee hurts; never bounce.
tips: Sit on a folded towel if your back rounds when you sit tall.
Lift your chest and let your fingertips take a little weight.
Let your knees sink a little more with each breath out.

477.cue: Soles together, let your knees fall open; never push them. Breathe slowly.
how: Lie on your back on the bed with your knees bent and your feet flat.
Bring the soles of your feet together and slide your heels towards your seat.
Let both knees fall open to the sides, your arms resting by your sides.
Keep your low back resting on the bed and breathe slowly for the time shown.
To finish, bring your knees together with your hands and stretch your legs out.
477.name: Lying butterfly
477.setup: Lie on your back on your bed, a pillow under your head.
477.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or if the inside of a knee hurts.
tips: Put a pillow under each knee if the stretch is too strong.
Let the bed take your weight; gravity does the stretching, not you.

478.cue: Legs wide and straight, toes up, lean forward with a flat back. Breathe slowly.
how: Sit near the front edge of your chair and stretch both legs out wide.
Rest your heels on the floor, knees straight and toes pointing up.
Sit tall, then lean forward from your hips with a flat back.
Slide your hands down to your knees and breathe slowly for the time shown.
478.name: Wide-leg chair stretch
478.setup: Sit near the front of a firm chair that does not roll.
478.stop: Ease off at a strong pull inside the thighs or behind the knees.
tips: Bring your feet a little closer if your knees have to bend.
Lead with your chest so your back stays flat.
Widen your feet a little more each week.

479.cue: Sit halfway down, knees pushed out over the toes, chest up. Breathe slowly.
how: Stand with your feet twice your shoulders' width apart, toes pointing ahead.
Bend your knees and sit your hips down, pushing your knees out over your toes.
Stop when your thighs are halfway to level, chest up and back long.
Hold with your hands on your hips and breathe slowly for the time shown.
479.name: Horse stance
479.setup: Stand with your feet wide on a floor that does not slip.
479.stop: Stop if your knees cave in, or ease off if a knee hurts.
tips: Press the outsides of your feet down to keep your knees out.
Turn your toes out a little if your knees roll in.
Keep your weight over the middle of your feet, not your toes.

48.cue: Body straight, chest to the edge. Count out loud, breathe out as you push.
how: Put your hands near the front edge of the bottom stair or step, shoulder-width apart.
Walk your feet back until your body forms a straight line from heels to head.
Bend your elbows and lower your chest to the stair edge.
Breathe out as you push the stair away until your arms are straight.
Count each rep out loud as your arms straighten.
48.name: Step push-up
48.setup: Hands on the bottom stair or a step that cannot slide.
48.stop: Stop when your hips sag or your elbows flare.
tips: Keep your whole palm on the step, not hanging over its edge.
Look at the step just ahead of your hands so your neck stays in line.
Brace your belly and squeeze your seat so your hips never dip towards the floor.

480.cue: Heels in close, let your knees sink; never push them down. Breathe slowly.
how: Sit tall with your knees bent and the soles of your feet together.
Draw your heels in with your hands to about a hand from your body.
Let both knees sink towards the bed; never press them down.
Lean forward from your hips, fingertips on the bed in front of your feet.
Keep your back long and breathe slowly for the time shown.
480.name: Deep butterfly
480.setup: Sit on your bed or the floor, your back on the wall if it helps.
480.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or if the inside of a knee hurts; never bounce.
tips: Sit on a folded towel if your back rounds.
Lead with your chest so your back stays long.
Never press your knees down with your hands or elbows.

481.cue: Gently press the straight leg's foot down for 5 s, relax, breathe out and sink lower.
how: Face the desk, fingertips on its edge, feet five foot-lengths apart, toes out a little.
Bend one knee and sit your hips back, the other leg straight with its heel down.
Gently press the straight leg's foot into the floor, as if to pull it in, for 5 s.
Relax, breathe out and sink a little lower; do three rounds.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
481.name: Side lunge, press and sink
481.setup: Face the desk, hands on its edge, feet five foot-lengths apart.
481.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or if the inside of a knee hurts; never bounce.
tips: Press at about half your strength, never as hard as you can.
Keep breathing while you press; never hold your breath.
Keep the bent knee over its toes, not falling in.

482.cue: Big toes together, knees wide, sink your seat back to your heels. Breathe slowly.
how: Kneel with your big toes touching and your knees twice your hips' width apart.
Walk your hands forward and sink your seat back towards your heels.
Reach your arms long and rest your forehead on the floor.
Breathe slowly and let your hips sink a little with each breath out.
482.name: Wide-knee child's pose
482.setup: Kneel on a rug or mat, a folded towel under your knees.
482.stop: Ease off at a strong pull inside the thighs or if a knee hurts.
tips: Put a cushion between your seat and heels if they do not meet yet.
Keep your knees wide so the stretch stays inside your thighs.
Rise slowly at the end, walking your hands back in.

483.cue: Let your legs slide open down the wall; never push them. Breathe slowly.
how: Sit side-on to a wall, then swing your legs up it as you lie back on the floor.
Shuffle your seat towards the wall, legs straight up it, knees soft if you need.
Let your legs slide open to the sides, heels resting on the wall.
Rest your arms by your sides and breathe slowly for the time shown.
To finish, bring your legs together, bend your knees and roll onto your side.
483.name: Wall straddle
483.setup: Lie on the floor, your seat near a wall and your legs up it.
483.stop: Ease off at a strong pull, and bring your legs together if your feet tingle.
tips: Move your seat a little away from the wall if the backs of your legs pull.
Let gravity open your legs and keep your thighs relaxed.

484.cue: Knees wide, shins parallel, ease your hips back in line with your knees. Breathe slowly.
how: Start on your hands and knees, a folded towel under each knee.
Slide your knees out wide, shins parallel and ankles in line with your knees.
Lower onto your forearms and ease your hips back until they line up with your knees.
Breathe slowly and let your hips sink a little with each breath out.
To come out, walk your hands back, lift your hips and slide your knees in.
484.name: Frog
484.setup: Kneel on a rug or mat, a folded towel under each knee.
484.stop: Ease off at a strong pull inside the thighs or if a knee hurts; never bounce.
tips: Flex your feet so the insides of your feet rest on the floor.
Keep your back long, not sagging towards the floor.
Move slowly in and out, since the frog pulls hard on the inner thighs.

485.cue: Legs wide and straight, kneecaps and toes up, sit tall. Breathe slowly.
how: Sit on the bed with your seat and back against the wall or the headboard.
Open your legs wide, knees straight, kneecaps and toes pointing up.
Sit tall and lift your hands off the bed, resting them on your thighs.
Breathe slowly and widen your legs a little with each breath out.
485.name: Wide sit on the bed
485.setup: Sit on a double bed, your back on the wall or the headboard.
485.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or if the inside of a knee hurts; never press your knees.
tips: Sit on a folded towel if your back rounds or your knees bend.
Bring your legs a little closer if your kneecaps roll in.
Keep your toes pointing up, not falling out to the sides.

486.cue: Sit down until your thighs are level, knees out over the toes. Breathe slowly.
how: Stand with your feet twice your shoulders' width apart, toes pointing ahead.
Bend your knees and sit straight down, pushing your knees out over your toes.
Sit until your thighs are level with the floor, chest up and back long.
Reach your arms forward at shoulder height and breathe slowly for the time shown.
486.name: Deep horse stance
486.setup: Stand with your feet wide on a floor that does not slip.
486.stop: Stop if your knees cave in, or ease off if a knee hurts.
tips: Widen your feet a little if your knees come forward past your toes.
Press the outsides of your feet down to keep your knees out.
Rise slowly at the end and never drop out of the stance.

487.cue: Gently press your heels down and in for 5 s, relax, breathe out and fold deeper.
how: Sit tall on the towel and open your legs wide, at least a right angle apart.
Point your kneecaps and toes up and fold forward from your hips.
Gently press both heels down and in for 5 s, as if to pull your legs together.
Relax, breathe out and fold a little deeper; do three rounds.
Walk your hands back to sit up at the end of the hold.
487.name: Straddle fold, press and sink
487.setup: Sit on a folded towel, 2 m of clear floor to the sides.
487.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or if the inside of a knee hurts; never bounce.
tips: Press at about half your strength, never as hard as you can.
Keep breathing while you press; never hold your breath.
Fold from the hips so your back stays long.

488.cue: Legs wide, hands beside your hips, lift both heels for 5 counts, lower. Breathe slowly.
how: Sit tall on the towel, legs straight and at least a right angle apart.
Point your kneecaps and toes up and put your hands beside your hips.
Tighten your thighs and lift both heels just off the floor for 5 counts.
Lower them for a breath, then lift again until the time is up.
488.name: Straddle heel lifts
488.setup: Sit on a folded towel, 2 m of clear floor to the sides.
488.stop: Stop when your knees bend or a hip cramps.
tips: Keep sitting tall, since leaning back makes the lift easy but misses the point.
Lift one heel at a time until both together get easier.
Keep breathing through each lift.

489.cue: Step your feet out wide, knees straight, seat a forearm from the floor. Breathe slowly.
how: Stand facing your bed with both hands on it, feet together.
Step your feet out to the sides a little at a time, knees straight.
Keep your kneecaps facing forward and lower your seat to a forearm from the floor.
Lean on your hands and breathe slowly for the time shown.
To come out, lean on your hands, bend your knees and step your feet in.
489.name: Standing straddle at the bed
489.setup: Face your bed, hands on it, barefoot on a floor that does not slip.
489.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or if the inside of a knee hurts; never bounce.
tips: Keep your weight in your hands so you can rise at any moment.
Point your toes forward or a little out, never rolling in.
Go a little wider each week, never with a jump or a bounce.

49.cue: Body straight, chest to a fist's height. Count out loud, breathe out as you push.
how: Place your hands flat on the floor under your shoulders, fingers pointing forward.
Step back onto your toes, feet hip-width apart, body straight from heels to head.
Bend your elbows and lower your chest to about a fist above the floor.
Breathe out as you push the floor away until your arms are straight.
Count each rep out loud as your arms straighten.
49.name: Push-up
49.setup: On the floor, hands under your shoulders.
49.stop: Stop when your hips sag or your elbows flare.
tips: Tuck your elbows so they point back towards your hips, at about 45 degrees.
Squeeze your seat and brace your belly before each rep, and keep them tight.
Grip the floor with your fingers and press through the whole hand.

490.cue: Sit tall, lift the back shin and foot off the bed for 5 counts, lower. Breathe slowly.
how: Sit in the 90-90 on your bed, front shin across, back shin pointing back.
Sit tall with both knees at right angles and your hands light on the bed behind you.
Keep the back knee down and lift the back shin and foot off the bed for 5 counts.
Lower for a breath, then lift again until the time is up.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
490.name: 90-90 back shin lift
490.setup: Sit on your bed in the 90-90, hands on the bed behind you.
490.stop: Stop if your hip cramps or pinches.
tips: Turn your chest towards the front shin to keep your back long.
Lift only a little at first; the height comes with practice.
Keep breathing through each lift.

491.cue: Gently press your heels down and in for 5 s, relax, breathe out and fold deeper.
how: Sit tall on the towel with your legs wide, kneecaps and toes pointing up.
Tip your hips forward and walk your hands out, chest leading.
Gently press your heels down and in for 5 s, as if to pull your legs together.
Relax, breathe out and fold a little deeper; do three rounds.
Walk your hands back to sit up at the end of the hold.
491.name: Pancake, press and sink
491.setup: Sit on a folded towel, 2 m of clear floor to the sides.
491.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or if the inside of a knee hurts; never bounce.
tips: Press at about half your strength, never as hard as you can.
Keep breathing while you press; never hold your breath.
Bring your legs a little closer if your kneecaps roll in.

492.cue: Gently press down and in for 5 s, relax, breathe out, lean on your hands and ease wider.
how: Face your bed with both hands on it and your feet wide, knees straight.
Step your feet out a little at a time until your hips are about a hand from the floor.
Gently press your feet down and in for 5 s, as if to pull them together.
Relax, breathe out, then with your weight in your hands ease your feet a little wider.
Do three rounds, then lean on your hands, bend your knees and walk your feet in.
492.name: Side split press at the bed
492.setup: Face your bed, barefoot on a floor that does not slip, 2 m of clear floor to the sides.
492.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or if the inside of a knee hurts; never bounce.
tips: Press at about half your strength, never as hard as you can.
Keep your weight in your hands so you can rise at any moment.
Keep breathing while you press; never hold your breath.

493.cue: Knees wide, shins parallel, lower your chest and belly to the floor. Breathe slowly.
how: Start in the frog on your forearms, hips in line with your knees.
Slide your knees a little wider, shins parallel and feet flexed.
Lower your chest and belly towards the floor, arms reaching forward.
Breathe slowly and let your hips sink a little with each breath out.
To come out, walk your hands back, lift your hips and slide your knees in.
493.name: Frog, chest down
493.setup: Kneel on a rug or mat, a folded towel under each knee.
493.stop: Ease off at a strong pull inside the thighs or if a knee hurts; never bounce.
tips: Keep your hips in line with your knees, not behind them.
Move slowly in and out, and never rock or bounce at the bottom.

494.cue: In the middle split, tip your hips forward and fold onto your forearms. Breathe slowly.
how: Slide into the middle split with your hands on the floor or the books.
Turn your kneecaps up, tip your hips forward and walk your hands out.
Lower onto your forearms with a long back, hips on the floor or the towel.
Breathe slowly for the time shown.
To come out, walk your hands back, bend your knees and walk your feet in.
494.name: Middle split fold
494.setup: 2 m of clear floor, a folded towel under your seat, books for your hands.
494.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or if the inside of a knee hurts; never bounce.
tips: Fold from the hips so your back stays long.
Keep your weight in your hands until your hips rest on the floor.
Slide down slowly and never drop or bounce into the split.

495.cue: Gently press your feet down and in for 5 s, relax, breathe out and slide lower.
how: Slide your feet out to the sides with your hands on the floor or the books.
Stop at a strong pull, knees straight and kneecaps facing forward.
Gently press your feet down and in for 5 s, as if to pull them together.
Relax, breathe out and slide a little lower; do three rounds.
To come out, lean on your hands, bend your knees and walk your feet in.
495.name: Middle split, press and sink
495.setup: 2 m of clear floor, a folded towel under your seat, books for your hands.
495.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or if the inside of a knee hurts; never bounce.
tips: Press at about half your strength, never as hard as you can.
Keep your weight in your hands so you can rise at any moment.
Keep breathing while you press; never hold your breath.

496.cue: Strap round one sole, that leg straight up, the other leg long. Breathe slowly.
how: Lie on your back on your bed with both legs long.
Loop a towel, belt or strap round the sole of one foot and hold both ends.
Straighten that leg and draw it up until you feel a gentle pull behind the thigh.
Keep the other leg long on the bed and breathe slowly.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
496.name: Lying strap hamstring stretch
496.setup: Lie on your back on your bed with a towel, belt or strap.
496.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or any tingling down the leg; never bounce.
tips: Walk your hands up the strap to bring the leg closer; keep your shoulders down.
Keep the knee straight: a lower straight leg beats a higher bent one.
Relax your neck and shoulders on the bed.

497.cue: One heel up the wall, that leg straight, the other flat through the door. Breathe slowly.
how: Lie on your back in an open doorway with one leg flat through the door.
Rest the other heel on the wall beside the door frame, knee bent.
Slide that heel up the wall until the leg is straight.
Let the wall hold the leg, arms resting on the floor, and breathe slowly.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
497.name: Doorway hamstring stretch
497.setup: Lie on your back on the floor in an open doorway.
497.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or any tingling down the leg; never bounce.
tips: Shuffle your seat back from the wall if the knee will not straighten.
Keep your seat and low back flat on the floor.
Let the wall do the holding so the leg can let go.

498.cue: Press the heel gently down for 5 s, relax, breathe out, hinge a little deeper.
how: Sit near the front edge of your chair and slide one leg out straight, heel down.
Hinge forward with a flat back until you feel a gentle pull behind the thigh.
Press the heel gently down into the floor at about half effort for 5 seconds.
Relax, breathe out and hinge a little deeper; do three rounds.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
498.name: Chair hamstring press and sink
498.setup: Sit near the front edge of your chair, feet flat.
498.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or any tingling down the leg; never bounce.
tips: Keep breathing while you press; never hold your breath.
Press at about half effort, never hard.
Sink only as far as the leg lets go; the next round goes a little deeper.

499.cue: Lift one leg straight with no hands and hold it there. Breathe slowly.
how: Lie on your back on your bed with both legs long and your arms by your sides.
Pull the toes of one foot towards you and lock that knee straight.
Lift the leg slowly as high as it goes with the knee straight.
Hold it there with no hands and breathe slowly, then lower it slowly.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
499.name: Lying straight leg lift
499.setup: Lie on your back on your bed, legs long, arms by your sides.
499.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or any tingling down the leg; lower it slowly.
tips: Keep the other leg long and resting on the bed.
Stop the lift where the knee starts to bend.
Keep your belly soft and your head on the bed; only the leg works.

50.cue: Lower halfway and hold, body straight. Count out loud.
how: Place your hands flat on the floor under your shoulders, fingers pointing forward.
Step back onto your toes and make a straight line from heels to head.
Lower your chest halfway, until your elbows are bent to about a right angle.
Hold still there, breathing slowly in and out and counting out loud.
The clock times how long you hold the halfway point, then set your knees down.
50.name: Push-up hold
50.setup: On the floor, hands under your shoulders.
50.stop: Stop when your hips sag or your arms shake hard.
tips: Keep your elbows tucked back by your ribs, not out wide.
Press the floor away so your shoulders stay up and your chest does not sink.
Breathe out on every count so your breath keeps moving through the hold.

500.cue: Heel on the edge, leg straight, hinge forward with a flat back. Breathe slowly.
how: Stand facing your bed or a sofa, about one step away.
Rest one heel on the edge with that leg straight and the toes up.
Stand tall on the other leg with the hand on that side on your hip.
Hinge with a flat back, slide your free hand halfway down the thigh and breathe slowly.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
500.name: Bed edge hamstring stretch
500.setup: Stand facing your bed or a sofa, about one step away.
500.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or any tingling down the leg; never bounce.
tips: Keep the standing leg straight and its foot pointing forward.
Lead with your chest, not your head, so the back stays flat.
Stand beside a wall and touch it if you wobble.

501.cue: Leg straight, toes up, fold from the hips and reach for the toes. Breathe slowly.
how: Sit on your bed with one leg straight out in front of you, toes up.
Bend the other knee and rest that sole against the inside of the straight thigh.
Turn your chest to face the straight leg and sit tall.
Fold forward from the hips, reach your fingertips to the toes and breathe slowly.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
501.name: One-leg reach on the bed
501.setup: Sit on your bed, one leg out straight, the other foot on its thigh.
501.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or any tingling down the leg; never bounce.
tips: Keep the back of the straight knee down on the bed.
Put a pillow under the bent knee if it does not reach the bed.
Lead with your chest, not your head.

502.cue: Walk back and hinge until your back is flat and level. Breathe slowly.
how: Stand facing your desk, feet hip-width apart, hands on its edge.
Walk your feet back and hinge forward from the hips.
Lower your chest until your back is flat and level with the floor.
Keep your knees straight and your head between your arms, and breathe slowly.
Walk your feet in and stand up slowly at the end of the hold.
502.name: Desk half fold
502.setup: Stand facing your desk or a table, hands on its edge.
502.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or any tingling down the legs; never bounce.
tips: Push your seat back as your chest goes down to keep the back flat.
Bend your knees a little first, then straighten them as the legs let go.
Use a higher surface if your back rounds before it is level.

503.cue: Seat at the wall, heel up it, that leg straight, the other flat. Breathe slowly.
how: Lie on your back in an open doorway with one leg flat through the door.
Shuffle your seat right up to the wall beside the door frame.
Rest the other heel on the wall and slide it up until the leg is straight.
Let the wall hold the leg, arms resting on the floor, and breathe slowly.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
503.name: Doorway hamstring at the wall
503.setup: Lie on your back on the floor in an open doorway.
503.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or any tingling down the leg; never bounce.
tips: Move your seat back a little if the knee will not straighten.
Keep your seat and low back flat on the floor.
Let the wall do the holding so the leg can let go.

504.cue: Fingertips to the floor beside your heels, knees straight, head hanging. Breathe slowly.
how: Stand with your feet together and your knees a little bent.
Fold from the hips and reach your hands down beside your feet.
Straighten your knees and touch your fingertips to the floor beside your heels.
Let your back round and your head hang, and breathe slowly.
Bend your knees and rise slowly at the end of the hold.
504.name: Heel reach fold
504.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or any tingling down the leg; never bounce.
tips: Touch the floor beside your toes first, then walk your fingers back.
Keep your weight over the balls of your feet, not back on your heels.
Stand still for a breath after you rise before you move on.

505.cue: Leg straight, both hands round the foot, back long. Breathe slowly.
how: Sit on your bed with one leg straight out, the other sole against its thigh.
Turn your chest to face the straight leg and sit tall.
Fold forward from the hips and wrap both hands round the foot.
Keep your back long and the knee down, and breathe slowly.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
505.name: One-leg fold on the bed
505.setup: Sit on your bed, one leg out straight, the other foot on its thigh.
505.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or any tingling down the leg; never bounce.
tips: Loop a towel round the foot until your hands reach it.
Lead with your chest, not your head.
Put a pillow under the bent knee if it does not reach the bed.

506.cue: Strap round one sole, that leg straight past upright, the other long. Breathe slowly.
how: Lie on your back on your bed with both legs long.
Loop a towel, belt or strap round the sole of one foot and hold both ends.
Straighten that leg and draw it up past upright towards you.
Keep the other leg long on the bed and breathe slowly.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
506.name: Deep lying strap stretch
506.setup: Lie on your back on your bed with a towel, belt or strap.
506.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or any tingling down the leg; never bounce.
tips: Walk your hands up the strap as the leg comes closer.
Keep the knee straight and your head on the bed.
Keep your low back resting on the bed.

507.cue: Hands on hips, straighten one leg level with the seat and hold. Breathe slowly.
how: Sit tall near the front edge of a chair, feet flat, hands on your hips.
Pull the toes of one foot up towards you.
Straighten that knee until the whole leg is level with the seat.
Hold it there with your back tall and breathe slowly, then lower it slowly.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
507.name: Seated straight leg lift
507.setup: Sit tall near the front edge of a chair, back off the backrest.
507.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or any tingling down the leg; lower it slowly.
tips: Stop where your back starts to round: sitting tall matters more than the height.
Keep the thigh resting on the seat while the knee straightens.
Keep both sit bones on the chair.

508.cue: Hold your soles, press the heels gently down for 5 s, relax, breathe out, sink.
how: Sit on your bed with both legs straight out in front of you, feet together.
Fold from the hips and hold your soles until you feel a gentle pull.
Press your heels gently down into the bed at about half effort for 5 seconds.
Relax, breathe out and fold a little deeper; do three rounds.
Stay for the time shown, then sit up slowly.
508.name: Seated fold press and sink
508.setup: Sit on your bed with your legs out straight in front of you.
508.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or any tingling down the legs; never bounce.
tips: Keep breathing while you press; never hold your breath.
Press at about half effort, never hard.
Fold from the hips, since a round back only brings your head down.

509.cue: Leg straight, fold until your forehead meets the knee. Breathe slowly.
how: Sit on your bed with one leg straight out, the other sole against its thigh.
Turn your chest to face the straight leg and hold the foot.
Fold from the hips and bring your forehead to the straight knee.
Keep the knee down, let your back round, and breathe slowly.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
509.name: One-leg chest to knee on the bed
509.setup: Sit on your bed, one leg out straight, the other foot on its thigh.
509.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or any tingling down the leg; never bounce.
tips: Bend your elbows out to the sides to draw your forehead toward the knee.
Fold from the hips first, then let your back round.
Relax your shoulders and neck in the fold.

51.cue: Body straight, chest to the floor. Count out loud, breathe out as you push.
how: Push the bed or sofa with a foot to check it stays put, then kneel with your back to it.
Put your hands under your shoulders and set your toes on its edge, one foot at a time.
Lift into a straight line from heels to head, hips level with your shoulders.
Lower your chest towards the floor, then breathe out as you push back up.
Count each rep out loud as your arms straighten.
51.name: Feet-elevated push-up
51.setup: Toes on the edge of a bed or sofa, hands on the floor.
51.stop: Stop when your hips sag or your elbows flare.
tips: Keep your hips level with your shoulders and feet, not up in the air.
Let your chest lead towards the floor, with your eyes just ahead of your hands.
Tuck your elbows back towards your hips as you lower.

510.cue: Strap round one sole, draw the straight leg in, toes over your chin. Breathe slowly.
how: Lie on your back on your bed with both legs long.
Loop a towel, belt or strap round the sole of one foot and hold both ends.
Draw the straight leg towards you until the toes are over your chin.
Keep the knee straight and the other leg long, and breathe slowly.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
510.name: Lying toes to chin
510.setup: Lie on your back on your bed with a towel, belt or strap.
510.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or any tingling down the leg; never bounce.
tips: Walk your hands up the strap as the leg comes closer.
Keep your head and shoulders resting on the bed.
Pull gently with your arms only to help, never to force the leg.

511.cue: Hold your soles, press the heels gently down for 5 s, relax, breathe out, fold.
how: Sit on your bed with both legs straight out in front of you, feet together.
Hold your soles and fold from the hips, chest towards your thighs.
Press your heels gently down into the bed at about half effort for 5 seconds.
Relax, breathe out and fold a little deeper; do three rounds.
Stay for the time shown, then sit up slowly.
511.name: Chest to knees press and sink
511.setup: Sit on your bed with your legs out straight in front of you.
511.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or any tingling down the legs; never bounce.
tips: Keep breathing while you press; never hold your breath.
Press at about half effort, never hard.
Fold from the hips first, then let your back round.

512.cue: Leg straight, chest on the thigh, face down to the shin. Breathe slowly.
how: Sit on your bed with one leg straight out, the other sole against its thigh.
Turn your chest to face the straight leg and hold the foot.
Fold from the hips with your chest along the thigh and your back long.
Let your face come down to the shin, knee down, and breathe slowly.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
512.name: One-leg face to shin on the bed
512.setup: Sit on your bed, one leg out straight, the other foot on its thigh.
512.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or any tingling down the leg; never bounce.
tips: Pull gently with your arms only to help, never to force the fold.
Keep the foot flexed, toes pointing up.
Stay with chest to thigh until the deeper fold comes easily.

513.cue: Hands round your calves, knees straight, face to your shins. Breathe slowly.
how: Stand with your feet together and your knees a little bent.
Fold from the hips and wrap your hands round the backs of your calves.
Straighten your knees and draw your chest onto your thighs.
Let your face come to your shins and breathe slowly.
Let go, bend your knees and rise slowly at the end of the hold.
513.name: Standing face to shins
513.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or any tingling down the leg; never bounce.
tips: Bend your elbows back to draw your chest closer to your legs.
Keep your weight forward over the balls of your feet.
Stand still for a breath after you rise before you move on.

514.cue: Hold the lower shin, draw the straight leg in, shin near your face. Breathe slowly.
how: Lie on your back on your bed with both legs long.
Lift one leg straight up and hold the lower shin with both hands.
Draw the leg in until the shin is a hand's width from your face.
Keep the knee straight and the other leg long, and breathe slowly.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
514.name: Lying leg to face
514.setup: Lie on your back on your bed, both legs long.
514.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or any tingling down the leg; never bounce.
tips: Use a strap round the sole until your hands reach the shin.
Keep your head and shoulders resting on the bed.
Pull gently with your arms only to help, never to force the leg.

515.cue: Fold flat, press the heels gently down for 5 s, relax, breathe out, sink.
how: Sit on your bed with both legs straight out in front of you, feet together.
Hold your feet and fold from the hips, chest along your thighs.
Press your heels gently down into the bed at about half effort for 5 seconds.
Relax, breathe out and let your face come closer to your shins; do three rounds.
Stay for the time shown, then sit up slowly.
515.name: Pike fold press and sink
515.setup: Sit on your bed with your legs out straight in front of you.
515.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or any tingling down the legs; never bounce.
tips: Keep breathing while you press; never hold your breath.
Press at about half effort, never hard.
Keep your feet flexed, toes pointing up.

516.cue: Forearms down, draw your chest forward and up, hips heavy. Breathe slowly.
how: Lie face down, legs long and hip-width apart, the tops of your feet down.
Set your elbows under your shoulders, forearms flat and side by side.
Draw your chest forward and up between your arms, hips heavy on the floor.
Press your forearms down, shoulders away from your ears, and breathe slowly.
Lower your chest slowly at the end of the hold.
516.name: Sphinx
516.setup: Lie face down on a mat, elbows under your shoulders.
516.stop: Ease off if your low back pinches; keep your hips on the floor.
tips: Think of pulling your chest forward through your arms, not of bending your low back.
Keep your neck long and your eyes on the floor a little ahead.

517.cue: Arms over your head, let them sink back toward the floor. Breathe slowly.
how: Lie on your back with the rolled towel across your upper back, under your shoulder blades.
Bend your knees with your feet flat and hip-width apart, head resting on the mat.
Reach both arms over your head, elbows straight, palms up.
Let your arms and chest sink back over the towel and breathe slowly.
Bring your arms back over your chest at the end of the hold.
517.name: Towel reach-back
517.setup: Roll a towel tight and lay it across the mat under your shoulder blades.
517.stop: Ease off if your shoulders pinch or your low back arches hard.
tips: Keep your ribs soft so the bend comes from your upper back.
Move the towel a hand lower for a softer bend.

518.cue: Press your elbows gently into the desk, let go, sink your chest. Breathe slowly.
how: Stand facing the desk and set your forearms on its top, shoulder-width apart.
Walk your feet back until your hips are over your feet, knees soft.
Let your chest sink down, your head between your upper arms, ears level with them.
Press your elbows gently into the desk for 5 s at half effort, then let go.
Breathe out and let your chest sink a little lower; three rounds in the hold.
518.name: Desk chest sink
518.setup: Stand a long step from your desk, forearms on its top, shoulder-width.
518.stop: Ease off if your shoulders pinch or your hands tingle.
tips: Keep your low back long so the bend stays in your upper back.
Bring your palms together if your elbows slide apart.
Keep breathing while you press; never hold your breath.

519.cue: Lift your chest, arms and legs together, neck long. Breathe slowly.
how: Lie face down, legs long and together, arms by your sides with your palms down.
Breathe in and lift your chest, arms and both legs off the floor together.
Keep your legs straight and reach your hands back toward your feet.
Rest on your belly, eyes on the floor ahead, and breathe slowly.
Lower slowly at the end of the hold.
519.name: Locust
519.setup: Lie face down on a mat, arms by your sides, palms down.
519.stop: Come down slowly if your low back pinches or your neck strains.
tips: Lift through the length of your body, not by throwing your head back.
Squeeze your seat to help your legs lift.

52.cue: Lower for 3 seconds, push up in 1. Count out loud, breathe out as you push.
how: Place your hands flat on the floor under your shoulders, fingers pointing forward.
Step back onto your toes, feet hip-width apart, body straight from heels to head.
Lower your chest to about a fist above the floor for a slow count of three.
Breathe out and push up to straight arms in one count.
Count each rep out loud as your arms straighten, then start the next slow lowering.
52.name: Push-up, 3-s lowering
52.setup: On the floor, hands under your shoulders.
52.stop: Stop when you lose the 3-s lowering or your hips sag.
tips: Count one, two, three out loud so the last part of the lowering stays slow.
Breathe in slowly as you lower, never hold your breath to stay tight.
Keep your body stiff like a plank so hips and chest reach the bottom together.

520.cue: Press up, hips high, one straight line from shoulders to feet. Breathe slowly.
how: Sit with your legs straight and your hands a hand-length behind your hips.
Point your fingers toward your feet and press your palms into the floor.
Lift your hips until your body is one straight line from shoulders to feet.
Reach your soles toward the floor, open your chest and breathe slowly.
Lower your hips slowly at the end of the hold.
520.name: Upward plank
520.setup: Sit on a mat, legs straight, hands behind your hips, fingers to your feet.
520.stop: Come down slowly if your wrists or shoulders pinch.
tips: Squeeze your seat to keep your hips from sagging.
Keep your neck long; let your head go back only as far as is easy.

521.cue: Arms straight, sink your hips toward the desk, lift your chest. Breathe slowly.
how: Stand facing the desk and set your hands on its edge, shoulder-width apart.
Step back onto the balls of your feet until your body leans in a straight line.
Keep your arms straight and let your hips sink toward the desk.
Lift your chest through your arms, shoulders down, and breathe slowly.
Bring your hips back in line at the end of the hold.
521.name: Desk up-dog
521.setup: Stand a long step back from a desk that cannot slide, hands on its edge.
521.stop: Ease off if your low back pinches or your wrists hurt.
tips: Press the desk away so your shoulders stay over your hands.
Squeeze your seat so the bend spreads through your whole back.

522.cue: Hold your ankles, kick into your hands, chest and thighs up. Breathe slowly.
how: Lie face down, bend your knees and hold the outsides of your ankles.
Keep your knees about hip-width apart.
Breathe in and press your feet back into your hands to lift your chest and thighs.
Rest on your belly with straight arms and breathe slowly.
Let go of your ankles and lower slowly at the end of the hold.
522.name: Bow
522.setup: Lie face down on a mat, knees hip-width apart.
522.stop: Come down slowly if your low back or knees pinch.
tips: The lift comes from your legs pressing back, not from pulling with your arms.
Loop a towel round your ankles if your hands cannot reach them.

523.cue: Lift your chest, elbows and legs together, elbows wide. Breathe slowly.
how: Lie face down, legs long and together, fingers laced behind your head.
Open your elbows wide to the sides.
Breathe in and lift your chest, elbows and both legs off the floor together.
Draw your elbows back level with your ears, rest on your belly and breathe slowly.
Lower slowly at the end of the hold.
523.name: Locust, hands behind head
523.setup: Lie face down on a mat, fingers laced behind your head.
523.stop: Come down slowly if your low back pinches or your neck strains.
tips: Keep your hands light on your head; never pull your head forward.
Squeeze your seat to help your legs lift.

524.cue: Hips forward, chest up, slide your palms down your thighs. Breathe slowly.
how: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, palms on the backs of your hips.
Squeeze your seat and press your hips forward over your feet.
Lift your chest up and back with your knees soft.
Let your palms slide down the backs of your thighs as your back arches.
Breathe slowly, then slide your hands back up and rise, chest first.
524.name: Standing backbend, hands down the thighs
524.setup: Clear space behind you, feet hip-width, a soft mat or rug underfoot.
524.stop: Ease off if your low back pinches; never bounce.
tips: Keep pressing your hips forward so the bend spreads up your back.
Let your head follow your chest, never dropping back hard.

525.cue: In the wheel, up on your toes, push your chest over your hands. Breathe slowly.
how: Press up into the wheel, hands by your ears and feet hip-width apart.
Come up onto the balls of your feet.
Straighten your legs to push your chest through your arms, shoulders over your wrists.
Hold with your arms straight and breathe slowly.
Lower your heels, tuck your chin and come down slowly.
525.name: Wheel lean
525.setup: A clear 2 x 2 m floor that does not slip and a wall behind you.
525.stop: Come down slowly, chin tucked, if your arms shake or your low back pinches.
tips: Keep your knees and feet pointing forward, not turning out.
Push from your legs, never by bending your arms.

526.cue: In the wheel, lift one foot a hand's height for 2 s, then the other. Breathe slowly.
how: Press up into the wheel, hands by your ears and feet hip-width apart.
Shift your weight onto your hands and one foot, hips high.
Lift the other foot a hand's height off the floor and hold it for 2 s.
Set it down softly and lift the other foot the same way, breathing slowly.
Tuck your chin and come down slowly at the end of the set.
526.name: Wheel foot lift
526.setup: A clear 2 x 2 m floor that does not slip and a wall behind you.
526.stop: Come down slowly, chin tucked, if your arms shake or your low back pinches.
tips: Keep your hips level as the foot lifts.
Lift the foot only as high as your hips stay up.

527.cue: Hips forward, arch back, slide your palms down to your calves. Breathe slowly.
how: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, palms on the backs of your hips.
Squeeze your seat and press your hips well forward over your toes.
Lift your chest and arch back, sliding your palms down the backs of your legs.
Go past your knees to your calves, legs nearly straight, and breathe slowly.
Slide your hands back up the same way and rise, chest first.
527.name: Standing backbend, hands to the calves
527.setup: A clear 2 x 2 m floor behind you and a soft mat underfoot.
527.stop: Stop and slide your hands back up if your low back pinches.
tips: Your head is below your hips here, so move slowly.
Keep your hips pressing forward; if they sit back, slide your hands back up.

528.cue: In the wheel, one leg straight up, hips high and level. Breathe slowly.
how: Press up into the wheel, hands by your ears and feet hip-width apart.
Shift your weight onto your hands and one foot.
Draw the other knee in, then straighten that leg up toward the ceiling.
Keep your hips high and level and breathe slowly.
Bend the knee, set the foot down softly, tuck your chin and come down.
528.name: One-leg wheel
528.setup: A clear 2 x 2 m floor that does not slip and a wall behind you.
528.stop: Come down slowly, chin tucked, if your arms shake or your low back pinches.
tips: Point the raised foot and reach it up, not back over your head.
Lift the leg only as high as your hips stay up.

529.cue: Arms by your ears, hips forward, arch back toward the floor. Breathe slowly.
how: Kneel tall with your knees hip-width apart and your thighs upright.
Raise your arms by your ears and press your hips forward.
Arch back from your chest, reaching your hands over your head toward the floor.
Hold with your hips still forward and your hands off the floor; breathe slowly.
Rise slowly with your arms by your ears, chest leading.
529.name: Kneeling reach-back
529.setup: Kneel on a folded towel with clear floor behind you.
529.stop: Stop and rise if your low back or knees pinch.
tips: Your head is below your hips here, so move slowly.
Reach only as far as you can rise from; your hands never land.

53.cue: Head toward the floor between your hands, push back up. Count out loud, breathe out up.
53.hint: Bend your knees if your legs are tight.
how: Place your hands on the floor a little wider than your shoulders, fingers forward.
Walk your feet in and lift your hips high so your body makes an upside-down V.
Bend your elbows and lower the top of your head towards the floor between your hands.
Breathe out as you push back up until your arms are straight, hips staying high.
Count each rep out loud as your arms straighten.
53.name: Pike push-up
53.setup: On the floor, hands wide, hips high.
tips: Keep your hips high the whole time so the push goes up through your shoulders.
Let your elbows point back towards your knees, not out to the sides.
Lower slowly so your head stops just short of the floor, never bumping it.

530.cue: In the wheel, walk your hands in small steps toward your feet. Breathe slowly.
how: Press up into the wheel, hands by your ears and feet hip-width apart.
Lift one hand and set it a little closer to your feet, then the other.
Keep stepping in until your hands are a shin's length from your heels.
Hold with your arms straight and breathe slowly.
Walk your hands back out the same way, tuck your chin and come down.
530.name: Wheel walk-in
530.setup: A clear 2 x 2 m floor that does not slip and a wall behind you.
530.stop: Come down slowly, chin tucked, if your arms shake or your low back pinches.
tips: Move one hand at a time, never both at once.
Push your hips up and your chest toward your hands as they come in.

531.cue: In the wheel, walk your hands in until your fingers touch your heels. Breathe slowly.
how: Press up into the wheel, hands by your ears and feet hip-width apart.
Walk your hands in toward your feet in small steps, one hand at a time.
Keep going until your fingertips touch your heels, arms straight.
Hold with your hips high and breathe slowly.
Walk your hands back out the same way, tuck your chin and come down.
531.name: Wheel, hands to heels
531.setup: A clear 2 x 2 m floor that does not slip and a wall behind you.
531.stop: Come down slowly, chin tucked, if your arms shake or your low back pinches.
tips: Move one hand at a time, never both at once.
Push your hips up over your feet as your hands come in.

532.cue: Arms up, hips forward, hang back with your hands toward the floor. Breathe slowly.
how: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and raise your arms by your ears.
Press your hips well forward over your toes and bend your knees a little.
Arch back slowly, eyes looking for the floor, hands reaching toward it.
Hold there with your hands well off the floor and breathe slowly.
Rise slowly with your hips forward, arms by your ears, chest leading.
532.name: Standing hang-back
532.setup: A clear 2 x 2 m floor behind you and a soft mat underfoot.
532.stop: Stop and rise at once if your legs shake; never drop.
tips: Go only as far as you can rise from; your hands never land.
Your head is below your hips here, so move slowly.
Practise the drop back to the bed until rising feels easy.

536.cue: Hips facing ahead, turn your chest and put both palms on the wall. Breathe out to turn.
how: Stand side-on to a wall, a forearm's length from it, feet hip-width and facing ahead.
Breathe in and stand tall through the top of your head.
Breathe out and turn your chest to the wall, both palms flat on it at chest height.
Keep your hips and knees facing ahead, turning a little more on each breath out.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to turn round and face the other way.
536.name: Wall twist
536.setup: Stand side-on to a wall, a forearm's length away, feet hip-width.
536.stop: Ease off if your back pinches; never push off the wall to turn further.
tips: Squeeze a cushion between your knees if your hips want to turn with you.
Let your hands rest on the wall; the turn comes from your middle back, not your arms.
Turn your chest first and let your head follow last.

537.cue: Keep your knees stacked, open the top arm behind you, eyes follow. Breathe slowly.
how: Lie on your side, a cushion under your head, hips and knees bent to a right angle.
Stack your knees and rest your bottom arm on the floor in front of you.
Breathe out and open the top arm up and over to the floor behind you, chest turning up.
Stay there and let the arm and shoulder blade sink a little on each breath out.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to roll over.
537.name: Side-lying twist
537.setup: Lie on your side on the floor, hips and knees bent to a right angle.
537.stop: Ease off if your shoulder or back pinches.
tips: Keep the top knee on the bottom knee so the turn comes from your upper back.
Rest the arm on a cushion while it does not reach the floor yet.
Let the arm hang heavy rather than pressing it down.

538.cue: Sit tall, one hand behind you, the other on the knee you turn to. Breathe out as you turn.
how: Sit cross-legged on a folded towel, one shin in front of the other, knees low.
Put one hand on the floor behind you and the other on the knee on that side.
Breathe in and sit tall, then breathe out and turn your chest towards the back hand.
Keep both sit bones heavy on the towel and grow tall on each breath in.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to turn the other way.
538.name: Cross-legged twist
538.setup: Sit cross-legged on a folded towel on the floor.
538.stop: Ease off if your back pinches; never pull to turn further.
tips: Lean on the back hand only lightly, so your back stays upright.
Swap which shin is in front when you switch sides.
Turn your chest first and let your head follow last.

539.cue: Turn, gently press as if to turn back for 5 s, relax, breathe out and turn a little more.
how: Sit tall facing the desk and turn your chest to one side, knees still facing forward.
Hold the chair back with the hand behind you and the desk edge with the other.
Gently press your hands as if to turn back, about half effort, for 5 s, still breathing.
Let go of the press, breathe out and turn a little further; do three rounds in all.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
539.name: Chair twist, press and sink
539.setup: Sit tall on your chair facing the desk, feet flat.
539.stop: Ease off if your back pinches; press gently, never hard.
tips: The press is light and your body stays still while you press; only the effort changes.
Breathe the whole time and never hold your breath while you press.
Turn only as far as the stretch stays strong but easy.

54.cue: Lower toward one hand, the other arm straight, alternate. Count out loud, breathe out up.
how: Place your hands on the floor very wide, far outside your shoulders, fingers turned out.
Step back onto your toes, feet hip-width apart, body straight from heels to head.
Bend one elbow and lower your chest towards that hand, keeping the other arm straight.
Breathe out and push back up to the middle, then lower towards the other hand.
Alternate sides every rep; a push-up to one side and then the other counts one.
54.name: Archer push-up
54.stop: Stop when your hips twist or sag. A push-up to each side counts one.
tips: Keep your chest and hips facing the floor, with no twisting towards the bent arm.
Keep the straight arm long and pressing lightly while the bent arm does the work.
Shift your chest sideways over the bent arm as you lower, not only straight down.

540.cue: Hips level, far upper arm on the outside of the raised knee, turn. Breathe out to turn.
how: Face the bed or sofa and put one foot up on its edge, that knee bent and pointing ahead.
Keep the standing leg straight and both hips level and facing the bed.
Breathe in and stand tall, then breathe out and turn towards the raised knee.
Press the far upper arm on the outside of the raised knee, the other hand on your hip.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch legs.
540.name: Foot-up standing twist
540.setup: Face your bed or sofa and put one foot up on its edge.
540.stop: Ease off if your back pinches or a knee hurts; never pull to turn further.
tips: Stand near a wall and touch it with your free hand if you wobble.
Keep the raised knee pointing ahead; it will want to swing in towards your arm.
Grow tall on each breath in and turn a little on each breath out.

541.cue: Hand behind your head, turn the elbow up to the ceiling, eyes follow. Breathe slowly.
how: Set your hands under your shoulders and your knees under your hips, back flat.
Put one hand behind your head, its elbow pointing forwards and down.
Breathe out and turn that elbow up towards the ceiling, your chest turning with it.
Stay at the top and breathe slowly, pressing the floor away with the other hand.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch hands.
541.name: Kneeling chest turn
541.setup: Hands and knees on the floor, a folded towel under your knees.
541.stop: Ease off if your neck, shoulder or wrist pinches.
tips: Keep your hips right over your knees so the turn comes from your upper back.
Let your eyes follow the elbow, and keep the hand light behind your head.
Spread the fingers of the floor hand wide and press through the whole hand.

542.cue: Gently press elbow and knee into each other for 5 s, relax, breathe out and turn more.
how: Sit with one leg long and bend the other knee up, its foot flat by the long thigh.
Turn towards the bent knee and hook the far elbow outside it, the other hand behind you.
Gently press the knee and the elbow into each other, about half effort, for 5 s.
Let go, breathe out and turn a little further; do three rounds in all.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch legs and turn the other way.
542.name: Seated twist, press and sink
542.stop: Ease off if your back pinches; press gently, never hard.
tips: Your body stays still while you press; only the effort changes.
Breathe the whole time and never hold your breath while you press.
Sit up tall before each new turn, both sit bones heavy on the floor.

543.cue: Back flat, one palm under your shoulder, other arm up, chest open. Breathe out to turn.
how: Stand with your feet a leg-length apart, toes facing ahead and knees straight.
Hinge forward with a flat back and put both palms on the floor under your shoulders.
Keep one palm there, breathe out and turn your chest open, the other arm reaching up.
Breathe slowly, growing long through your back on each breath in.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to turn the other way.
543.name: Twisted wide-leg fold
543.setup: Clear floor, feet a leg-length apart and facing ahead.
543.stop: Ease off if your back pinches; never pull to turn further.
tips: Keep your weight over your feet rather than leaning on the hand.
Look down at the floor if looking up bothers your neck.
Come up slowly with your hands on your hips, so your head rises last.

544.cue: On one leg, hand on the books, back leg level, turn your chest up. Breathe slowly.
how: Stand on the leg nearer the desk, the books on the floor a foot ahead of that foot.
Hinge forward and put the hand opposite your standing leg on the books.
Lift the back leg until it is level with your hips, both legs straight.
Breathe out and turn your chest open, the top arm reaching up and the hips level.
The clock times each side; to switch legs, turn round so the desk is by the other leg.
544.name: Twisted half moon on books
544.setup: Clear floor, books 20 cm high, the desk at your side within reach of your top hand.
544.stop: Put the foot down if you wobble hard; ease off if your back pinches.
tips: Keep most of your weight on the standing leg, its knee straight but soft.
Look down at the books if looking up makes you wobble.
Practise with the back foot against a wall until the balance is steady.

545.cue: Foot over the long knee, upper arm outside the bent knee, turn. Breathe out to turn.
how: Sit tall with both legs long, then step one foot over the other knee, flat on the floor.
Plant the hand on the bent-knee side on the floor just behind your hips.
Breathe out and turn towards the bent knee, the other arm hooking outside it.
Slide that arm down until your armpit rests against the outside of the knee.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch legs and turn the other way.
545.name: Foot-over seated twist
545.setup: Sit tall on a folded towel on the floor, legs long.
545.stop: Ease off if your back pinches; never pull to turn further.
tips: Grow taller on every breath in and turn a little further on every breath out.
Keep both sit bones heavy on the towel as your chest turns.
Keep the bent knee pointing up rather than letting it drop across your body.

546.cue: On one leg, hand on the floor, back leg level, turn your chest up. Breathe slowly.
how: Stand on the leg nearer the desk and hinge forward, the back leg lifting behind you.
Put the hand opposite your standing leg on the floor, a foot ahead of your standing foot.
Lift the back leg until it is level with your hips, both legs straight.
Breathe out and turn your chest open, the top arm reaching up and the hips level.
The clock times each side; to switch legs, turn round so the desk is by the other leg.
546.name: Twisted half moon
546.setup: Clear floor, books near in case the floor is far, the desk in reach of your top hand.
546.stop: Put the foot down if you wobble hard; ease off if your back pinches.
tips: Keep most of your weight on the standing leg and only fingertip weight on the hand.
Look down at the floor if looking up makes you wobble.
Go back to the books for a day if the floor makes the turn shrink.

547.cue: Foot over the long knee, arm straight outside the bent knee to the foot. Breathe out.
how: Sit tall with both legs long, then step one foot over the other knee, flat on the floor.
Plant the hand on the bent-knee side behind your hips and sit up tall.
Breathe out and turn, sliding the other arm outside the bent knee up to the armpit.
Straighten that arm down the outside of the shin and hold the foot or the ankle.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch legs and turn the other way.
547.name: Seated twist, hand to foot
547.setup: Sit tall on a folded towel on the floor, legs long.
547.stop: Ease off if your back or shoulder pinches; never pull to turn further.
tips: Hold the ankle first, then walk the hand down to the foot over the days.
Keep the long leg straight and both sit bones heavy on the towel.
Turn your chest first and let your head follow last.

548.cue: Turn, lower arm under the front thigh, clasp behind your back. Breathe out to turn.
how: Step one foot back a leg-length, back toes turned out a little, both knees straight.
Hinge over the front leg with a flat back and turn into the twisted triangle.
Thread the lower arm under the front thigh, close to the hip, and bend that elbow.
Reach the top arm behind your back and clasp your hands or the towel; breathe slowly.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
548.name: Bound twisted triangle
548.setup: Clear floor, feet a leg-length apart, a towel ready for your hands.
548.stop: Ease off if your back pinches or a hamstring tugs hard; never pull on the bind.
tips: Hold the towel between your hands if your fingers do not meet.
Draw the front hip back so your hips stay level as you turn.
Look down at the floor if looking up bothers your neck.

549.cue: Arm round the raised knee, hands clasped behind your back. Breathe out to turn.
how: Fold one leg on the floor, its heel beside the other hip, both sit bones on the towel.
Step the other foot over that knee, flat on the floor, and sit up tall.
Breathe out and turn towards the raised knee, wrapping the far arm round its outside.
Reach the other hand behind your back and clasp your hands or a towel; breathe slowly.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch legs and turn the other way.
549.name: Bound folded-leg twist
549.setup: Sit on a folded towel on the floor, beside your foot, never on it.
549.stop: Ease off if a knee or your back pinches; never pull on the bind.
tips: Keep the bottom leg long, as in the foot-over twist, if the folded knee feels strained.
Hold a towel between your hands if your fingers do not meet.
Sit tall before each turn and never twist with a round back.

55.cue: One hand under your chest, lower and push up. Count out loud, breathe out as you push.
how: Start on your toes with both hands on the floor, then walk your feet out very wide.
Move one hand under the middle of your chest and rest the other hand on your lower back.
Lower your chest towards the floor, keeping hips and shoulders level.
Breathe out and push the floor away until your arm is straight.
Count each rep out loud; finish one arm, press Switch sides, then do the other.
55.name: One-arm push-up
55.stop: Stop when your hips twist or sag. Count the weaker side.
tips: Squeeze your seat and brace your belly hard so your hips stay square to the floor.
Keep the working elbow close to your side, pointing back towards your hip.
Spread your fingers wide and grip the floor to steady the hand.

556.cue: Back heel down, bend the back knee, sink gently. Breathe slowly.
how: Face the wall with your hands flat on it at shoulder height.
Step one foot a short step back, toes pointing at the wall, heel flat on the floor.
Bend both knees and sink your hips down until the low calf of the back leg pulls.
Keep the back heel pressed down and breathe slowly.
The clock times each leg, then counts you in to switch.
556.name: Bent-knee calf stretch
556.setup: Hands on the wall, one foot a short step back.
556.stop: Ease off at a strong pull or if your heel or ankle hurts; never bounce.
tips: A shorter step back moves the stretch lower, towards the heel.
Keep the back knee pointing over your middle toes.
The bent knee stretches the low calf, the part a deep squat needs.

557.cue: Press the ball of your foot down gently, relax, breathe out, knee to the wall.
how: Face the wall, hands on it, front toes four fingers away and the other foot a step back.
Bend the front knee towards the wall, the front heel flat on the floor.
Press the ball of the front foot gently into the floor at half effort for 5 s.
Relax, breathe out and ease the knee closer to the wall; do three rounds.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
557.name: Knee to the wall
557.setup: Face the wall, front toes four fingers from it, hands on the wall.
557.stop: Ease off at a pinch at the front of the ankle; never bounce.
tips: Measure four fingers once with your hand and mark the spot on the floor.
Aim your knee over your middle toes, never inwards.
Keep breathing through each press; never hold your breath.

558.cue: Sit deep, heels on the book, hands light on the desk. Breathe slowly.
how: Face the desk with your hands on its edge and your feet hip-width apart.
Rest your heels on a thick book or a rolled towel, toes on the floor.
Sit your hips down between your heels until your thighs are below level.
Let your hands rest lightly on the desk and breathe slowly.
Stand up slowly, using the desk, at the end of the hold.
558.name: Desk squat, heels raised
558.setup: Face the desk, hands on its edge, a thick book or rolled towel under your heels.
558.stop: Ease off at a pinch at the front of the ankle or if a knee hurts; never bounce.
tips: The raised heels let your knees go forward while your ankles loosen.
Push your knees out over your toes to make room for your hips.
Use a thinner book over the weeks until your heels reach the floor.

559.cue: Drive the front knee over the toes, heel down, body tall. Breathe slowly.
how: Kneel on one knee on a folded towel, the other foot flat on the floor in front.
Rest your hands on your hips and keep your body upright.
Lean your weight forward so the front knee travels past your toes.
Keep the front heel flat on the floor and breathe slowly.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
559.name: Half-kneeling ankle stretch
559.setup: Kneel on one knee on a folded towel, the other foot flat in front.
559.stop: Ease off at a pinch at the front of the ankle or if a knee hurts; never bounce.
tips: Check it once: toes a fist from a wall, the knee just touches it.
Aim the front knee over your middle toes so it tracks straight.
Lean in a little further on each breath out, only as far as a steady pull.

56.cue: Lean back, arms straight, pull your chest to the frame. Breathe out as you pull.
how: Face the edge of a solid doorframe and grip it at chest height, one hand above the other.
Toes near the frame, lean back until your arms are straight, heels to head in one line.
Pull your chest to the frame, elbows close to your sides, then lower with control.
Breathe out as you pull, breathe in as you lean back.
Each pull to the frame and back to straight arms is one rep.
56.name: Doorframe row
56.setup: Grip a solid doorframe at chest height, feet close to it.
56.stop: Stop when your shoulders shrug or your hips sag.
tips: Start each pull by drawing your shoulder blades back, then bend your arms.
Keep your hips in line with your shoulders so your whole body moves as one piece.
Keep your heels planted and your neck long, eyes on the frame.

560.cue: Press your feet down gently, relax, breathe out and sink lower.
how: Face the desk, hands on its edge, and sit into the deep squat with your heels flat.
Press your feet gently into the floor at half effort for 5 s, as if to stand up.
Relax, breathe out and let your hips sink a little lower.
Do three rounds, breathing all the way, then stand up slowly using the desk.
560.name: Desk squat, press and sink
560.setup: Face the desk, hands on its edge, feet hip-width.
560.stop: Ease off at a pinch at the front of the ankle or if a knee hurts; never bounce.
tips: Half effort is enough; the sink after the press is what counts.
Keep breathing as you press; never hold your breath.
Put a rolled towel under your heels if they lift.

561.cue: Heels on the book, palms together, elbows inside the knees. Breathe slowly.
how: Stand with your heels on a thick book or a rolled towel, feet hip-width apart.
Sit your hips down between your heels until your thighs are below level.
Press your palms together at your chest, elbows inside your knees.
Keep your chest up and your hands off the floor, and breathe slowly.
Put your hands on the floor and stand up slowly at the end of the hold.
561.name: Deep squat, heels raised
561.setup: Clear floor, feet hip-width, a thick book or rolled towel under your heels.
561.stop: Ease off at a pinch at the front of the ankle or if a knee hurts; never bounce.
tips: The raised heels let you squat with no hands while your ankles loosen.
Use a thinner book over the weeks until your heels reach the floor.
Press your elbows gently into your knees to open them over your toes.

562.cue: Press your knees gently in against your elbows, relax, breathe out, sink lower.
how: Sit into the deep squat, heels flat, palms together and elbows inside your knees.
Press your knees gently in against your elbows at half effort for 5 s.
Relax, breathe out and let your elbows ease your knees wider as your hips sink.
Do three rounds, then put your hands on the floor and stand up slowly.
562.name: Deep squat, press and sink
562.setup: Clear floor, feet hip-width, toes turned out a little.
562.stop: Ease off at a pinch at the front of the ankle or if a knee hurts; never bounce.
tips: Half effort is enough; keep breathing the whole time.
Keep your heels flat and your chest up as you sink.
Put a rolled towel under your heels if they lift.

563.cue: Hug the bag, sit between your heels, elbows inside the knees. Breathe slowly.
how: Hold a light bag or backpack against your chest with both arms.
Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your toes turned out a little.
Sit your hips down between your heels until your thighs are below level.
Push your knees out with your elbows, heels flat, and breathe slowly.
Stand up slowly at the end of the hold, the bag still close to your chest.
563.name: Bag hug squat
563.setup: Clear floor, feet hip-width, a light bag or backpack hugged to your chest.
563.stop: Ease off at a pinch at the front of the ankle or if a knee hurts; never bounce.
tips: A light bag is enough: its weight helps you sit deeper and stay upright.
Keep the bag close to your chest; held far out it loads your back.
Set the bag down before you put your hands on the floor.

564.cue: Heels down, arms reaching up, elbows straight. Breathe slowly.
how: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your toes turned out a little.
Reach both arms straight up, hands shoulder-width apart.
Sit your hips down between your heels until your thighs are below level.
Keep your arms up, your chest tall and your heels flat, and breathe slowly.
Lower your arms, put your hands on the floor and stand up slowly.
564.name: Deep squat, arms up
564.setup: Clear floor, feet hip-width, toes turned out a little.
564.stop: Ease off at a pinch at the front of the ankle, in a knee or a shoulder; never bounce.
tips: Lift your chest so your arms reach up, not straight ahead.
Hold a towel tight between your hands if it helps keep your arms straight.
Let your arms come forward a little before you let your heels lift.

565.cue: Slide the front knee far over the toes, heel down, body tall. Breathe slowly.
how: Kneel on one knee on a folded towel, the other foot flat on the floor in front.
Slide the front knee forward over your toes until the thigh rests on the calf.
Keep the front heel flat, your body upright and your hands on your hips.
Breathe slowly and let the front ankle bend a little more on each breath out.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
565.name: Knee over toe kneel
565.setup: Kneel on one knee on a folded towel, the other foot flat in front.
565.stop: Ease off at a pinch at the front of the ankle or if a knee hurts; never bounce.
tips: Bring the front foot closer to the back knee if the front heel lifts.
Keep the front knee pointing over your middle toes.
Build up over the weeks; it is a deep bend for the front knee.

566.cue: Feet and knees together, heels down, arms reaching forward. Breathe slowly.
how: Stand with your feet and knees together.
Sit your hips down low, keeping your heels flat.
Reach both arms straight forward at shoulder height, hands off your legs.
Hold yourself in the squat with your legs and breathe slowly.
Put your hands on the floor and stand up slowly at the end of the hold.
566.name: Feet-together squat, arms forward
566.setup: Clear floor, feet together, a rolled towel at hand.
566.stop: Ease off at a pinch at the front of the ankle or if a knee hurts; never bounce.
tips: Lean your chest a little further forward if you tip back.
Put the rolled towel under your heels if they lift.
Keep your knees together and pointing straight ahead.

567.cue: Press the balls of your feet down gently, relax, breathe out, knees forward.
how: Squat with your feet and knees together, heels flat, hands round your ankles.
Press the balls of your feet gently into the floor at half effort for 5 s.
Relax, breathe out and let your knees travel a little further over your toes.
Do three rounds, then put your hands on the floor and stand up slowly.
567.name: Feet-together squat, press and sink
567.setup: Clear floor, feet together, a rolled towel at hand.
567.stop: Ease off at a pinch at the front of the ankle or if a knee hurts; never bounce.
tips: Half effort is enough; keep breathing the whole time.
Put the rolled towel under your heels if they lift.
Reach your arms forward for balance if you tip back.

568.cue: Front thigh on the calf, back knee up, body tall, hands free. Breathe slowly.
how: Stand beside the desk and take a long step forward with one foot.
Bend both knees and lower until the front thigh rests on the calf, heel flat.
Keep the back knee just off the floor and your body upright, hands free.
Breathe slowly and hold, the front heel down the whole time.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
568.name: Knee over toe hover
568.setup: Clear floor beside the desk, a hand free to catch it.
568.stop: Ease off at a pinch at the front of the ankle or in a knee; touch the desk if you sway.
tips: Rest your fingertips on the desk while you learn, then let go.
Keep the back knee a hand's width off the floor, no higher.
Bring the front foot a little closer if the front heel lifts.

569.cue: Heels down, palms together, elbow outside both knees, turn. Breathe out.
how: Squat with your feet and knees together and your heels flat.
Reach your arms forward for balance, then press your palms together at your chest.
Breathe out, turn to one side and hook the far elbow outside both knees.
Press palm into palm to turn your chest a little further, and breathe slowly.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
569.name: Squat prayer twist
569.setup: Clear floor, feet together, a rolled towel at hand.
569.stop: Ease off at a pinch at the front of the ankle, in a knee or in your back.
tips: Put the rolled towel under your heels if they lift; the goal pose needs them flat.
Turn a little more on each breath out, never by forcing the elbow.
Keep your weight over your feet so you do not tip back.

57.cue: Back flat, pull the weight to your hip. Count out loud, breathe out as you pull.
how: Any weight with a handle: a bag of books or bottles, a full jug, a kettlebell or dumbbell.
Nothing near? Hold a light chair without wheels upright by the side of its seat.
Face the desk, free hand flat on it, step back on the weight's side, back flat.
Pull the weight to your hip, elbow close to your side, then lower it with control.
Breathe out as you pull, count each rep; every rep on one side, then press Switch sides.

dumbbells: Face the desk, free hand flat on it, step back on the dumbbell's side, back flat.
Let the dumbbell hang under your shoulder, arm long, palm facing in.
Pull it to your hip, elbow close to your side, then lower it with control.
Breathe out as you pull, count each rep; every rep on one side, then press Switch sides.
kettlebell: Face the desk, free hand flat on it, step back on the kettlebell's side, back flat.
Let the bell hang under your shoulder by its handle, arm long.
Pull it to your hip, elbow close to your side, then lower it with control.
Breathe out as you pull, count each rep; every rep on one side, then press Switch sides.

57.name: One-arm row
57.setup: One hand on the desk, a weight of 5-15 kg in the other: a bag, a jug.

setups.dumbbells: One hand on the desk, a dumbbell of 5-15 kg in the other.
setups.kettlebell: One hand on the desk, a kettlebell of 5-15 kg in the other.

57.stop: Stop when your back rounds or twists. Count the weaker side.
tips: Pick a weight where 10 reps are work and 20 hard: the game says when to go heavier.
1 L of water weighs 1 kg, a hardback about 1 kg: most people start at 5-15 kg.
Drive your elbow towards your back pocket, not straight up to the ceiling.

570.cue: Press the arm gently against your thighs, relax, breathe out and turn further.
how: Come into the bound squat twist, heels flat, hands or the towel clasped behind.
Press the wrapped arm gently against your thighs at half effort for 5 s.
Relax, breathe out and turn your chest a little further.
Do three rounds, breathing all the way, then let go slowly.
The clock times each side, then counts you in to switch.
